items.title_en: Optimization Framework for Full-Skyrmionic Polarimetry
items.title_zh: 全斯格明子偏振测量的优化框架
items.abstract_en: Optical skyrmionic beams hold considerable potential for applications in quantum information and weak-intensity detection. These applications require accurate measurements of full topological observables using imaging Stokes polarimetry, with measurement states optimized in advance to limit the effect of stochastic error sources. However, the optimization framework for general Stokes polarimetries is based on a linear reconstruction chain for Stokes vectors and cannot quantitatively evaluate the nonlinear reconstruction of topological observables. Here, we define full-skyrmionic polarimetry (FSP) and construct its optimization framework from the reconstruction chain for full topological observables. Based on existing polarization evaluating functions (PEF), we introduce topological evaluating functions (TEF) and develop a multi-stage FSP optimization methodology. Numerical results confirm that topological optimization can further improve the reconstruction of topological observables, even when the measurement states are already optimal for polarization. Increasing the redundant projection number also effectively suppresses the effects of all stochastic error sources, providing a low-cost methodology to improve the reconstruction of both polarization and topological observables. The FSP optimization framework can identify topologically optimal configurations for arbitrary FSP structures, providing a guideline for high-precision full-skyrmionic measurements at weak-intensity levels and potential skyrmion ellipsometry.
items.abstract_zh: 光学斯格明子光束在量子信息和弱强度检测中具有相当大的应用潜力。这些应用需要使用成像斯托克斯偏振测量术准确测量完整拓扑可观测量，并预先优化测量状态以限制随机误差源的影响。然而，通用斯托克斯偏振测量的优化框架基于斯托克斯矢量的线性重建链，无法定量评估拓扑可观测量的非线性重建。在此，我们定义全斯格明子偏振测量（FSP），并从完整拓扑可观测量的重建链构建其优化框架。基于现有的偏振评估函数（PEF），我们引入拓扑评估函数（TEF），并开发多阶段 FSP 优化方法。数值结果证实，即使测量状态已对偏振最优，拓扑优化仍可进一步改善拓扑可观测量的重建。增加冗余投影数也能有效抑制所有随机误差源的影响，为改善偏振和拓扑可观测量的重建提供了一种低成本方法。FSP 优化框架能够为任意 FSP 结构识别拓扑最优配置，为弱强度水平下的高精度全斯格明子测量以及潜在的斯格明子椭偏测量提供指导。

items.title_en: Deep Learning for Physicists: From Linear Regression to Reasoning Models
items.title_zh: 面向物理学家的深度学习：从线性回归到推理模型
items.abstract_en: These lecture notes are based on an introductory course on neural networks and deep learning that the author taught in the School of Mathematical Sciences at Queen Mary University of London in 2023/24 and 2024/25. The author, however, is a physicist, and it shows: wherever possible, ideas are explained with physical intuition rather than heavy formalism. Readers with a background in physics or mathematics who want a self-contained, introductory route into modern machine learning may therefore find these notes particularly friendly. The notes start from maximum likelihood, least squares, linear regression and (stochastic) gradient descent. They then cover neural networks, backpropagation, the vanishing gradient problem, batch and layer normalization, overfitting and regularization, adversarial examples, and the kernel method. The second half turns to natural language processing: word embeddings, recurrent networks and LSTMs, the attention mechanism and Transformers, and large language models, including scaling laws, the history of GPT, instruction tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback, hallucination, alignment faking, chain-of-thought reasoning and test-time scaling. The emphasis on large language models reflects requests from the students. The notes are aimed at third- and fourth-year students in the UK system. Because the course was also taken by students from other departments, very little is assumed: even basic material such as matrix multiplication is explained from scratch, so readers familiar with it can safely skip such parts. No originality is claimed; the aim is a coherent, intuitive path through the material. Developments after spring 2025 are not covered, but the basic ideas emphasized here are unlikely to go out of date soon.
items.abstract_zh: 这些讲义基于作者于 2023/24 和 2024/25 学年在伦敦玛丽女王大学数学科学学院讲授的一门关于神经网络和深度学习的入门课程。然而，作者是一名物理学家，这一点显而易见：在可能的情况下，概念通过物理直觉而非繁重形式体系来解释。因此，具有物理或数学背景、希望获得自包含的现代机器学习入门路径的读者可能会觉得这些讲义特别友好。讲义从最大似然、最小二乘、线性回归和（随机）梯度下降开始。随后涵盖神经网络、反向传播、梯度消失问题、批归一化和层归一化、过拟合与正则化、对抗样本以及核方法。后半部分转向自然语言处理：词嵌入、循环网络和 LSTM、注意力机制和 Transformer，以及大语言模型，包括缩放定律、GPT 的历史、指令微调、基于人类反馈的强化学习、幻觉、对齐伪装、思维链推理和测试时缩放。对大语言模型的强调反映了学生的要求。讲义面向英国体系中的三年级和四年级学生。由于该课程也有其他院系的学生选修，因此假定知识很少：甚至矩阵乘法等基础材料也从零解释，所以熟悉这些内容的读者可以安全跳过此类部分。不主张原创性；目标是提供一条连贯、直观的材料学习路径。2025 年春季之后的发展未涵盖，但这里强调的基本思想不太可能很快过时。

items.title_en: Seeing Isn't Resolving: Visual and Linguistic Disambiguation with Conversational Grounding
items.title_zh: 看见不等于消解：利用对话接地的视觉与语言消歧
items.abstract_en: Visual grounding benchmarks usually do not consider the contextual uncertainty of real-world scenarios. In this study, we construct a novel benchmark, the Japanese evaluation for Ambiguous visual Grounding with Dialogue (JAG-D) dataset. It consists of human-robot conversational multimodal interactions covering different types of ambiguity, arising from visual and linguistic categories. We evaluate the capabilities of different state-of-the-art Visual Language Models (VLMs) for ambiguity recognition and resolution. We compare dialogue context grounding performance for visual and linguistic ambiguity resolution. Our experiments show that VLMs can substantially improve the resolution of linguistic ambiguity, especially Japanese zero anaphora, by using dialogue context. We further conduct a comparative analysis to understand whether grounding improvements arise from the semantic content of the dialogue or from its conversational structure.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉接地基准通常不考虑真实场景中的上下文不确定性。在本研究中，我们构建了一个新基准——日语歧义视觉接地对话评估（JAG-D）数据集。它由人-机器人对话多模态交互组成，涵盖源自视觉和语言类别的不同类型歧义。我们评估了不同最先进视觉语言模型（VLM）在歧义识别与消解方面的能力。我们比较了对话上下文接地在视觉歧义和语言歧义消解中的表现。实验表明，VLM 可以利用对话上下文显著改善语言歧义，尤其是日语零代词的消解。我们进一步进行比较分析，以理解接地的改善是来自对话的语义内容还是其会话结构。

items.title_en: ROSE: A Shared Cross-Embodiment Facial-Motion Latent Space for Humanoid Robot Expression
items.title_zh: ROSE：用于人形机器人表情的共享跨具身面部运动潜在空间
items.abstract_en: Natural, coherent full-face dynamic expressions are central to making humanoid robots socially approachable, yet existing systems commonly realize only limited lip motion or scripted expressions. The limitation is both physical and algorithmic. A compact head leaves little room for densely packed, independently controllable actuation; meanwhile, learned systems often generate an avatar video, landmarks, or facial parameters and then infer actuator commands through visual retargeting. This render-and-invert path adds latency and artifacts, and it does not reliably transfer generated behavior to a physical robot. We present ROSE (RObot facial expression through Shared motion Embeddings), a framework that integrates biomimetic hardware, cross-embodiment motion representation learning, and multimodal motion generation. On the hardware side, we build a flexible tendon-sheath transmission structure that integrates 34 actuators into a 19.5 cm biomimetic head. By decoupling actuator placement from facial action points, it enables coordinated full-face expression within a compact volume. On the algorithmic side, ROSE-VAE learns an identity-independent shared facial-motion latent space from human, digital-human, and robot observations. ROSE-Flow directly maps text, audio, or their combination to trajectories in this motion space without using video as a generator input. ROSE-ACT then converts these trajectories into constrained actuator commands. Our system demonstrates how high-density biomimetic hardware and a shared executable facial-motion representation can jointly unify cross-embodiment learning, multimodal generation, and physical robot expression.
items.abstract_zh: 自然、连贯的全脸动态表情对于使人形机器人具有社会亲和力至关重要，但现有系统通常仅实现有限的唇部运动或脚本化表情。这种限制既是物理上的也是算法上的。紧凑的头部几乎没有空间容纳密集排列、可独立控制的驱动；同时，学习系统通常生成虚拟形象视频、关键点或面部参数，然后通过视觉重定向推断执行器命令。这种渲染-反演路径增加了延迟和伪影，并且不能可靠地将生成行为迁移到物理机器人。我们提出 ROSE（RObot facial expression through Shared motion Embeddings，通过共享运动嵌入实现机器人面部表情），一个集成了仿生硬件、跨具身运动表示学习和多模态运动生成的框架。在硬件方面，我们构建了一种柔性腱鞘传动结构，将 34 个执行器集成到 19.5 cm 的仿生头部中。通过将执行器放置与面部动作点解耦，它能够在紧凑体积内实现协调的全脸表情。在算法方面，ROSE-VAE 从人类、数字人和机器人观测中学习一种身份无关的共享面部运动潜在空间。ROSE-Flow 直接将文本、音频或其组合映射到该运动空间中的轨迹，而不使用视频作为生成器输入。ROSE-ACT 随后将这些轨迹转换为受约束的执行器命令。我们的系统展示了高密度仿生硬件和共享可执行面部运动表示如何共同统一跨具身学习、多模态生成和物理机器人表情。

items.title_en: VisDrone-ReID: A Unified Multi-Category Object Re-Identification Benchmark
items.title_zh: VisDrone-ReID：一个统一的多类别目标重识别基准
items.abstract_en: Object re-identification (Re-ID) benchmarks remain predominantly confined to single-category evaluations, limiting the development of unified systems capable of operating across diverse object types. This paper presents VisDrone-ReID, a unified multi-category Re-ID benchmark derived from the VisDrone2019-MOT dataset through a principled conversion pipeline. The pipeline resolves structural incompatibilities between multi-object tracking annotations and Re-ID evaluation requirements, addressing sequence-scoped identity collision, temporal redundancy, and the absence of a principled identity-level train/test split. The resulting benchmark comprises 9,516 identities and 150,016 images across ten object categories - pedestrian, people, bicycle, car, van, truck, tricycle, awning-tricycle, bus, and motor, sourced from 80 unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) sequences captured across urban environments. A leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation protocol is adopted to provide a comprehensive assessment. Baseline experiments across four representative Re-ID models spanning CNN and transformer architectures establish the first systematic performance reference on this benchmark. Results reveal a consistent Rank-1 to mAP gap across all models, suggesting that VisDrone-ReID presents a genuine retrieval challenge beyond nearest-neighbour matching. Per-category analysis identifies pedestrian as the most challenging category and reveals that vision-language pretraining provides a measurable advantage on semantically distinctive categories. VisDrone-ReID provides a consistent platform for studying multi-category object re-identification under the scale variation, viewpoint challenges, and category diversity characteristic of real-world surveillance scenarios.
items.abstract_zh: 目标重识别（Re-ID）基准仍主要局限于单类别评估，限制了能够跨多种目标类型运行的统一系统的发展。本文提出 VisDrone-ReID，一个统一的多类别 Re-ID 基准，通过一套有原则的转换流程从 VisDrone2019-MOT 数据集派生而来。该流程解决了多目标跟踪标注与 Re-ID 评估需求之间的结构不兼容问题，处理了序列范围内的身份冲突、时间冗余以及缺乏有原则的身份级训练/测试划分的问题。所得基准包含来自城市环境中采集的 80 个无人机（UAV）序列的十个目标类别——行人、人群、自行车、汽车、厢式货车、卡车、三轮车、带篷三轮车、公交车和摩托车——的 9,516 个身份和 150,016 张图像。采用留一法（LOO）评估协议以提供全面评估。跨四种代表性 Re-ID 模型（涵盖 CNN 和 Transformer 架构）的基线实验建立了该基准上的首个系统性性能参考。结果揭示所有模型均存在一致的 Rank-1 到 mAP 差距，表明 VisDrone-ReID 呈现出超越最近邻匹配的真实检索挑战。按类别分析将行人识别为最具挑战性的类别，并揭示视觉-语言预训练在语义上可区分的类别上提供了可测量的优势。VisDrone-ReID 为研究真实世界监控场景所特有的尺度变化、视角挑战和类别多样性下的多类别目标重识别提供了统一平台。

items.title_en: From the possible to the optimal: differentiable optimization of gene regulatory networks
items.title_zh: 从可能到最优：基因调控网络的可微优化
items.abstract_en: Understanding the space of ``the actual and the possible'' regulatory architectures capable of realizing biological functions is one of the major challenges in biology. Optimization-based approaches can rationalize regulatory mechanisms from functional objectives and constraints, but their computational cost has limited them to finding individual solutions. Here, we introduce \texttt{jaxgrn}, a framework that combines differentiable programming with stochastic simulations of gene regulatory networks (GRNs) to optimize thousands of networks end-to-end on GPUs. Using morphogen-driven embryonic patterning as a case study, we optimize networks for domain formation and positional information, while varying constraints on input noise, boundary precision and scaling with system size. While recovering known archetypes for scaling, we find that varying the constraints organizes optimal solutions into qualitatively distinct regimes. When optimizing domain formation, we observe phenotypic convergence across a continuum of regulatory architectures, ranging from input-driven to feedback-driven networks. When optimizing positional information, solutions are initially phenotypically diverse despite moderate variation in regulatory architecture; imposing scaling drives both phenotypic and regulatory convergence of the optimized networks onto a few recurring regulatory architectures. Our systematic approach opens the door for variational systems biology in which changing functional constraints reshape the landscape of possible phenotypes and regulatory architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 理解能够实现生物学功能的“实际与可能”调控架构空间是生物学的主要挑战之一。基于优化的方法可以从功能目标和约束中合理化调控机制，但其计算成本限制了它们只能寻找个别解。在此，我们介绍 jaxgrn，一个将可微编程与基因调控网络（GRN）的随机模拟相结合的框架，可在 GPU 上端到端优化数千个网络。以形态发生素驱动的胚胎模式化为案例研究，我们针对结构域形成和位置信息优化网络，同时改变对输入噪声、边界精度以及随系统规模缩放（scaling）的约束。在恢复已知的缩放原型的同时，我们发现改变约束会将最优解组织为定性不同的区域。在优化结构域形成时，我们观察到跨连续调控架构（从输入驱动到反馈驱动网络）的表型收敛。在优化位置信息时，尽管调控架构存在中等程度变异，解起初在表型上是多样的；施加缩放会驱动优化网络的表型和调控收敛到少数重复出现的调控架构上。我们的系统方法为变分系统生物学打开了大门，其中改变功能约束会重塑可能表型和调控架构的景观。

items.title_en: Collective coupling of over 100 individually trapped atoms to a single cavity mode
items.title_zh: 超过100个独立囚禁原子与单一腔模的集体耦合
items.abstract_en: Coupling optical tweezer arrays to high-finesse cavities provides a shared optical interface for neutral-atom registers. Scaling this interface to large tweezer arrays requires placing many traps within the coupling region of a single cavity mode while maintaining uniform trapping and site-resolved detection. Here we match a two-dimensional array of 192 optical tweezers to the coupling profile of a millimeter-scale Fabry-Perot cavity. To improve trap uniformity in the array generated by crossed acousto-optic deflectors, we combine optimization with optical feedback and atomic fluorescence feedback, achieving a mean cesium loading probability of approximately 58%. In each trial, fluorescence imaging determines whether each individual tweezer site is occupied, allowing the cavity transmission spectra to be grouped by atom number. The grouped spectra exhibit resolved normal-mode doublets, and the group with 120 imaged atoms yields an effective collective coupling of $G_{\mathrm{eff}}/(2π) = 21.30 \pm 0.23$ MHz. A model based on the calculated coupling profile and measured site loading probabilities predicts that the mean squared coupling per occupied site changes little between 97 and 120 atoms. The fitted collective coupling is therefore consistent with square-root scaling with atom number despite the spatial variation in single-atom coupling. These results provide an experimental basis for studying photon-mediated many-body dynamics and developing cavity-assisted readout and optical links between neutral-atom registers.
items.abstract_zh: 将光镊阵列耦合到高精细度腔为中性原子寄存器提供了共享光学接口。将这一接口扩展到大型光镊阵列，需要在单一腔模的耦合区域内放置许多陷阱，同时保持均匀囚禁和位点分辨检测。在此，我们将192个光镊的二维阵列与毫米级法布里-珀罗腔的耦合分布相匹配。为改善由交叉声光偏转器生成的阵列中的陷阱均匀性，我们将优化与光学反馈和原子荧光反馈相结合，实现了约58%的平均铯装载概率。在每次试验中，荧光成像确定每个单独光镊位点是否被占据，从而使腔透射光谱能够按原子数分组。分组后的光谱显示出可分辨的简正模双峰，包含120个成像原子的组产生有效集体耦合 G_eff/(2π) = 21.30 ± 0.23 MHz。基于计算耦合分布和实测位点装载概率的模型预测，每个被占据位点的平均平方耦合在97到120个原子之间变化很小。因此，尽管单原子耦合存在空间变化，拟合的集体耦合与原子数的平方根缩放一致。这些结果为研究光子介导的多体动力学以及开发中性原子寄存器之间的腔辅助读出和光学链接提供了实验基础。

items.title_en: In-Context Estimation and Prediction for Parametric ODEs
items.title_zh: 参数化常微分方程的上下文估计与预测
items.abstract_en: Transformers have demonstrated the ability to perform in-context learning, that is, to adapt to new tasks from a few examples without updating their parameters. Existing theory has largely focused on emulating gradient-based algorithms for convex statistical problems or establishing general function approximation guarantees without exploiting the underlying statistical structure. We study in-context parameter estimation and trajectory prediction for parametric ordinary differential equations (ODEs), where estimation is generally nonconvex. Under suitable identifiability and regularity conditions, we construct a transformer that estimates unknown system parameters from noisy trajectory observations through a two-stage approximate maximum likelihood procedure: a coarse search provides an initialization within a locally strongly convex region, followed by gradient descent with local linear contraction. For prediction, we compose this estimator with a neural approximation of the ODE solution map. We further show that, through parameter sharing, a single transformer can perform both parameter estimation and trajectory prediction simultaneously. For these constructions, we establish nonasymptotic guarantees and finite-pretraining oracle inequalities that separate errors due to finite pretraining data, finite context length, and finite-sized transformer approximation. Numerical experiments on linear and nonlinear ODEs further show that pretrained transformers can benefit from longer inference contexts without updating their weights.
items.abstract_zh: Transformer 已被证明具备上下文学习能力，即无需更新参数即可从少量示例适应新任务。现有理论主要集中于为凸统计问题模拟基于梯度的算法，或建立一般函数逼近保证，而未利用底层统计结构。我们研究参数化常微分方程（ODE）的上下文参数估计与轨迹预测，其中估计通常是非凸的。在适当的可识别性和正则性条件下，我们构造了一个 Transformer，通过两阶段近似最大似然过程从含噪轨迹观测中估计未知系统参数：粗搜索提供位于局部强凸区域内的初始化，随后进行具有局部线性收缩的梯度下降。对于预测，我们将该估计器与 ODE 解映射的神经近似组合。我们进一步表明，通过参数共享，单个 Transformer 可同时执行参数估计和轨迹预测。对于这些构造，我们建立了非渐近保证和有限预训练 oracle 不等式，将误差分别归因于有限预训练数据、有限上下文长度和有限规模 Transformer 逼近。在线性和非线性 ODE 上的数值实验进一步表明，预训练的 Transformer 可以受益于更长的推理上下文而无需更新权重。

items.title_en: Living Context Graphs: Continual Semantic Learning for Enterprise Data Reasoning
items.title_zh: Living Context Graph：面向企业数据推理的持续语义学习
items.abstract_en: Enterprise AI can now perform analytics, reporting, and data-driven workflows, yet the data foundations it relies on remain hard to operationalize: business meaning, relationships, metric definitions, and reporting conventions are absent from database schemas and scattered across undocumented systems and tribal knowledge. We introduce the Living Context Graph (LCG), a continually learned context layer that makes existing enterprise data operational for AI without requiring a copy or transformation of the underlying warehouse. LCG bootstraps base semantics and relationships from the data itself, builds a concept graph that indexes business context as queries are served, writes durable semantic learnings from verified outcomes, and withdraws or re-earns context when later outcomes contradict prior routes. We evaluate LCG through text-to-SQL, a core data-reasoning task, on a transfer-aware split of three BIRD databases comprising 499 questions: 353 form the learning history and 146 are held out and never used to update the context layer. Bootstrapping alone improves overall accuracy by +4.6 percentage points. Learning only from the history raises accuracy on the untouched held-out transfer set by +22.6 points (95% CI [+14.4, +30.8]), exceeding five-shot retrieval from the same history by +12.3 points. Incremental learning reaches the one-shot endpoint within observed evaluation noise on every database. Ablating the graph changes held-out accuracy by at most one question per database but increases per-query cost 2.3-3.3x and median latency 1.8-3.4x: continually learned semantics drive accuracy, while the graph makes that context efficient to serve.
items.abstract_zh: 企业 AI 现在可以执行分析、报告和数据驱动工作流，但其依赖的数据基础仍难以操作化：业务含义、关系、指标定义和报告惯例在数据库模式中缺失，并分散在未记录的系统与部落知识中。我们引入 Living Context Graph（LCG），一个持续学习的上下文层，使现有企业数据可供 AI 操作，而无需复制或转换底层数据仓库。LCG 从数据本身自举基础语义和关系，构建一个概念图，在服务查询时索引业务上下文，将经过验证的结果写入持久语义学习，并在后续结果与先前路径矛盾时撤回或重新获得上下文。我们通过文本到 SQL（text-to-SQL）这一核心数据推理任务评估 LCG，在三个 BIRD 数据库的迁移感知划分上进行，共包含 499 个问题：353 个构成学习历史，146 个被留出且从不用于更新上下文层。仅自举即可将总体准确率提高 4.6 个百分点。仅从历史中学习可使未触碰的留出迁移集准确率提高 22.6 个百分点（95% CI [+14.4, +30.8]），比从同一历史中进行五样本检索高 12.3 个百分点。增量学习在每个数据库上均在观测到的评估噪声范围内达到单样本端点。对图进行消融至多使每个数据库的留出准确率改变一个问题，但使每次查询成本增加 2.3-3.3 倍、中位延迟增加 1.8-3.4 倍：持续学习的语义驱动准确率，而图使该上下文能够被高效服务。

items.title_en: TacBridge: Learning Unified Tactile Representations through Cross-Sensor Correspondence
items.title_zh: TacBridge：通过跨传感器对应学习统一触觉表征
items.abstract_en: Optical tactile sensors record tactile videos that capture local deformation and its temporal evolution during contact, supporting robot manipulation, force estimation, and tactile representation learning. Differences in imaging geometry, background appearance, illumination, resolution, and deformation response lead to sensor-dependent observations of the same contact across GelSight, DIGIT, GelSlim, TacTip, and other optical tactile sensors. This variability limits representation transfer and the joint use of multi-sensor data. We introduce TacBridge, a framework for learning unified representations from multi-sensor tactile videos through cross-sensor correspondence. Specifically, multi-sensor masked tactile-video pre-training learns spatiotemporal representations across sensors. We then train the same masked model jointly on same-sensor and cross-sensor reconstruction, using paired source and target videos of matched contact events. Experiments on cross-sensor translation and downstream perception demonstrate the cross-sensor generalization and task transferability of the learned tactile representations.
items.abstract_zh: 光学触觉传感器记录触觉视频，捕获接触期间的局部变形及其时间演化，支持机器人操作、力估计和触觉表征学习。成像几何、背景外观、光照、分辨率和变形响应的差异导致在 GelSight、DIGIT、GelSlim、TacTip 和其他光学触觉传感器上对同一接触的传感器相关观测。这种变异性限制了表征迁移和多传感器数据的联合使用。我们引入 TacBridge，一个通过跨传感器对应从多传感器触觉视频学习统一表征的框架。具体而言，多传感器掩蔽触觉视频预训练学习跨传感器的时空表征。然后，我们使用匹配接触事件的配对源视频和目标视频，在相同传感器和跨传感器重建上联合训练同一掩蔽模型。跨传感器翻译和下游感知实验证明了所学触觉表征的跨传感器泛化和任务可迁移性。

items.title_en: DoF-Query Transformer for Adaptive Fusion of Egocentric Vision and Forearm HD-sEMG in Continuous Hand Kinematics
items.title_zh: 用于连续手部运动学中第一人称视觉与前臂HD-sEMG自适应融合的DoF-Query Transformer
items.abstract_en: Continuous and accurate estimation of human hand kinematics is important not only for intuitive human-machine interaction, but also for capturing fine-grained human manipulation demonstrations that can provide action supervision for embodied-intelligence datasets and dexterous robot learning. However, individual sensing modalities may be insufficient for reliable estimation under varying operating conditions. We present a finger-unencumbered multimodal framework for continuous regression of 20 hand joint angles from egocentric RGB images and 128-channel forearm high-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG). The framework combines a Vision Transformer-based visual encoder, a Transformer-based EMG encoder, and a degree of freedom (DoF) query Transformer fusion decoder. To account for the varying informativeness of visual and EMG cues across joint DoFs and input conditions, the decoder assigns a separate learnable query to each DoF, enabling DoF-specific and context-adaptive fusion of the two modalities. The framework was evaluated on synchronized multimodal data from 10 participants. Averaged across participants, the proposed fusion model achieved a mean coefficient of determination ($R^2$) of $0.88$ and a mean absolute error (MAE) of $2.80^\circ$, compared with $0.82$ and $3.21^\circ$ for the vision-only model and $0.68$ and $5.13^\circ$ for the EMG-only model. It also outperformed the evaluated representative unimodal baselines and alternative fusion designs. DoF-wise analyses showed larger fusion gains for visually ambiguous joints and viewing conditions, while synthetic visual occlusion demonstrated greater robustness than vision-only estimation. These results highlight the complementary value of egocentric vision and forearm HD-sEMG for capturing fine-grained human hand kinematics, with potential applications in human demonstration acquisition and dexterous robot learning.
items.abstract_zh: 连续、准确地估计人手运动学不仅对直观的人机交互很重要，而且对采集细粒度的人类操作演示也很重要，这些演示可为具身智能数据集和灵巧机器人学习提供动作监督。然而，在变化的工作条件下，单一传感模态可能不足以实现可靠估计。我们提出一种手指无束缚的多模态框架，从第一人称RGB图像和128通道前臂高密度表面肌电（HD-sEMG）连续回归20个手部关节角。该框架结合了基于Vision Transformer的视觉编码器、基于Transformer的EMG编码器以及自由度（DoF）查询Transformer融合解码器。为考虑视觉与EMG线索在不同关节自由度和输入条件下的信息量变化，解码器为每个自由度分配一个单独的可学习查询，从而实现两种模态的特定于自由度且上下文自适应的融合。该框架在来自10名参与者的同步多模态数据上进行了评估。在参与者间平均，所提出的融合模型达到平均决定系数（$R^2$）为$0.88$、平均绝对误差（MAE）为$2.80^\circ$，而仅视觉模型为$0.82$和$3.21^\circ$，仅EMG模型为$0.68$和$5.13^\circ$。它还优于所评估的代表性单模态基线和替代融合设计。按自由度分析显示，对于视觉上模糊的关节和视角条件，融合增益更大；而合成视觉遮挡实验表明其比仅视觉估计具有更强的鲁棒性。这些结果凸显了第一人称视觉和前臂HD-sEMG在捕捉细粒度人手运动学方面的互补价值，并可能在人类演示采集和灵巧机器人学习中具有应用。

items.title_en: Multi-Assay Antibody Developability Prediction with Shared Structure-Language Representations
items.title_zh: 使用共享结构-语言表示的多测定抗体可开发性预测
items.abstract_en: Early assessment of antibody developability is critical in drug discovery, but computational approaches remain limited by the scarcity of experimental data. We explore two strategies for working within that limit. First, we designed per-residue physicochemical descriptors encoding the local structural environment, including new terms such as directional charge asymmetry and screened electrostatic potential. These feed a convolutional network, combined with protein language model (PLM) embeddings in a two-stream architecture: the two are encoded and predicted independently and merged only at the prediction stage. Second, a shared trunk with per-assay heads passes information between related assays. Both are implemented in the Multi-Assay Developability Model (MADM) and evaluated on eight assays: HIC, heparin affinity (HAC), AC-SINS, and polyspecificity ELISA against BVP, dsDNA, insulin, ovalbumin and soluble membrane proteins (SMP), with labels from 29 open sources. Structural descriptors match or exceed PLM embeddings (AbLang2, ESM2) on several assays; combining the streams gives a small but consistent gain in accuracy and reduces seed-to-seed variance. Multi-assay training raises Spearman rho for ovalbumin and SMP by about 0.1, where assays correlate and share sequence space. Under cluster-split cross-validation the strongest results are for HAC, ovalbumin, insulin, SMP and HIC (rho = 0.70-0.82); AC-SINS, BVP and dsDNA are weaker (0.50-0.55). In these three, sequence clusters largely coincide with data source, so a held-out fold measures transfer to differently calibrated measurements as well as to new sequences. On the 80-antibody GDPa3 hold-out, performance falls by rho around 0.1 for all but SMP (0.22). Transfer to the VHH panel of Ginkgo GDPa5 gives comparable results, and scFv validation against binary SMP labels yields F1 = 0.89, AUC = 0.95.
items.abstract_zh: 抗体可开发性的早期评估在药物发现中至关重要，但计算方法仍受实验数据稀缺的限制。我们探索了在该限制下开展工作的两种策略。首先，我们设计了编码局部结构环境的逐残基物理化学描述符，包括方向性电荷不对称性和屏蔽静电势等新项。这些描述符输入一个卷积网络，并在双流架构中与蛋白质语言模型（PLM）嵌入结合：两者独立编码和预测，仅在预测阶段合并。其次，带有各测定专属头的共享主干在相关测定之间传递信息。两者均在多测定可开发性模型（MADM）中实现，并在八项测定上评估：HIC、肝素亲和力（HAC）、AC-SINS，以及针对BVP、dsDNA、胰岛素、卵白蛋白和可溶性膜蛋白（SMP）的多特异性ELISA，标签来自29个公开来源。在若干测定上，结构描述符达到或超过PLM嵌入（AbLang2、ESM2）；结合两个流在准确率上带来小而一致的增益，并降低种子间方差。多测定训练将卵白蛋白和SMP的Spearman rho提高约0.1，这些测定相互关联并共享序列空间。在聚类划分交叉验证下，HAC、卵白蛋白、胰岛素、SMP和HIC的结果最强（rho = 0.70-0.82）；AC-SINS、BVP和dsDNA较弱（0.50-0.55）。在这三项中，序列簇在很大程度上与数据来源重合，因此留出折既衡量对新序列的迁移，也衡量对校准不同的测量的迁移。在80个抗体的GDPa3留出集上，除SMP（下降0.22）外，所有测定的性能下降约0.1（rho）。迁移到Ginkgo GDPa5的VHH面板得到可比结果，针对二值SMP标签的scFv验证得到F1 = 0.89、AUC = 0.95。

items.title_en: Ternary-Valued FDTD Method for Nonlinear Optics: Third-Harmonic Generation on a Multiplier-Free Solver
items.title_zh: 用于非线性光学的三值FDTD方法：无乘法器求解器上的三次谐波产生
items.abstract_en: I show that a finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) solver with field variables restricted to the ternary alphabet $\{-1,0,+1\}$ can reproduce nonlinear optical physics quantitatively on both CPUs and field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs). Building on the general ternary-valued FDTD algorithm, in which each Yee cell stores an integer state that accumulates the discrete curl of neighbouring symbols without being drained, I extend the scheme to inhomogeneous and Kerr media and to Mur absorbing boundaries, without performing any multiplication operations. Dielectric contrast is implemented as a multiplexer, since the difference between ternary symbols takes only a few values, the instantaneous Kerr nonlinearity as a coefficient look-up table and the Mur boundary coefficients as canonical signed-digit shift--add chains. The scheme reproduces the third-harmonic conversion efficiency of a floating-point reference to within $1.4\%$. A symmetry of the governing physics, expressed through the even harmonics forbidden by centrosymmetric $χ^{(3)}$, provides a reference-free self-check for both ternary and floating-point models. The complete solver fits on a small, low-cost FPGA and contains no multiplier anywhere in its datapath, placing nonlinear optical modelling within reach of embedded and autonomous platforms rather than of high-performance computers.
items.abstract_zh: 我表明，场变量限制在三元字母表$\{-1,0,+1\}$的有限差分时域（FDTD）求解器可以在CPU和现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）上定量重现非线性光学物理。基于通用三值FDTD算法——其中每个Yee元胞存储一个整数状态，该状态累加相邻符号的离散旋度而不被耗尽——我将该方案扩展到非均匀介质、Kerr介质和Mur吸收边界，且不执行任何乘法操作。介电对比度实现为多路复用器，因为三值符号之间的差值仅取少数几个值；瞬时Kerr非线性实现为系数查找表；Mur边界系数实现为规范符号位（CSD）移位-加法链。该方案将三次谐波转换效率重现到与浮点参考相差$1.4\%$以内。支配物理的一种对称性——表现为中心对称$χ^{(3)}$所禁止的偶次谐波——为三值模型和浮点模型提供了一种无参考自检。完整求解器可适配小型低成本FPGA，且其数据通路中任何位置都不含乘法器，使非线性光学建模可为嵌入式和自主平台所用，而不再局限于高性能计算机。

items.title_en: A COMPASS to the Galaxy: Joint nucleosynthetic yield set comparison and parameter inference in Galactic chemical evolution
items.title_zh: 通往银河系的COMPASS：星系化学演化中核合成产额集联合比较与参数推断
items.abstract_en: Galactic Chemical Evolution (GCE) models connect stellar nucleosynthesis to observed abundance patterns, but their interpretation requires simultaneous parameter inference and comparison between competing stellar yield prescriptions. This remains challenging due to intractable likelihoods and growing dataset complexity. Using compass, a novel simulation-based inference framework, we perform, for the first time, amortized joint Bayesian model comparison and parameter inference for GCE models with intractable likelihoods within a unified architecture. Compass employs a conditional score-based diffusion model with a transformer architecture to learn both the posterior and likelihood directly from forward simulations, enabling efficient inference and likelihood-based ranking of competing nucleosynthetic yield sets. In controlled tests, compass identifies the generating yield set and recovers ground-truth parameters with accuracy comparable to existing simulation-based inference (SBI) methods, while reducing computational cost by orders of magnitude. Applied to Milky Way data, the framework favors a hybrid NuGrid + IllustrisTNG yield prescription, confirmed by an independent classifier, and infers an initial mass function slope of $α_{\rm IMF} = -2.65 \pm 0.02$ and a SN$_{\rm Ia}$ normalization of $\log(N_{\rm Ia}) = -2.81 \pm 0.02$, with a systematic spread of $\approx 0.3$ in $α_{\rm IMF}$ between the best-ranked yield sets, consistent with independent constraints. The attention mechanism confirms that the inferred parameters are driven by physically meaningful abundance signatures. By unifying amortized parameter inference, Bayesian model comparison, and interpretability in a single probabilistic framework, compass provides a scalable approach for precision chemical evolution studies with current and forthcoming spectroscopic surveys.
items.abstract_zh: 星系化学演化（GCE）模型将恒星核合成与观测到的丰度模式联系起来，但其解释需要同时进行参数推断以及竞争性恒星产额规定之间的比较。由于似然难以处理且数据集复杂性不断增加，这仍然具有挑战性。使用compass——一种新的基于模拟的推断框架——我们首次在统一架构内对具有难处理似然的GCE模型进行摊销式联合贝叶斯模型比较和参数推断。Compass采用具有Transformer架构的条件基于分数的扩散模型，直接从正向模拟中学习后验和似然，从而实现高效推断以及基于似然的竞争性核合成产额集排序。在受控测试中，compass识别生成产额集，并以与现有基于模拟的推断（SBI）方法相当的精度恢复真实参数，同时将计算成本降低几个数量级。应用于银河系数据时，该框架倾向于混合的NuGrid + IllustrisTNG产额规定，这一点由独立分类器确认，并推断初始质量函数斜率为$α_{\rm IMF} = -2.65 \pm 0.02$、SN$_{\rm Ia}$归一化为$\log(N_{\rm Ia}) = -2.81 \pm 0.02$，在最佳排序产额集之间$α_{\rm IMF}$的系统性散布约为$0.3$，与独立约束一致。注意力机制确认，推断出的参数由具有物理意义的丰度特征驱动。通过将摊销式参数推断、贝叶斯模型比较和可解释性统一在一个概率框架中，compass为利用当前和即将开展的光谱巡天进行精密化学演化研究提供了一种可扩展的方法。

items.title_en: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB: An Open and Efficient Small Language Model for Fast Conversational Agents
items.title_zh: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB：面向快速对话代理的开放高效小型语言模型
items.abstract_en: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an open and efficient small language model further post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it and optimized for speed and intelligence per GB of memory used for fast conversational agents. The model carries forward Gemma's strong conversational capabilities and further improves multi-turn tool use, instruction following, and input grounding for fast, local voice/device assistants, interactive personas, and embedded/Edge interfaces. The model combines natural conversation with multi-turn agentic capabilities to power voice/device assistants, interactive characters and robotic/IoT interfaces running on GeForce RTX, Jetson, and RTX/DGX Spark. Experiments on 21 benchmarks show that Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB achieves the highest average accuracy while generating the fewest output tokens in both reasoning and non-reasoning modes, compared with Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3.5-4B. The model is released with a DFlash drafter. With DFlash, Bolt E4B achieves $2.74\times$ the per-user decode speed of inference without speculative decoding at concurrency~1, and $1.21\times$ the generation throughput of Gemma-4-E4B-it with MTP at batch size 1.
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB，这是一个开放且高效的小型语言模型，由Gemma-4-E4B-it进一步后训练而来，并针对快速对话代理所用每GB内存的速度和智能进行优化。该模型继承了Gemma强大的对话能力，并进一步改进多轮工具使用、指令遵循和输入接地，面向快速、本地的语音/设备助手、交互式角色以及嵌入式/边缘接口。该模型将自然对话与多轮代理能力相结合，为运行在GeForce RTX、Jetson和RTX/DGX Spark上的语音/设备助手、交互式角色以及机器人/IoT接口提供支持。在21个基准上的实验表明，与Gemma-4-E4B-it和Qwen3.5-4B相比，Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB在推理和非推理模式下均实现最高平均准确率，同时生成最少的输出token。该模型随DFlash drafter一起发布。借助DFlash，在并发度为1时，Bolt E4B达到无推测解码推断的每用户解码速度的$2.74\times$，并且在批大小为1时达到带MTP的Gemma-4-E4B-it生成吞吐量的$1.21\times$。

items.title_en: Learning and Verifying Progress: Closed-Loop Agentic Planning with Progress-Enhanced Execution for Long-Horizon Vision-Language Navigation
items.title_zh: 学习与验证进度：面向长时程视觉-语言导航的具有进度增强执行的闭环代理规划
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon vision-language navigation (VLN) requires agents to track instruction progress and recover from local errors before they propagate across subtasks. However, executors trained on expert trajectories encounter policy-induced state shifts during deployment, and their stop signals do not reliably indicate subtask completion. We introduce Learning and Verifying Progress for VLN (LeaP-VLN), an agentic VLN system that couples progress-aware execution with independent progress verification through plan--execute--verify--recover cycles. LeaP-VLN leverages progress both explicitly, through a progress verifier that verifies subtask completion before the agent advances and triggers dual-phase recovery upon route deviation, and implicitly, by co-training the executor on progress reasoning and action prediction to enhance the executor's progress awareness and corrective control. To adapt the executor to this closed-loop interface, we propose a two-stage progress-enhanced curriculum: behavior cloning on expert demonstrations, followed by joint training on demonstrations, expert action corrections, and progress-reasoning supervision. Policy-generated trajectories expose the executor to both intra-subtask drift and inter-subtask state shifts, aligning training with the deviations encountered during closed-loop execution. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE demonstrate state-of-the-art success rates among monocular methods trained without additional navigation datasets, while real-world experiments further validate the effectiveness of LeaP-VLN in long-horizon navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 长时程视觉语言导航（VLN）要求代理跟踪指令进度，并在局部错误传播到跨子任务之前从中恢复。然而，在专家轨迹上训练的执行器在部署期间会遇到策略引起的状态偏移，并且其停止信号不能可靠地指示子任务完成。我们提出用于VLN的学习与验证进度（LeaP-VLN），一种代理式VLN系统，通过规划--执行--验证--恢复循环，将进度感知执行与独立进度验证相结合。LeaP-VLN显式地和隐式地利用进度：显式地通过进度验证器，在代理前进之前验证子任务完成，并在路线偏离时触发双阶段恢复；隐式地通过对执行器进行进度推理和动作预测的联合训练，以增强执行器的进度意识和纠正控制。为使执行器适应这种闭环接口，我们提出两阶段进度增强课程：先在专家演示上进行行为克隆，然后在演示、专家动作纠正和进度推理监督上进行联合训练。策略生成的轨迹使执行器同时暴露于子任务内漂移和子任务间状态偏移，从而使训练与闭环执行期间遇到的偏差对齐。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上的大量实验表明，在未使用额外导航数据集训练的单目方法中，其成功率达到最先进水平；真实世界实验进一步验证了LeaP-VLN在长时程导航中的有效性。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.title_zh: NeRF：将场景表示为神经辐射场以进行视图合成
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏输入视图优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视角方面取得最先进结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续5D坐标（空间位置 $(x,y,z)$ 和观察方向 $(θ, φ)$），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和视图相关发射辐射。我们通过沿相机光线查询5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组已知相机位姿的图像。我们描述如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何和外观的场景的逼真新视角，并展示优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: Vision-Language Models Reproduce a Human Mental-Extrapolation Bias in the Watanabe Illusion
items.title_zh: 视觉语言模型在Watanabe错觉中重现人类心理外推偏差
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for visual judgments, yet whether they share human perceptual biases, and where in the model such biases arise, is unclear. We addressed this with the Watanabe Illusion, a stimulus not previously studied quantitatively: an oblique segment inside a circle whose extension geometrically hits the topmost of 11 dots, yet human observers (n = 131) reported a dot near the middle of the column. Five VLMs (Qwen2.5-VL-32B and 7B, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.5 Instant, Gemini 3.5 Flash), given the identical stimulus and wording, all deviated in the same direction. In the open-weight Qwen2.5-VL-32B, linear probes on the vision encoder recovered the line angle and the target dot six to eight times more accurately than its behavioral responses. A layer-wise logit lens showed that the correct answer dominates in the middle layers of the language model and is overwritten in late layers only under a visual-judgment frame. Naming the illusion, requesting suppression of prior knowledge, forcing a visual chain of thought, and 390 semantic preambles left the response center unchanged; only disclosing the correct answer moved it. VLMs may therefore carry human perceptual biases at the language-generation stage, where they resist declarative correction.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多地用于视觉判断，但它们是否具有与人类相同的知觉偏差，以及这些偏差在模型何处产生，仍不清楚。我们用Watanabe错觉来研究这一问题，该刺激此前未被定量研究：圆内一条斜线段，其延长线在几何上击中11个点中最上方的一个，但人类观察者（n=131）报告的是靠近该列中部的一个点。五个VLM（Qwen2.5-VL-32B和7B、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.5 Instant、Gemini 3.5 Flash）在给定相同刺激和措辞时，均朝相同方向偏离。在开放权重的Qwen2.5-VL-32B中，视觉编码器上的线性探针恢复线段角度和目标点的准确率比其行为响应高6到8倍。逐层logit lens显示，正确答案在语言模型的中间层占主导，并且仅在视觉判断框架下在后期层被覆盖。命名该错觉、要求抑制先验知识、强制视觉思维链以及390个语义前缀均未改变响应中心；只有披露正确答案才使其移动。因此，VLM可能在语言生成阶段携带人类知觉偏差，并在该阶段抵抗陈述性纠正。

items.title_en: Multi-output neural network surrogate for double-pulse femtosecond optothermal control of thin silicon films on fused silica
items.title_zh: 用于熔融石英上薄硅膜双脉冲飞秒光热控制的多输出神经网络代理模型
items.abstract_en: We introduce a multi-output feedforward neural network surrogate trained on a coupled multiple-reflection and two-temperature model to map double-pulse femtosecond laser excitation (1030 nm) of crystalline silicon films on fused silica across film thicknesses (50-500 nm) and inter-pulse delays (0-10ps). Trained via Levenberg-Marquardt optimization on 2000 physical simulations, the dual-hidden-layer network ([40,30] neurons) simultaneously predicts six strongly coupled optothermal observables, peak electron temperature, peak lattice temperature, peak carrier density, minimum and maximum absorptivity and minimum refractive index achieving coefficients of determination R2 larger than 0.9998 across all targets. Evaluating a dense 200 by 200 design grid in milliseconds resolves pronounced thin-film interference fringes and carrier-induced index modulation, identifying an optimal optothermal coupling regime at d=156 nm and Dt=4.572 ps. This unified machine-learning workflow eliminates computationally expensive multi-physics runtime bottlenecks for real-time laser processing control and inverse photonic thin-film design.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种多输出前馈神经网络代理模型，它在耦合多重反射与双温度模型上训练，用于映射对熔融石英上晶体硅薄膜的双脉冲飞秒激光激发（1030 nm），覆盖薄膜厚度（50-500 nm）和脉冲间延迟（0-10 ps）。该双隐藏层网络（[40,30]个神经元）通过Levenberg-Marquardt优化在2000次物理仿真上训练，可同时预测六个强耦合的光热观测量：峰值电子温度、峰值晶格温度、峰值载流子密度、最小和最大吸收率以及最小折射率，在所有目标上取得大于0.9998的决定系数R2。在毫秒内评估200×200的密集设计网格，可分辨显著的薄膜干涉条纹和载流子诱导折射率调制，识别出d=156 nm和Δt=4.572 ps处的最优光热耦合区间。这一统一的机器学习工作流消除了用于实时激光加工控制和逆向光子薄膜设计的计算昂贵多物理运行时瓶颈。

items.title_en: SemiNovo: Learning Beyond Search-Identified Spectra for De Novo Peptide Sequencing
items.title_zh: SemiNovo：超越搜索鉴定谱图学习用于从头肽段测序
items.abstract_en: Sensitive peptide identification is fundamental to protein characterization and novel protein discovery, for which de novo peptide sequencing (DNPS) from tandem mass spectra provides an important database-independent approach. Although deep learning has substantially advanced de novo sequencing, existing models are predominantly trained on high-confidence peptide-spectrum matches obtained through database search. This search-conditioned supervision excludes a large fraction of unidentified spectra, creating a distribution mismatch between the selectively labeled training data and the complete spectrum stream encountered at inference time, thereby limiting peptide identification performance. To address this challenge, we propose SemiNovo, a semi-supervised framework that learns jointly from identified and unlabeled spectra. SemiNovo first constructs DarkSpec, a large-scale quality-controlled corpus of unlabeled spectra collected from diverse public proteomics projects, thereby extending training beyond search-identified spectra and mitigating the resulting shift in DNPS supervision. It then combines stepwise mass-constrained autoregressive decoding with cumulative path confidence to derive reliable supervision from unlabeled spectra. Moreover, SemiNovo introduces head-wise chemical-evidence gating to improve spectral evidence aggregation under noisy and incomplete fragmentation. Experiments show that SemiNovo performs favorably against state-of-the-art methods on multiple benchmarks. Code and dataset are publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 灵敏的肽段鉴定是蛋白质表征和新蛋白质发现的基础，其中基于串联质谱的从头肽段测序（DNPS）提供了一种重要的不依赖数据库的方法。尽管深度学习已显著推进从头测序，但现有模型主要在高置信度、通过数据库搜索获得的肽段-谱图匹配上训练。这种以搜索为条件的监督排除了很大一部分未鉴定谱图，造成选择性标注的训练数据与推理时遇到的完整谱图流之间的分布不匹配，从而限制肽段鉴定性能。为应对这一挑战，我们提出SemiNovo，一个从已鉴定谱图和未标记谱图联合学习的半监督框架。SemiNovo首先构建DarkSpec，这是一个从多个公共蛋白质组学项目中收集的大规模、经过质量控制的未标记谱图语料库，从而将训练扩展到搜索鉴定谱图之外，并缓解由此产生的DNPS监督偏移。然后，它将逐步质量约束自回归解码与累积路径置信度相结合，从无标记谱图中获得可靠监督。此外，SemiNovo引入逐头化学证据门控，以在噪声和不完整碎裂下改进谱图证据聚合。实验表明，SemiNovo在多个基准上优于最先进方法。代码和数据集已公开可用。

items.title_en: CuRSE-Bench: A Benchmark for Probing Cultural Blind Spots in Text-to-Image Safety Evaluation
items.title_zh: CuRSE-Bench：用于探查文本到图像安全评估中文化盲点的基准
items.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) safety evaluation typically assigns each prompt or image a single culture-blind harm label, so content that is harmful only within a particular culture can pass as benign. We introduce CultureCraft, an agentic framework that constructs T2I prompts that appear benign under a general-purpose rubric yet carry a latent harmful meaning in a target culture, and use it to build CuRSE-Bench: 10,709 culture-specific prompts and 2,648 culture-general controls over six regions and ten harm axes, each drawn from a predefined knowledge base of documented harm vectors and traceable to at least two independent sources. Scoring every prompt under six region persona judges and a paired culture-blind judge, we find that the culture-blind judge under-rates culture-specific latent harm while matching the persona judges on the controls. Each persona judge, in turn, chiefly decodes its own region's latent harm under our instrument: a selective cultural blind spot that persists in deployed moderators.
items.abstract_zh: 文本到图像（T2I）安全评估通常为每个提示或图像分配单一的文化盲危害标签，因此仅在特定文化中有害的内容可能被当作良性通过。我们引入CultureCraft，一个智能体框架，用于构建在通用标准下看似良性但在目标文化中带有潜在有害含义的T2I提示，并用其构建CuRSE-Bench：涵盖六个区域和十个危害轴的10,709个文化特定提示和2,648个文化通用对照，每个均取自预定义的有记录危害向量知识库，并可追溯至至少两个独立来源。在六个区域人格评审器和一个配对的文化盲评审器下对每个提示评分，我们发现文化盲评审器低估文化特定潜在危害，而在对照上与人格评审器一致。反过来，每个人格评审器在我们的测量工具下主要解码其自身区域的潜在危害：一种选择性文化盲点在已部署的审核器中持续存在。

items.title_en: Vision-Language Grounded Semantic Navigation for Autonomous Mobile Robots
items.title_zh: 面向自主移动机器人的视觉语言 grounded 语义导航
items.abstract_en: Language-guided navigation enables mobile robots to interpret natural language commands and navigate toward user-specified targets in unstructured environments. However, integrating open-vocabulary visual perception with classical robotics pipelines for mapping and navigation remains a challenging problem. In this work, we present a complete ROS2-based system that combines frontier-based exploration, open-vocabulary object detection using Grounding DINO, depth-based 3D localization, and semantic mapping to enable end-to-end vision-language grounded navigation in simulation. The system accepts natural language commands such as ``go to the yellow box,'' detects candidate objects from RGB images using text prompts, estimates their positions in the world frame, and generates navigation goals executed by the Nav2 stack. In a Gazebo-based indoor environment with a TurtleBot3 robot, the system autonomously explored the room, detected three of the five target objects, and successfully executed both natural language navigation commands tested, without task-specific training. The results indicate that open-vocabulary grounding models can be integrated into classical navigation pipelines, though performance is limited by detection uncertainty, depth-based localization error, and incomplete exploration coverage. These findings highlight both the feasibility and current limitations of deploying vision-language grounded navigation systems using lightweight, CPU-only architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 语言引导导航使移动机器人能够解释自然语言命令，并在非结构化环境中导航至用户指定目标。然而，将开放词汇视觉感知与用于建图和导航的经典机器人流水线集成仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。在本工作中，我们提出一个完整的基于ROS2的系统，结合基于前沿的探索、使用Grounding DINO的开放词汇目标检测、基于深度的3D定位和语义建图，以在仿真中实现端到端视觉语言 grounded 导航。系统接受诸如“去黄色盒子”的自然语言命令，使用文本提示从RGB图像中检测候选对象，估计它们在世界坐标系中的位置，并生成由Nav2栈执行的导航目标。在基于Gazebo、配备TurtleBot3机器人的室内环境中，系统自主探索房间，检测到五个目标对象中的三个，并成功执行了两个测试的自然语言导航命令，且无需任务特定训练。结果表明，开放词汇 grounding 模型可以集成到经典导航流水线中，但性能受检测不确定性、基于深度的定位误差和不完整探索覆盖的限制。这些发现凸显了使用轻量级、仅CPU架构部署视觉语言 grounded 导航系统的可行性与当前局限。

items.title_en: ViRA: Toward Ultra-High-Resolution Visual Agents via Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization
items.title_zh: ViRA：通过跨输入相对策略优化迈向超高分辨率视觉智能体
items.abstract_en: Visual agents answer questions about ultra-high-resolution photos by zooming into the relevant regions. However, existing agents often answer from common sense instead of reading the evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) on the final answer cannot correct this, because a guess earns the same reward as reading. We propose Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization (CrossRPO), which trains agents on contrast sets. A contrast set asks one question about several versions of an image that differ only in a small region with the evidence and have different answers, so only reading the evidence solves the whole set. CrossRPO rewards solving the whole set, and we prove that it does not reinforce a set answered from common sense. We build contrast sets for training (ViRA-Train) and evaluation (ViRA-Bench) by editing one small object in images of 21 to 120 megapixels, and we photograph further sets with real changes (ViRA-Bench-Real) to exclude editing traces. We train two Visual Reasoning Agents, ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B, with CrossRPO on only about 3,500 items of ViRA-Train each. CrossRPO achieves 63.3% set accuracy on ViRA-Bench at the maximum resolution, against 59.3% for GRPO. ViRA-9B is the most accurate open model of its size on all benchmarks, and ViRA-27B outperforms Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6-Luna, both at their highest thinking level, on most benchmarks.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉智能体通过放大相关区域来回答关于超高分辨率照片的问题。然而，现有智能体常常凭常识作答，而不是读取证据。仅对最终答案进行强化学习（RL）无法纠正这一点，因为猜测与读取证据获得相同的奖励。我们提出跨输入相对策略优化（CrossRPO），在对比集上训练智能体。对比集针对同一个问题给出图像的多个版本，这些版本仅在一个包含证据的小区域上不同且答案不同，因此只有读取证据才能解出整个集合。CrossRPO 奖励解出整个集合，并且我们证明它不会强化凭常识作答的集合。我们通过编辑 21 至 120 兆像素图像中的一个小物体，构建用于训练（ViRA-Train）和评估（ViRA-Bench）的对比集，并拍摄具有真实变化的进一步集合（ViRA-Bench-Real）以排除编辑痕迹。我们仅使用每个约 3,500 条 ViRA-Train 数据，通过 CrossRPO 训练了两个视觉推理智能体 ViRA-9B 和 ViRA-27B。CrossRPO 在最大分辨率下的 ViRA-Bench 上达到 63.3% 的集合准确率，而 GRPO 为 59.3%。ViRA-9B 是所有基准上同规模开放模型中最准确的，且 ViRA-27B 在大多数基准上优于 Claude Haiku 5.5 和 GPT-6-Luna（两者均处于其最高思考水平）。

items.title_en: Whole-bulb LSFEM enables automated reconstruction and quantitative spatial mapping of thousands of olfactory glomeruli
items.title_zh: 全嗅球 LSFEM 实现数千个嗅小球的自动重建与定量空间映射
items.abstract_en: The glomerular layer of the olfactory bulb (OB) transforms chemical information into the first spatially organized neural representation of odor identity. Yet its three-dimensional architecture remains difficult to quantify at whole-bulb scale. Here, we establish an end-to-end framework integrating light-sheet fluorescence expansion microscopy (LSFEM) with automated reconstruction of thousands of individual glomeruli across intact mouse OBs. LSFEM preserves whole-bulb architecture and supports genetically encoded fluorescence and immunolabelling, providing continuous multichannel input for automated analysis. SegFormer-based segmentation of 2D optical sections was followed by morphology-guided separation and three-dimensional object reconstruction. Across 12 intact bulbs, the workflow yielded a median of 2,677 glomeruli per bulb, approaching the 2,851 reported by complete three-dimensional reconstruction. Object-level maps further revealed that glomeruli spanning a broad range of volumes were intermingled throughout the bulb without evident size-defined anatomical domains. Because each reconstructed glomerulus retains a three-dimensional centroid coordinate, the resulting object map can additionally be used as a specimen-specific spatial reference framework, allowing distances and distributions to be expressed relative to defined glomerular or anatomical positions within the intact OB. Together, whole-bulb LSFEM and automated reconstruction provide a scalable framework for quantitative three-dimensional mapping of glomerular number, morphology, and spatial organization, and the relative positioning of additional anatomical signals within the glomerular architecture.
items.abstract_zh: 嗅球（OB）的嗅小球层将化学信息转化为气味身份的首个具有空间组织的神经表征。然而，其三维结构在全嗅球尺度上仍难以量化。在此，我们建立了一个端到端框架，将光片荧光膨胀显微术（LSFEM）与完整小鼠嗅球中数千个单个嗅小球的自动重建相结合。LSFEM 保留全嗅球结构，并支持基因编码荧光和免疫标记，为自动分析提供连续的多通道输入。先对二维光学切片进行基于 SegFormer 的分割，随后进行形态学引导的分离和三维对象重建。在 12 个完整嗅球中，该工作流程每个嗅球产生中位数 2,677 个嗅小球，接近完整三维重建报道的 2,851 个。对象级图谱进一步揭示，跨越广泛体积范围的嗅小球遍布整个嗅球并相互混杂，没有明显的由大小定义的解剖域。由于每个重建的嗅小球保留三维质心坐标，所得对象图谱还可作为特定标本的空间参考框架，使距离和分布能够相对于完整 OB 内定义的嗅小球或解剖位置来表示。总之，全嗅球 LSFEM 和自动重建提供了一个可扩展框架，用于定量三维映射嗅小球数量、形态和空间组织，以及嗅小球架构内其他解剖信号的相对定位。

items.title_en: Machine Learning the $GW$ Self-Energy Operator for Real Materials
items.title_zh: 机器学习真实材料的 $GW$ 自能算符
items.abstract_en: Machine learning of $GW$ in solids has largely focused on prediction of scalar quasiparticle energy corrections. Here, we introduce a phase-aware many-body transformer that predicts the full $\mathbf{k}$-resolved complex self-energy matrix. As a proof of principle, we apply the model to predict quasiparticle energies before and after diagonalization of the quasiparticle Hamiltonian, obtaining a test set mean absolute error (MAE) of 29 meV for a dataset of 1745 2D materials in the static COHSEX approximation and 60 meV for a more limited dataset of 433 materials calculated within a plasmon-pole model. COHSEX pretraining followed by finetuning reduces this MAE to 42 meV. The predicted matrices also accurately reproduce QP wavefunctions.
items.abstract_zh: 固体中 $GW$ 的机器学习主要集中于预测标量准粒子能量修正。在此，我们引入一种相位感知的多体 transformer，用于预测完整的 $\mathbf{k}$ 分辨复自能矩阵。作为原理验证，我们应用该模型预测准粒子哈密顿量对角化前后的准粒子能量，在静态 COHSEX 近似下的 1745 种二维材料数据集上获得测试集平均绝对误差（MAE）为 29 meV，在等离激元极点模型下计算的 433 种材料这一更有限数据集上为 60 meV。先进行 COHSEX 预训练再微调可将该 MAE 降至 42 meV。预测矩阵还能准确重现 QP 波函数。

items.title_en: artist: A Python package for differentiable ray tracing and gradient-based optimization of solar tower power plant operation
items.title_zh: artist：用于可微光线追踪和太阳能塔式电站运行梯度优化的 Python 包
items.abstract_en: Solar tower power plants provide dispatchable, renewable energy by concentrating sunlight with thousands of mirrors, called heliostats, onto a central receiver. Efficient operation requires accurate modeling of the optical path from each heliostat to the receiver and compensation for manufacturing imperfections, kinematic misalignment, and material degradation that distort the flux distribution. Conventional ray tracers predict the flux from an assumed plant model but are limited to forward simulation. They cannot recover unknown plant parameters from measured flux nor directly optimize plant operation. We present artist, an open-source, FAIR4RS-compliant Python package implementing a fully differentiable digital twin of solar tower power plants. By making the optical pipeline, comprising heliostat surface representation, kinematics, blocking, and ray tracing, end to end differentiable, artist turns the digital twin from a passive forward model into an active physics-based tool for inverse modeling and data-driven optimization. The resulting gradient-based framework unifies tasks usually handled by separate solutions, such as reconstructing heliostat surfaces and kinematics from operational flux images without costly deflectometry, predicting irradiance at the receiver, and optimizing aim points to realize a desired receiver flux density distribution. Built on PyTorch, artist scales to real plants through GPU acceleration, a structure-of-arrays memory layout, and nested data parallelism. It interfaces with open data sources such as the PAINT database. We describe the software architecture, physical models, and optimization framework, and demonstrate the workflow on representative tasks. By integrating modeling, prediction, and optimization into a single open, interpretable package, artist provides a principled foundation for data-driven research toward autonomous solar tower operation.
items.abstract_zh: 太阳能塔式电站通过数千面称为定日镜的镜子将阳光聚集到中央接收器上，提供可调度的可再生能源。高效运行需要准确建模从每个定日镜到接收器的光路，并补偿制造缺陷、运动学失准和材料退化对通量分布的扭曲。传统光线追踪器从假设的电站模型预测通量，但仅限于前向模拟。它们既无法从测量通量反演未知的电站参数，也无法直接优化电站运行。我们提出 artist，一个开源、符合 FAIR4RS 的 Python 包，实现太阳能塔式电站的完全可微数字孪生。通过使光学管线（包括定日镜表面表示、运动学、遮挡和光线追踪）端到端可微，artist 将数字孪生从被动的正向模型转变为用于逆向建模和数据驱动优化的主动物理工具。由此得到的基于梯度的框架统一了通常由不同解决方案处理的任务，例如无需昂贵的偏折测量即可从运行通量图像重建定日镜表面和运动学、预测接收器处辐照度，以及优化瞄准点以实现期望的接收器通量密度分布。artist 基于 PyTorch 构建，通过 GPU 加速、结构数组内存布局和嵌套数据并行扩展到真实电站。它与 PAINT 数据库等开放数据源接口。我们描述软件架构、物理模型和优化框架，并在代表性任务上演示工作流程。通过将建模、预测和优化集成到一个开放、可解释的单一软件包中，artist 为面向自主太阳能塔式运行的数据驱动研究提供了有原则的基础。

items.title_en: GPRM: Global Perspective Process Reward Model
items.title_zh: GPRM：全局视角过程奖励模型
items.abstract_en: Process Reward Models (PRMs) are widely used for step-level evaluation of multi-step reasoning in large language models, but existing methods are often limited by weak historical dependency modeling and insufficient global awareness. They typically fail to leverage prior step evaluations for coherent judgment and lack visibility into subsequent reasoning, leading to suboptimal assessment of intermediate steps. To address this issue, we propose the Global Perspective Process Reward Model (GPRM), which jointly models the problem, previous reasoning steps and their evaluations, the current step, and future steps to enable history-aware and globally informed process evaluation. We further introduce a structured evaluation framework along four dimensions---look back, look ahead, self-check, and goal alignment---to assess prior consistency, future plausibility, step validity, and task alignment. Based on this framework, we construct datasets for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (GRPO). Experiments show that, despite using less training data and smaller model sizes, GPRM outperforms strong baseline models by 7.8 and 5.4 points on PRMBench and ProcessBench, respectively. GPRM also generalizes well across tasks, surpassing the GPT-4.1 baseline on Agent Error Bench, improving strong baselines by around 4 points under test-time scaling (TTS), and achieving competitive performance on PPE.
items.abstract_zh: 过程奖励模型（PRM）广泛用于大语言模型多步推理的步骤级评估，但现有方法常受限于历史依赖建模薄弱和全局意识不足。它们通常无法利用先前步骤的评估进行连贯判断，也缺乏对后续推理的可见性，导致对中间步骤的评估次优。为解决此问题，我们提出全局视角过程奖励模型（GPRM），联合建模问题、先前推理步骤及其评估、当前步骤和未来步骤，以实现历史感知和全局知情的过程评估。我们进一步引入沿四个维度——回看、前瞻、自查和目标对齐——的结构化评估框架，以评估先前一致性、未来合理性、步骤有效性和任务对齐。基于该框架，我们构建用于监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（GRPO）的数据集。实验表明，尽管使用更少训练数据和更小模型规模，GPRM 在 PRMBench 和 ProcessBench 上分别比强基线模型高出 7.8 和 5.4 分。GPRM 还具有良好的跨任务泛化能力，在 Agent Error Bench 上超过 GPT-4.1 基线，在测试时扩展（TTS）下将强基线提升约 4 分，并在 PPE 上取得有竞争力的性能。

items.title_en: OrthoMark: Place Recognition with Point-Anchored Orthographic Height Mark
items.title_zh: OrthoMark：基于点锚定正交高度标记的位置识别
items.abstract_en: LiDAR place recognition provides the loop closures of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping(SLAM). Perspective from Z-axis, a gravity-aligned scan is an orthographic map of the scene, and a revisit from another position and heading moves this map rigidly in the plane, a motion that a polar Fourier spectrum ignores and phase correlation recovers. Along the vertical, the heights of the returns describe the structures, but which heights are observed depends on the range, because the sensor's vertical field of view cuts nearby structures low; height thus misleads a global key, yet is decisive once two scans are aligned and compared cell by cell where they overlap. We present \method, a training-free method built on one principle: two LiDAR scans can only be compared through features computed from the same geometric surfaces in both scans. \method retrieves candidates with a translation- and rotation-invariant polar spectrum of the bird's-eye view (BEV), 1.9,KB per keyframe, and verifies each candidate by estimating its planar pose through phase correlation and scoring it with \emph{point-anchored height columns}: every BEV cell keeps a 16-bit mask of the heights of its own returns; within a session, the score is weighted by the expected overlap of the two scans' sensing ranges, computed from their distance. We show that this vertical link pays off in verification but hurts in retrieval, where what a height slice contains depends on the range to the structure. For single robot, \method has the highest AP of the training-free methods without 3D registration on the KITTI development sequences; across robots, on all multi-robot sequences, it matches or exceeds RING++ at 1/350 of its descriptor size and closes more inter-robot loops than the learned BEVPlace++ on all tests.
items.abstract_zh: LiDAR 位置识别为同步定位与建图（SLAM）提供回环检测。从 Z 轴视角看，重力对齐的扫描是场景的正交地图，而来自另一位置和朝向的重访使该地图在平面内刚性移动，这种运动被极坐标傅里叶谱忽略，而相位相关可恢复它。沿垂直方向，返回点的高度描述结构，但观察到哪些高度取决于距离，因为传感器的垂直视场会截断附近结构的高度；因此高度会误导全局键，但一旦两次扫描对齐并在重叠处逐单元比较，高度就具有决定性。我们提出 OrthoMark，一种基于一个原则的无训练方法：两次 LiDAR 扫描只能通过由两次扫描中相同几何表面计算的特征进行比较。OrthoMark 使用鸟瞰图（BEV）的平移和旋转不变极坐标谱检索候选，每个关键帧 1.9 KB，并通过相位相关估计每个候选的平面位姿，再用点锚定高度柱对其评分来进行验证：每个 BEV 单元保留其自身返回点高度的 16 位掩码；在单次会话内，评分由两次扫描感知范围的预期重叠加权，该重叠由其距离计算。我们表明，这种垂直联系在验证中有益，但在检索中有害，因为高度切片包含的内容取决于到结构的距离。对于单机器人，OrthoMark 在 KITTI 开发序列上在无 3D 配准的无训练方法中具有最高 AP；跨机器人时，在所有多机器人序列上，它以描述子大小 1/350 的代价匹配或超过 RING++，并且在所有测试中比学习型 BEVPlace++ 闭合更多机器人间回环。

items.title_en: Power Line Detection in Point Clouds with Point-SAM and RANSAC
items.title_zh: 基于Point-SAM和RANSAC的点云电力线检测
items.abstract_en: This article deals with the problem of detecting the position of power lines in airborne laser scanning point clouds. We address both the problem of segmenting power lines from background like ground and vegetation and of identifying individual lines. For segmentation we compare a rule-based approach with one based on transfer learning (Point-SAM). For individual line detection, we derive the mathematical formulas for RANSAC applied to 3D catenaries and compare it with a non-parametric method (TriplClust). All methods are evaluated on a newly created dataset "PowLiDFR", which we make publicly available. The samples have been taken from the French project LiDAR HD and cover a variety of terrain layouts and point cloud resolutions. On this dataset, an unsupervised transfer learning outperformed a mere rule-based segmentation, and for individual power line detection, RANSAC was better in following the shape of catenaries than the non-parametric algorithm.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究机载激光扫描点云中电力线位置的检测问题。我们同时处理从地面和植被等背景中分割电力线以及识别单条电力线这两个问题。在分割方面，我们比较了基于规则的方法与基于迁移学习（Point-SAM）的方法。在单条电力线检测方面，我们推导了将RANSAC应用于三维悬链线的数学公式，并将其与非参数方法（TriplClust）进行比较。所有方法均在我们新建并公开提供的数据集“PowLiDFR”上进行评估。样本取自法国LiDAR HD项目，覆盖多种地形布局和点云分辨率。在该数据集上，无监督迁移学习优于单纯的基于规则的分割；在单条电力线检测方面，RANSAC在跟随悬链线形状方面优于非参数算法。

items.title_en: Reduced Resting Brain Entropy and Structural-Functional Reorganization in Hearing Loss
items.title_zh: 听力损失中静息脑熵降低及结构-功能重组
items.abstract_en: Hearing loss changes how the brain processes sound, yet how chronic auditory degradation shapes the temporal organization of spontaneous cortical activity remains unclear. We examined this question using multimodal MRI from 52 adults with age-related hearing loss and 30 normal-hearing controls. Guided by convergent neuroimaging evidence, we focused on the superior temporal gyrus (STG) and assessed brain entropy (BEN), complementary resting-state measures, and gray matter volume (GMV). Hearing loss was associated with lower BEN in a focal right-STG cluster after adjustment for local GMV (14 voxels; cluster FWER p = 0.008), consistent with more recurrent BOLD signal patterns. Six complementary measures of signal amplitude, local synchrony, symbolic sequence diversity, successive variation, and temporal persistence showed no corrected STG differences. A separate whole-brain analysis revealed higher bilateral midcingulate cortex (MCC) GMV (FWE p = 0.002 and 0.015), motivating examination of the auditory-cingulate relationship. The BEN-defined STG region showed stronger focal functional connectivity with MCC (FWE p = 0.031). Exploratory analyses suggested weaker directed STG-to-MCC influence alongside a small tractography-derived group difference. Exploratory directional comparisons indicated stronger right-MCC GMV-BEN coupling (p = 0.034) and STG-MCC SC-FC coupling (p = 0.037) in controls than in hearing loss. Together, these findings link greater temporal regularity in auditory association cortex to altered auditory-cingulate coordination and local structure-function correspondence, suggesting that adaptation to hearing loss involves both the organization of spontaneous cortical dynamics and their relationship to brain structure.
items.abstract_zh: 听力损失改变大脑处理声音的方式，但慢性听觉退化如何塑造自发皮层活动的时间组织仍不清楚。我们利用52名年龄相关性听力损失成人和30名听力正常对照的多模态MRI研究这一问题。在汇聚的神经影像证据指导下，我们聚焦于颞上回（STG），并评估脑熵（BEN）、补充性静息态指标和灰质体积（GMV）。在调整局部GMV后，听力损失与右侧STG一个局灶簇中较低的BEN相关（14个体素；簇FWER p = 0.008），这与更重复的BOLD信号模式一致。信号幅度、局部同步性、符号序列多样性、连续变化和时间持续性这六项补充指标未显示校正后的STG差异。单独的全脑分析显示双侧中扣带回皮层（MCC）GMV更高（FWE p = 0.002和0.015），这促使我们检查听觉-扣带关系。由BEN定义的STG区域与MCC表现出更强的局灶功能连接（FWE p = 0.031）。探索性分析提示STG到MCC的定向影响较弱，同时存在小的纤维束成像衍生组间差异。探索性方向性比较表明，对照组中右侧MCC的GMV-BEN耦合（p = 0.034）和STG-MCC的SC-FC耦合（p = 0.037）强于听力损失组。总体而言，这些发现将听觉联合皮层中更大的时间规律性与改变的听觉-扣带协调及局部结构-功能对应联系起来，提示对听力损失的适应既涉及自发皮层动态的组织，也涉及它们与脑结构的关系。

items.title_en: Porosification of the dielectric layer in alternating-current electroluminescence devices enables high-resolution tactile imaging
items.title_zh: 交流电致发光器件介电层的多孔化实现高分辨率触觉成像
items.abstract_en: Vision-based tactile sensing enables high-resolution contact perception, yet bulky optical architectures consume valuable space and constrain the functional design of dexterous robotic hands. Here we introduce a self-emissive tactile imaging strategy based on alternating-current electroluminescence (ACEL) devices, in which a compressible porous dielectric encodes contact pressure into spatial emission patterns without external illumination or discrete sensing pixels. We identify a nonlinear capacitance-dependent emission window that provides a basis for tunable pressure-to-light conversion. Pore-size engineering further suppresses local emission deficiencies, reducing spatial intensity variation by nearly ninefold and enabling faithful imaging of contact features down to 100 μm. The continuous electroluminescent interface also reproduces complex contact patterns without computational reconstruction of electrical fields. Direct lamination of the ACEL device onto a complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) image sensor is expected to enable compact contact imaging in an assembly less than 5 mm thick, substantially thinner than conventional vision-based tactile sensors. This approach could reduce the space required for high-resolution tactile imaging, offering greater design freedom for dexterous robotic hands.
items.abstract_zh: 基于视觉的触觉传感能够实现高分辨率接触感知，但笨重的光学架构消耗宝贵空间，并限制灵巧机械手的功能设计。在此，我们提出一种基于交流电致发光（ACEL）器件的自发光触觉成像策略，其中可压缩的多孔介电层将接触压力编码为空间发光图案，无需外部照明或离散传感像素。我们识别出一个非线性电容依赖的发光窗口，为可调的压力-光转换提供了基础。孔径工程进一步抑制局部发光缺陷，使空间强度变化降低近九倍，并能够对低至100 μm的接触特征进行忠实成像。连续电致发光界面还能复现复杂接触图案，而无需对电场进行计算重建。将ACEL器件直接贴合到互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）图像传感器上，有望在厚度小于5 mm的组件中实现紧凑的接触成像，这比传统基于视觉的触觉传感器薄得多。这种方法可以减少高分辨率触觉成像所需的空间，为灵巧机械手提供更大的设计自由度。

items.title_en: DNA: A Double-Helix Hierarchical Deep Interaction Network Architecture for Industrial Digital Twin
items.title_zh: DNA：面向工业数字孪生的双螺旋分层深度交互网络架构
items.abstract_en: High-fidelity modeling is fundamental to industrial digital twin, yet a trade-off persists between the physical transparency of mechanistic models and the superior predictive power of data-driven approaches. Existing hybrid methods often fail to bridge this gap, suffering from shallow integration and rigid one-shot modeling strategies that struggle with complex industrial systems. To address these issues, we propose a \textbf{Double-Helix Hierarchical Deep Interaction Network Architecture (DNA)}. Inspired by the double-helix structure of biological \textit{DNA}, our architecture intertwines mechanistic and data-driven modeling strands through two novel interaction strategies, forming a symbiotic architecture in which the two strands mutually enhance predictive capability. Furthermore, the hierarchical structure of DNA allows it to model complex systems in a multi-stage manner through two tailored deep learning frameworks. We evaluate the proposed approach on two distinct industrial systems, where DNA achieves reductions in MAE of 3.704\% and 3.175\%, respectively, compared to the strongest baseline. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of DNA and suggest its potential to provide new insights for the development of industrial digital twins.
items.abstract_zh: 高保真建模是工业数字孪生的基础，但机理模型的物理透明性与数据驱动方法的优越预测能力之间仍存在权衡。现有混合方法往往未能弥合这一差距，受限于浅层集成和难以应对复杂工业系统的刚性一次性建模策略。为解决这些问题，我们提出一种双螺旋分层深度交互网络架构（DNA）。受生物DNA双螺旋结构的启发，我们的架构通过两种新颖的交互策略交织机理建模链与数据驱动建模链，形成一种共生架构，其中两条链相互增强预测能力。此外，DNA的分层结构使其能够通过两个定制深度学习框架以多阶段方式对复杂系统建模。我们在两个不同的工业系统上评估所提方法，与最强基线相比，DNA分别使MAE降低3.704%和3.175%。这些结果证明了DNA的有效性，并表明其有望为工业数字孪生的发展提供新见解。

items.title_en: Rank, Don't Regress: A 279M Text Ranker Beats 2B and 7B VLMs on Referential Urdu GUI Grounding
items.title_zh: 排序而非回归：一个279M文本排序器在指代性乌尔都语GUI定位上优于2B和7B VLM
items.abstract_en: UI grounding asks a model to find the screen element that a user instruction refers to. Most current systems use a vision-language model (VLM) that reads a screenshot and outputs pixel coordinates. We study this task on Urdu mobile web pages, a setting with no published UI grounding results. Instead of regressing coordinates, we take the candidate elements from the page DOM and train a 279M-parameter cross-encoder (mDeBERTa-v3-base) to pick one. The click point is the centre of the picked element's box, so it is exact whenever the right element is picked. We built a frozen test set of 304 instructions from six Urdu news sites; 149 of them (49%) are referential and never quote the full target text. Test domains were banned from training data before collection started. The ranker scores 73.4% point-in-box accuracy, against 29.6% for UI-TARS-2B and 23.7% for Qwen2.5-VL-7B, both zero-shot. On the referential slice the ranker scores 65.8%, against 30.2% for a string-matching baseline that needs no training. In a controlled comparison at small scale, with training data drawn from the same pages, a coordinate-regression model of similar size scores 1.6%. Adding element geometry as input tokens gives the best variant, at 75.7%. The ranker's errors concentrate in two places: elements that share identical text, and ordinal instructions such as "the fourth link".
items.abstract_zh: UI定位要求模型找到用户指令所指的屏幕元素。大多数当前系统使用视觉-语言模型（VLM），其读取截图并输出像素坐标。我们在乌尔都语移动网页上研究该任务，这一设置尚无已发表的UI定位结果。我们不回归坐标，而是从页面DOM中获取候选元素，并训练一个279M参数的交叉编码器（mDeBERTa-v3-base）来选择一个元素。点击点是被选中元素框的中心，因此只要选对元素，点击点就是精确的。我们构建了一个由来自六个乌尔都语新闻网站的304条指令组成的冻结测试集；其中149条（49%）是指代性的，且从不引用完整目标文本。测试域在数据收集开始前已被禁止进入训练数据。该排序器取得73.4%的框内点准确率，而UI-TARS-2B为29.6%，Qwen2.5-VL-7B为23.7%，二者均为零样本。在指代性子集上，排序器得分为65.8%，而无需训练的字符串匹配基线为30.2%。在小规模受控比较中，训练数据取自相同页面，类似规模的坐标回归模型得分为1.6%。将元素几何作为输入token加入可获得最佳变体，得分为75.7%。排序器的错误集中在两处：文本相同的元素，以及诸如“第四个链接”之类的序数指令。

items.title_en: Stochastic Self-Distillation for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
items.title_zh: 面向基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型的随机自蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in robotics through imitation learning, yet fine-tuning them with on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is limited. In group-based RL methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), every rollout step requires multi-step ODE integration, and the sampler's limited stochasticity leads to rollout groups with low variance. We propose VLA-SSD, which addresses both high inference latency and limited stochasticity. In particular, our method self-distills a pretrained flow-matching action head into a stochastic one-step policy by conditioning a single-jump generator on a Brownian path. We derive a conditional action density via our stochastic one-step policy, enabling efficient post-training via likelihood-ratio RL algorithms. We show that distilling VLA-SSD from the $π_0$ VLA reduces the action head's forward-pass time by a factor of 7.7, at the cost of a 5.5% relative decrease in the success rate on the LIBERO benchmark. However, by leveraging the increased sample diversity of VLA-SSD during group generation, post-training a $π_{0.5}$ VLA using GRPO yields a 20.6% relative improvement.
items.abstract_zh: 基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过模仿学习在机器人领域取得强性能，但用同策略强化学习（RL）对其进行微调仍受限。在Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）等基于组的RL方法中，每个rollout步骤都需要多步ODE积分，而采样器有限的随机性导致rollout组方差低。我们提出VLA-SSD，同时解决高推理延迟和有限随机性问题。具体而言，我们的方法通过将单跳生成器以布朗路径为条件，将预训练的流匹配动作头自蒸馏为随机一步策略。我们通过随机一步策略推导条件动作密度，从而能够通过似然比RL算法进行高效后训练。我们表明，从π0 VLA蒸馏出VLA-SSD可将动作头的前向传播时间减少7.7倍，代价是在LIBERO基准上的成功率相对下降5.5%。然而，利用VLA-SSD在组生成期间增加的样本多样性，使用GRPO对π0.5 VLA进行后训练可带来20.6%的相对提升。

items.title_en: The Mask Is Not the Object: Volumetric Supervision for 3D Gaussian Segmentation
items.title_zh: 掩码并非对象：面向3D高斯分割的体积监督
items.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting enables object-level operations on Gaussian primitives, yet existing segmentation methods are largely trained and evaluated through rendered views. This mismatch can produce accurate rendered masks from incomplete 3D selections since alpha-blended feature supervision concentrates learning on dominant contributors while leaving occluded or low-contribution Gaussians weakly supervised. We propose VODA, a plug-and-play supervision objective that exploits local depth structure to group per-pixel contributors and directly supervises all Gaussians in selected depth clusters, bypassing contribution-weighted gradient delivery. To evaluate volumetric completeness, we introduce Removal-3D, a synthetic object-removal benchmark, and the Removal Depth Error (RDE), a metric comparing predicted and ground-truth depth changes. Across four rendering-based baselines, VODA consistently improves volumetric segmentation on Removal-3D while maintaining or improving performance on LERF and ScanNet. Further analysis shows that VODA recovers lower-contribution Gaussians, while simple gradient reweighting and spatial propagation fail to reproduce comparable gains.
items.abstract_zh: 3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）使高斯基元上的对象级操作成为可能，但现有分割方法大多通过渲染视图进行训练和评估。这种不匹配可能由不完整的三维选择产生准确的渲染掩码，因为alpha混合的特征监督将学习集中在主要贡献者上，而使被遮挡或低贡献的高斯仅得到弱监督。我们提出VODA，一种即插即用的监督目标，利用局部深度结构对逐像素贡献者进行分组，并直接监督所选深度簇中的所有高斯，绕过按贡献加权的梯度传递。为评估体积完整性，我们引入Removal-3D，一个合成对象移除基准，以及移除深度误差（Removal Depth Error，RDE），一种比较预测深度变化与真实深度变化的指标。在四个基于渲染的基线方法上，VODA在Removal-3D上持续改进体积分割，同时在LERF和ScanNet上保持或提升性能。进一步分析表明，VODA能恢复较低贡献的高斯，而简单的梯度重加权和空间传播无法复现相当的增益。

items.title_en: Casanovo-TMT: deep learning-based de novo sequencing of TMTpro-labeled peptides and phosphopeptides
items.title_zh: Casanovo-TMT：基于深度学习的TMTpro标记肽段和磷酸化肽段的从头测序
items.abstract_en: De novo peptide sequencing reads peptides directly from tandem mass spectra, but none of the released deep learning models can sequence peptides labeled with isobaric tags such as TMTpro, which are widely used for multiplexed quantitative proteomics. We extended the residue vocabulary of Casanovo with TMTpro tags and phosphorylation, fine-tuned it on 21 million spectra from our laboratory, most of them TMTpro-labeled, and re-ranked the candidates in the beam by their agreement with the measured precursor mass. The resulting model, Casanovo-TMT, predicted the exact peptidoform for 84.7% of the TMTpro-labeled spectra in our test set and for 87.4 and 79.6% of the spectra in two public global-proteome datasets from other laboratories, whereas the extended vocabulary without fine-tuning gave 0.3%. Discarding the lowest-scoring predictions raised precision to 95% while retaining 81.7% of the test spectra. Casanovo-TMT also predicted the exact peptidoform for 69.2% of the spectra in a public phosphopeptide-enriched dataset and for 66 to 72% of the phosphopeptide spectra in three phosphoproteomic studies from our laboratory that were not used for training. In these studies, it identified numbers of phosphopeptides comparable to or larger than those of database search engines, and proportionally more where database search identified fewer. For the phosphopeptides identified only by Casanovo-TMT, entrapment estimated that more than 90% were correct, and an independent search engine assigned the same sequence to 95 to 98% of the spectra that it identified with confidence. Casanovo-TMT can therefore extend database search in TMTpro-based quantitative proteomics, particularly in studies in which database search identifies few phosphopeptides.
items.abstract_zh: 从头肽段测序可直接从串联质谱中读取肽段，但已发布的深度学习模型均无法对使用TMTpro等同量异位标签标记的肽段进行测序，而此类标签广泛用于多重定量蛋白质组学。我们将Casanovo的残基词表扩展至包含TMTpro标签和磷酸化，在本实验室的2100万张谱图上对其进行微调（其中大多数为TMTpro标记），并根据候选与实测母离子质量的一致性对beam中的候选重新排序。所得模型Casanovo-TMT在我们的测试集中对84.7%的TMTpro标记谱图预测出精确的肽段形式，在来自其他实验室的两个公共全蛋白质组数据集中分别对87.4%和79.6%的谱图预测出精确肽段形式，而未微调的扩展词表仅为0.3%。丢弃评分最低的预测可将精确率提高到95%，同时保留81.7%的测试谱图。Casanovo-TMT还对公共磷酸化肽段富集数据集中69.2%的谱图，以及本实验室未用于训练的三项磷酸化蛋白质组研究中66%至72%的磷酸化肽段谱图，预测出精确肽段形式。在这些研究中，其鉴定到的磷酸化肽段数量与数据库搜索引擎相当或更多，并且在数据库搜索鉴定较少的情况下，相对鉴定更多。对于仅由Casanovo-TMT鉴定的磷酸化肽段，诱捕法估计超过90%是正确的，并且独立搜索引擎对其有把握鉴定的谱图中95%至98%给出了相同序列。因此，Casanovo-TMT可在基于TMTpro的定量蛋白质组学中扩展数据库搜索，尤其是在数据库搜索鉴定到的磷酸化肽段很少的研究中。

items.title_en: Advancing Quantum Reinforcement Learning with Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search and Adaptive Non-local Observables
items.title_zh: 利用可微量子架构搜索和自适应非局域可观测量推进量子强化学习
items.abstract_en: Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL) using variational quantum circuits (VQCs) is constrained by fixed measurement protocols and hand-designed circuit ansätze. Adaptive Non-local Observables (ANO) and Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search (DiffQAS) address these issues independently, but to our knowledge have not been combined or compared in a single QRL framework. We present an ablation of ANO and DiffQAS within the Quantum Time-series Transformer (QTSTransformer), evaluated on a 2 x 2 factorial design across six environments--two classic-control tasks and four Atari 2600 games. Three findings emerge. First, the quantum agent outperforms a matched classical transformer baseline on five of six environments, with absolute scores ranging from 360.0 vs 304.0 (MarioBros) to 17.2 vs 2.5 (Breakout), while using approximately 12.5x fewer transformer parameters on the four Atari environments (more modestly so on the two classic-control tasks). Second, ANO and DiffQAS provide complementary benefits: ANO yields the largest gain on continuous-state CartPole (347.7 vs 223.2), while DiffQAS yields the largest absolute Atari gains (Breakout 17.2 vs 3.0; DonkeyKong 70.0 vs 37.0). Third, combining both innovations exhibits an asymmetric interaction: ANO-dominant tasks tolerate DiffQAS, whereas DiffQAS-dominant tasks degrade when ANO is added. These results provide design guidance for QRL agents: select between ANO and DiffQAS according to whether the bottleneck is the measurement basis or the gate topology, rather than applying both indiscriminately.
items.abstract_zh: 使用变分量子电路（VQC）的量子强化学习（QRL）受限于固定的测量协议和手工设计的电路拟设。自适应非局域可观测量（ANO）和可微量子架构搜索（DiffQAS）分别独立地解决这些问题，但据我们所知，尚未在单一QRL框架中结合或比较。我们在量子时间序列Transformer（QTSTransformer）中对ANO和DiffQAS进行消融，采用2×2析因设计在六个环境中评估——两个经典控制任务和四个Atari 2600游戏。得到三项发现。第一，量子智能体在六个环境中的五个上优于匹配的经典Transformer基线，绝对得分为360.0对304.0（MarioBros）至17.2对2.5（Breakout），同时在四个Atari环境上使用的Transformer参数量约少12.5倍（在两个经典控制任务上减少幅度更小）。第二，ANO和DiffQAS提供互补收益：ANO在连续状态CartPole上带来最大增益（347.7对223.2），而DiffQAS在Atari上带来最大绝对增益（Breakout 17.2对3.0；DonkeyKong 70.0对37.0）。第三，结合两项创新表现出非对称交互：以ANO为主的任务可容忍DiffQAS，而以DiffQAS为主的任务在加入ANO时性能下降。这些结果为QRL智能体提供设计指导：应根据瓶颈是测量基还是门拓扑来选择ANO或DiffQAS，而不是不加区分地同时应用两者。
