items.title_en: Fuzzy Explainable Continual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Navigation
items.title_zh: 面向机器人导航的模糊可解释持续分层强化学习
items.abstract_en: Continual robot navigation requires reinforcement learning policies to continuously adapt to new environments while retaining previously acquired knowledge. Meanwhile, explainable reinforcement learning aims to learn meaningful behavioral representations through policy interaction. However, these objectives are inherently conflicting, as continual learning emphasizes policy stability whereas explainable behavior learning requires adaptive exploration. Existing methods rarely address both simultaneously. To resolve this issue, this paper proposes a Fuzzy Explainable Continual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (FECHRL) method. A two-stage behavior cloning strategy is introduced to balance rapid policy adaptation and explainable behavior evolution by progressively transitioning from strong imitation guidance to autonomous reinforcement learning. Furthermore, a fuzzy critic based on a Takagi--Sugeno fuzzy inference system is proposed to alleviate value extrapolation errors during the transition between imitation-guided learning and autonomous exploration, thereby improving continual training stability. Experimental results on sequential multi-scenario navigation tasks demonstrate that the proposed method effectively unifies continual learning capability and policy explainability within a single reinforcement learning framework, achieving stable knowledge retention and meaningful behavioral explanation.
items.abstract_zh: 持续机器人导航要求强化学习策略在保留先前获得知识的同时持续适应新环境。同时，可解释强化学习旨在通过策略交互学习有意义的行为表示。然而，这些目标本质上是冲突的，因为持续学习强调策略稳定性，而可解释行为学习需要自适应探索。现有方法很少同时处理两者。为解决该问题，本文提出一种模糊可解释持续分层强化学习（FECHRL）方法。引入两阶段行为克隆策略，通过从强模仿引导逐步过渡到自主强化学习，平衡快速策略适应与可解释行为演化。此外，提出一种基于Takagi–Sugeno模糊推理系统的模糊评论家，以缓解模仿引导学习与自主探索之间过渡期间的价值外推误差，从而提高持续训练的稳定性。在序列多场景导航任务上的实验结果表明，所提方法在单一强化学习框架内有效统一了持续学习能力与策略可解释性，实现了稳定的知识保留和有意义的的行为解释。

items.title_en: FRAAC: A French Multimodal Large Language Model and Dataset forPictogram-Based Augmentative and Alternative Communication
items.title_zh: FRAAC：面向基于图标的辅助与替代交流的法语多模态大语言模型和数据集
items.abstract_en: Pictograms are a core modality in augmentative and alternative communication (AAC), yet recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) cannot reliably interpret or produce pictogram sequences. Two obstacles explain this gap: the absence of a standardized pictogram grammar and the scarcity of parallel text-pictogram data. We introduce Retrieval-Augmented Pictogram Selection (RAPS), an annotation method that refines a rule-based transcription system's output with LLM-based concept extraction and retrieval over a pictogram vocabulary, handling cases where hand-written rules fail (named entities, numbers, polysemous words) without requiring new rules. Applied to French, RAPS yields a synthetic corpus of 1.4 million parallel pairs, of which 300k are publicly released. In a human ranking study where annotators order four pictogram transcriptions of the same sentence, RAPS outperforms the rule-based state of the art. Moreover, we show that standard reference-based metrics separate systems of clearly different quality but fail to rank strong systems against each other. Finally, we build an instruction-tuned model that supports interaction in several AAC modalities: it accepts pictogram or text input and answers in pictograms, speech, or text.
items.abstract_zh: 图标是辅助与替代交流（AAC）中的核心模态，但近期多模态大语言模型（MLLM）无法可靠地解释或生成图标序列。两个障碍解释了这一差距：缺乏标准化的图标语法，以及文本—图标平行数据稀缺。我们引入检索增强图标选择（RAPS），一种标注方法，通过基于LLM的概念提取和在图标词表上的检索来改进基于规则的转写系统的输出，处理手写规则失效的情况（命名实体、数字、多义词），且无需新规则。应用于法语，RAPS生成包含140万平行对的合成语料，其中30万对公开发布。在人工排序研究中，标注员对同一句子的四个图标转写进行排序，RAPS优于基于规则的当前最佳方法。此外，我们表明标准基于参考的指标能区分质量明显不同的系统，但无法在强系统之间相互排序。最后，我们构建了一个指令微调模型，支持多种AAC模态的交互：它接受图标或文本输入，并以图标、语音或文本作答。

items.title_en: NF-VLA: A Normalizing-Flow Baseline for Vision-Language-Action Learning
items.title_zh: NF-VLA：视觉-语言-动作学习的归一化流基线
items.abstract_en: Autoregressive normalizing flows (NFs) provide a tractable density for learning and sampling continuous robot actions. We show that a single maximum-likelihood objective can train vision--language--action (VLA) policies competitive with leading methods on manipulation benchmarks. We present NF-VLA, which combines conditional autoregressive normalizing flows with score-based action refinement. Its deep--shallow architecture concentrates visual, language, and proprioceptive prefix conditioning in a high-capacity deep block, while unconditioned shallow blocks provide a shared invertible action transformation. The vision--language backbone and flow are jointly trained by exact maximum likelihood on Gaussian-smoothed action chunks. The same learned density supplies a single score-based correction at inference, refining generated actions to account for training-time smoothing without a separately trained denoiser. Trained on LIBERO from a pretrained vision--language backbone without robot pretraining, NF-VLA achieves 98.35\% success across the four standard suites and 72.6\% on LIBERO-Plus using the same checkpoint without further fine-tuning. Ablations show that deep-only prefix conditioning and score-based refinement both improve closed-loop success. Together, these results establish carefully structured autoregressive flows as a competitive approach to VLA control, with one learned density supporting policy training, action generation, and refinement.
items.abstract_zh: 自回归归一化流（NF）为学习和采样连续机器人动作提供可处理的密度。我们表明，单一最大似然目标可训练出在操作基准上与领先方法具有竞争力的视觉—语言—动作（VLA）策略。我们提出NF-VLA，将条件自回归归一化流与基于分数的动作细化相结合。其深—浅架构将视觉、语言和本体感受前缀条件集中在高容量深层块中，而无条件浅层块提供共享的可逆动作变换。视觉—语言骨干网络和流通过对高斯平滑动作块进行精确最大似然联合训练。同一学习到的密度在推理时提供单次基于分数的校正，细化生成的动作以考虑训练时平滑，而无需单独训练的去噪器。在LIBERO上从预训练视觉—语言骨干网络训练且未进行机器人预训练，NF-VLA在四个标准套件上达到98.35%的成功率，并在LIBERO-Plus上使用同一检查点且无需进一步微调达到72.6%。消融表明，仅深层前缀条件和基于分数的细化均提高闭环成功率。总之，这些结果确立了精心构建的自回归流作为VLA控制的一种有竞争力方法，其单一学习密度支持策略训练、动作生成和细化。

items.title_en: Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating
items.title_zh: Déjà-Events：基于稀疏感知自适应门控的事件相机多视图3D几何
items.abstract_en: Event cameras keep capturing structure where conventional cameras blur or saturate, which makes them attractive for 3D perception in fast or poorly lit scenes. Event datasets with dense 3D ground truth, however, are far smaller and less diverse than the image collections behind feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. We present Déjà-Events, an event-only model that predicts depth, camera pose and pointmaps from multiple views in a single forward pass. Rather than relying on scarce 3D labels, we distil it from Déjà View, a feed-forward RGB model that refines its tokens by repeatedly applying one shared transformer block. On paired RGB and event recordings, the event student learns to reproduce the frozen teacher's final tokens, which requires no depth or pose ground truth and trains only about 1% of its parameters. Because events are dense at edges and moving texture but nearly absent in textureless regions, we further introduce sparsity-aware adaptive gating, which adapts the shared block's gates to events and adjusts them per patch by event density, so that accuracy holds as refinement steps are added. Trained only on simulated data, Déjà-Events achieves the lowest pointmap error among the event-based methods we evaluate, on EventScape and zero-shot on the real MVSEC and DSEC datasets. On DSEC it halves the error of the strongest baseline (0.15 vs. 0.30 AbsRel) with about a tenth of its parameters. It also has the lowest depth error on EventScape and DSEC and the lowest trajectory error on EventScape.
items.abstract_zh: 事件相机能在传统相机模糊或饱和的场景中持续捕捉结构，这使其在快速运动或光照不良场景中的3D感知具有吸引力。然而，具有密集3D真值的事件数据集远小于且多样性远低于前馈3D重建模型背后的图像集合。我们提出Déjà-Events，一种仅使用事件的模型，可在单次前向传播中从多视图预测深度、相机位姿和点图。它不依赖稀缺的3D标签，而是从Déjà View蒸馏而来；Déjà View是一种前馈RGB模型，通过重复应用一个共享Transformer块来细化其令牌。在配对的RGB和事件记录上，事件学生模型学习复现冻结教师模型的最终令牌，这不需要深度或位姿真值，且仅训练约1%的参数。由于事件在边缘和运动纹理处密集，而在无纹理区域几乎缺失，我们进一步引入稀疏感知自适应门控，使共享块的门控适应事件，并根据事件密度逐块调整，从而在增加细化步骤时仍保持精度。仅在模拟数据上训练，Déjà-Events在我们评估的基于事件的方法中取得最低的点图误差：在EventScape上，并在真实的MVSEC和DSEC数据集上零样本取得。在DSEC上，它以约十分之一的参数量将最强基线的误差减半（0.15 vs. 0.30 AbsRel）。它在EventScape和DSEC上还具有最低的深度误差，并在EventScape上具有最低的轨迹误差。

items.title_en: Gene-scale DNA and chromatin ensembles with atomic resolution
items.title_zh: 原子分辨率的基因尺度DNA与染色质系综
items.abstract_en: The spatial organization of cellular DNA extends across a wide range of scales, from sequence-dependent base pairing to the packaging of meter-long cellular DNA into micron-size nuclei. Integrating the information from disparate experiments, molecular simulations, and theoretical models into a coherent picture of DNA and chromatin organization across scales remains challenging. Here, we introduce hierarchical chain growth for DNA (HCG-DNA) to build atomically detailed ensembles of double-stranded DNA and chromatin. Starting from complete tetranucleotide fragment libraries encoding local sequence-dependent conformations, we assemble structures of DNA up to the megabase scale at quasilinear computational cost. From HCG-DNA, the large-scale polymer elastic properties emerge, in particular the persistence length. HCG-DNA recovers electron spin resonance, atomic force microscopy, and single-molecule force spectroscopy measurements of DNA structure across scales. HCG-DNA includes nucleosomes to generate 3D atomistic chromatin ensembles constrained by cryo-electron tomography or genomic nucleosome maps. With HCG-DNA, we show how small changes in nucleosome linker length alter nucleosome packing and chromatin compaction. HCG-DNA connects atomic-level DNA and nucleosome structure to chromosome-scale spatial organization, while providing scalable ensembles for coarse-grained model development and AI training.
items.abstract_zh: 细胞DNA的空间组织跨越广泛尺度，从序列依赖的碱基配对到将米长的细胞DNA包装进微米大小的细胞核。将来自不同实验、分子模拟和理论模型的信息整合为跨尺度DNA和染色质组织的连贯图景仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们引入DNA分层链生长（HCG-DNA），以构建双链DNA和染色质的原子细节系综。从编码局部序列依赖构象的完整四核苷酸片段库出发，我们以准线性计算成本组装高达兆碱基尺度的DNA结构。从HCG-DNA中涌现出大尺度聚合物弹性性质，特别是持续长度。HCG-DNA重现了电子自旋共振、原子力显微镜和单分子力谱对跨尺度DNA结构的测量。HCG-DNA包含核小体，以生成受冷冻电子断层扫描或基因组核小体图谱约束的3D原子级染色质系综。利用HCG-DNA，我们展示了核小体连接长度的小变化如何改变核小体堆积和染色质压缩。HCG-DNA将原子级DNA和核小体结构与染色体尺度空间组织联系起来，同时为粗粒化模型开发和AI训练提供可扩展的系综。

items.title_en: Machine-learned active spaces enable quantum calculations of spin-state energetics of transition-metal complexes on quantum hardware
items.title_zh: 机器学习活性空间使过渡金属配合物自旋态能量学可在量子硬件上进行量子计算
items.abstract_en: Multireference calculations on transition-metal complexes, on classical or quantum hardware, depend on the choice of active space. The orbitals that belong in it are those that are strongly entangled in the correlated wavefunction, but measuring this entanglement requires the very correlated calculation that the active space is meant to make affordable. Here we present SpinAware, a machine-learning model that predicts density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) single-orbital entropies and orbital-pair mutual information from the unrestricted Hartree-Fock (UHF) solution of each spin state, without any correlated calculation. Each of the 20 highest occupied and 20 lowest unoccupied orbitals is described by 60 descriptors computed from the UHF solution, among them the differences between its alpha and beta occupations and energies, its metal-d and ligand character, and its exchange coupling to the other orbitals, and a transformer predicts the entropy of each orbital in the context of all others. Trained on 3454 spin-pure DMRG calculations on mononuclear Cr-Ni complexes, the model transfers to experimentally characterized complexes with ligands, binding topologies, oxidation states and metals absent from training. Over 11 spin states it reproduces the DMRG entropy profiles with a mean absolute error of 0.027, and combining the predicted entropies with the predicted mutual information gives a candidate pool that contains 99% of the DMRG-active orbitals of the benchmark spin states while keeping, on average, only 15 of the 40 orbitals. Natural-orbital occupation scans then select compact active spaces from this pool for a nickel and a cobalt complex. Sample-based quantum diagonalization with samples from IBM quantum processors reproduces the exact CASCI energies of these spaces to within 0.3 kcal/mol and their spin-state gaps to within 0.10 kcal/mol for up to 32 qubits.
items.abstract_zh: 在经典或量子硬件上对过渡金属配合物进行多参考计算，取决于活性空间的选择。属于活性空间的轨道是那些在相关波函数中强纠缠的轨道，但测量这种纠缠需要活性空间原本旨在使其可负担的相关计算本身。我们提出SpinAware，一种机器学习模型，可从每个自旋态的无限制Hartree-Fock（UHF）解预测密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）单轨道熵和轨道对互信息，而无需任何相关计算。20个最高占据轨道和20个最低未占据轨道中的每一个都由从UHF解计算的60个描述符描述，其中包括其α和β占据数与能量之差、其金属d和配体特征，以及其与其他轨道的交换耦合；Transformer在所有其他轨道的上下文中预测每个轨道的熵。在3454个单核Cr-Ni配合物的自旋纯DMRG计算上训练后，该模型可迁移到实验表征的配合物，这些配合物的配体、结合拓扑、氧化态和金属在训练中未出现。在11个自旋态上，它以0.027的平均绝对误差重现DMRG熵分布；将预测熵与预测互信息结合，得到一个候选池，该候选池包含基准自旋态中99%的DMRG活性轨道，同时平均仅保留40个轨道中的15个。随后，自然轨道占据扫描从该池中为镍和钴配合物选择紧凑的活性空间。使用来自IBM量子处理器的样本进行基于样本的量子对角化，可在最多32个量子比特下将这些空间的精确CASCI能量重现至0.3 kcal/mol以内，并将其自旋态能隙重现至0.10 kcal/mol以内。

items.title_en: Hermitian Positive Definite Neural Networks for Matrix-CFAR Geometric Signal Detection in Nonhomogeneous Clutter
items.title_zh: 用于非均匀杂波中矩阵-CFAR几何信号检测的Hermitian正定神经网络
items.abstract_en: Matrix information geometry (MIG) detectors exploit the Riemannian geometry of Hermitian positive definite (HPD) matrices to achieve robust object detection in nonhomogeneous clutter. The matrix constant false alarm rate (matrix-CFAR) method is a representative MIG detector that relies on the geometric structures with respect to specific metrics. In most cases, computing representative HPD covariance matrices requires numerical methods, typically involving computationally intensive iterative optimization algorithms. Although explicit formulas are available for certain cases, such as the log-Euclidean (LE) mean, they are generally unavailable for many other matrix means and medians. To address this challenge, we propose integrating the Hermitian positive definite neural network (HPDNet) into the matrix-CFAR framework, replacing conventional numerical optimization procedures with a learned, geometry-preserving mapping that directly estimates representative HPD covariance matrices from data. In the simulations, the framework is evaluated for MIG detectors using both means and medians associated with the affine-invariant Riemannian metric, the LE metric, and the Bures--Wasserstein metric, on both simulated compound-Gaussian clutter and real IPIX sea clutter. In both cases, the HPDNet is trained solely on simulated data to assess its applicability to the study of real data. The results show a significant reduction of computational cost in testing, while maintaining detection performance and robustness.
items.abstract_zh: 矩阵信息几何（MIG）检测器利用Hermitian正定（HPD）矩阵的黎曼几何，在非均匀杂波中实现稳健目标检测。矩阵恒虚警率（matrix-CFAR）方法是一种代表性的MIG检测器，依赖于相对于特定度量的几何结构。在大多数情况下，计算代表性HPD协方差矩阵需要数值方法，通常涉及计算密集的迭代优化算法。尽管对于某些情况（如对数欧几里得（LE）均值）存在显式公式，但对于许多其他矩阵均值和矩阵中位数，通常不存在显式公式。为应对这一挑战，我们提出将Hermitian正定神经网络（HPDNet）集成到matrix-CFAR框架中，用学习到的、保持几何的映射替代传统数值优化过程，直接从数据估计代表性HPD协方差矩阵。在仿真中，该框架在模拟复合高斯杂波和真实IPIX海杂波上，针对使用与仿射不变黎曼度量、LE度量和Bures--Wasserstein度量相关的均值和内点的MIG检测器进行评估。在两种情况下，HPDNet仅在模拟数据上训练，以评估其对真实数据研究的适用性。结果表明，测试阶段计算成本显著降低，同时保持检测性能和稳健性。

items.title_en: Beyond Plain MCP: Do Decision Models and Code Mode Make Tool Use Cheaper and Faster?
items.title_zh: 超越普通MCP：决策模型和代码模式能使工具使用更便宜、更快速吗？
items.abstract_en: Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateways manage tool catalogs for language model agents using two primary paradigms: code mode where agents write scripts against tool stubs and decision layers which are cheap routers that preselect tool subsets. Using a controlled harness across 12 servers, up to 1,958 distractor tools, and three open-weight agents including Qwen, Gemma, and Nemotron, we present a preregistered evaluation on a sealed test split to determine when each approach succeeds. Code mode substantially outperforms plain MCP, cutting token usage by 70 to 90 percent while significantly boosting utility. Declaring return-shape hints in code mode stubs is a first-order variable, swinging success by up to 39.5 points for lower-performing agents, an effect larger than adding a router. The central hypothesis that a decision layer in front of code mode beats code mode alone is not confirmed, showing minor, statistically non-significant improvements for weaker agents and a slight cost for the strongest. We publicly release our harness, a finetuned 4B tool selection model, and all evaluation traces to support robust community experimentation on local AI privacy and agent architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 模型上下文协议（MCP）网关使用两种主要范式为语言模型智能体管理工具目录：代码模式，即智能体针对工具桩编写脚本；以及决策层，即预选工具子集的低成本路由器。我们使用跨12个服务器、多达1,958个干扰工具以及包括Qwen、Gemma和Nemotron在内的三个开放权重智能体的受控测试框架，在密封测试集上提出预注册评估，以确定每种方法何时成功。代码模式显著优于普通MCP，将令牌使用量减少70%至90%，同时显著提升效用。在代码模式桩中声明返回形状提示是一个一阶变量，可使表现较差的智能体的成功率波动高达39.5个百分点，其效应大于添加路由器。核心假设——在代码模式前添加决策层优于单独使用代码模式——未得到证实：对较弱智能体显示出微小且统计不显著的改进，对最强智能体则有轻微代价。我们公开发布测试框架、一个微调的4B工具选择模型以及所有评估轨迹，以支持社区在本地AI隐私和智能体架构方面进行稳健实验。

items.title_en: AgenticJevNav: Agentic Object Search and Navigation via Event-Driven Verification
items.title_zh: AgenticJevNav：通过事件驱动验证的智能体目标搜索与导航
items.abstract_en: Agentic navigation must maintain goals and adapt actions from incomplete evidence despite execution failures and delayed inference. We present AgenticJevNav, which links goal-directed planning, evidence memory, event-triggered verification, and bounded execution. The Agent plans from RGB, odometry, memory, and feedback, retaining goal ownership while authorizing a bounded action set. Jev reviews structured evidence after blocked/failed execution or two consecutive low-progress segments. Version, freshness, and once-only checks govern decision application. A single executor and independent RGB reflex constrain motion. Goal revisions revoke obsolete requests and actions before replanning. Across six simulated task families, AgenticJevNav achieves 73.33% SR over 60 trials, 21.67 percentage points above the next-best Agent-only aggregate control under differing historical protocols. A real-world GENISOM L1 quadruped deployment achieves 70.0% success over 30 trials, including bounded search reporting. Together, the simulation and physical-robot results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed architecture, while remaining failures highlight opportunities to improve grounding, approach planning, and runtime.
items.abstract_zh: 智能体导航必须在执行失败和推理延迟的情况下，从不完整证据中保持目标并调整动作。我们提出AgenticJevNav，将目标导向规划、证据记忆、事件触发验证和有界执行联系起来。Agent根据RGB、里程计、记忆和反馈进行规划，保留目标所有权，同时授权有界动作集。Jev在执行受阻/失败后或连续两个低进展片段后审查结构化证据。版本、新鲜度和仅一次检查控制决策应用。单个执行器和独立的RGB反射约束运动。目标修订在重新规划前撤销过时的请求和动作。在六个模拟任务族中，AgenticJevNav在60次试验中达到73.33%的成功率（SR），在不同历史协议下比次优的仅Agent聚合控制高21.67个百分点。在真实世界的GENISOM L1四足机器人部署中，在30次试验中达到70.0%的成功率，包括有界搜索报告。仿真和物理机器人结果共同证明了所提出架构的有效性，而剩余失败则突出了改进基础、接近规划和运行时的机会。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: MetricHand: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching for 4D Hand Reconstruction in Metric World Space
items.title_zh: MetricHand：面向度量世界空间中4D手部重建的几何感知流匹配
items.abstract_en: Egocentric hand motion provides physical motion supervision for dexterous manipulation and vision-language-action pretraining. Reliable use of this supervision requires accurate and temporally coherent 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. Existing methods typically lift framewise estimates produced under weak perspective into world coordinates. By ignoring joint-dependent depth variation at close range, this approximation couples errors in translation, orientation, and articulation that persist after world lifting and worsen under occlusion. We present MetricHand, a geometry-aware flow matching framework for 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. MetricHand encodes depth priors from hand-object interaction regions into joint-associated representations that preserve local spatial structure and metric scale. Fused with visual features, this geometry guides coarse metric estimation and conditions every step of temporal generation. The model jointly recovers world-space translation, global orientation, MANO articulation, and shape, while structural priors and temporal context support estimation under partial occlusion. MetricHand reduces camera-space MPJPE by 49.3% and 52.9%, absolute world-space MPJPE by 28.7% and 21.7%, and wrist localization error by 48.5% and 37.9% relative to HaWoR, respectively. World-space acceleration error decreases by 44.2% and 64.3%, demonstrating improved temporal fidelity alongside more accurate absolute localization.
items.abstract_zh: 第一视角手部运动为灵巧操作和视觉-语言-动作预训练提供物理运动监督。可靠地使用这种监督需要在度量世界空间中进行准确且时间连贯的4D手部重建。现有方法通常将在弱透视下生成的逐帧估计提升到世界坐标。通过忽略近距离下依赖关节的深度变化，这种近似把平移、朝向和关节运动的误差耦合在一起，这些误差在世界提升后仍然存在，并在遮挡下加重。我们提出 MetricHand，一个用于度量世界空间中4D手部重建的几何感知流匹配框架。MetricHand 将来自手-物体交互区域的深度先验编码为与关节关联的表示，这些表示保留局部空间结构和度量尺度。与视觉特征融合后，该几何引导粗粒度度量估计，并作为时间生成每一步的条件。该模型联合恢复世界空间平移、全局朝向、MANO 关节运动和形状，同时结构先验和时间上下文支持部分遮挡下的估计。相对于 HaWoR，MetricHand 分别将相机空间 MPJPE 降低 49.3% 和 52.9%，绝对世界空间 MPJPE 降低 28.7% 和 21.7%，手腕定位误差降低 48.5% 和 37.9%。世界空间加速度误差分别降低 44.2% 和 64.3%，表明在更准确绝对定位的同时时间保真度得到改善。

items.title_en: Pharmacophore-Inspired Virtual Receptor: Generating Realistic Peptide Binding Data for Machine Learning
items.title_zh: 受药效团启发的虚拟受体：为机器学习生成逼真的肽结合数据
items.abstract_en: VReceptor is a virtual receptor simulation framework that generates realistic, sequence-dependent binding data for peptide-based therapeutics. It combines pharmacophore-inspired weighting schemes with amino acid similarity metrics to evaluate peptide design strategies in a controlled environment. Validation using the Prolactin-Releasing Peptide (PrRP) dataset confirms VReceptor's ability to approximate binding behaviours and optimize experimental planning. This framework empowers researchers in computational peptide design and active learning workflows while highlighting areas for further refinement.
items.abstract_zh: VReceptor 是一个虚拟受体模拟框架，可为基于肽的治疗药物生成逼真的、序列依赖的结合数据。它结合受药效团启发的加权方案与氨基酸相似性度量，在受控环境中评估肽设计策略。使用催乳素释放肽（PrRP）数据集进行的验证确认了 VReceptor 近似结合行为并优化实验规划的能力。该框架为计算肽设计和主动学习工作流中的研究人员提供支持，同时指出有待进一步改进的方面。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Agentic AI for Discovering Fault-Tolerant Quantum Circuits
items.title_zh: 用于发现容错量子电路的智能体AI
items.abstract_en: Scaling quantum computing toward practical quantum advantage is currently limited by the efficiency of circuits that operate on information encoded by quantum error-correcting codes. The full stack of quantum computing encompasses several tasks: preparation of logical code states, implementation of logical gates, logical routines on encoded qubits, etc. Yet, these circuits are largely designed by hand for individual cases, with some recent works incorporating machine learning for certain aspects. We formulate this problem as agentic evolutionary program synthesis, wherein a large language model, leveraging its pretraining knowledge and tool-use proficiency, and guided by a circuit verifier, evolves a program that defines a Clifford circuit for a wide range of curated tasks such as logical state preparation, logical gate design, and logical routines such as code-switching, code growth, etc. Our approach consistently finds fault-tolerant circuits for all of these tasks, each verified by an exhaustive check over faults.
items.abstract_zh: 将量子计算扩展到实际量子优势目前受限于对由量子纠错码编码的信息进行操作的电路效率。量子计算的全栈包含若干任务：逻辑码态制备、逻辑门实现、编码量子比特上的逻辑例程等。然而，这些电路在很大程度上是针对个别情况手工设计的，近期一些工作在某些方面引入了机器学习。我们将该问题表述为智能体式进化程序合成，其中大语言模型利用其预训练知识和工具使用能力，并在电路验证器引导下，进化出一个程序，该程序为广泛精选任务定义 Clifford 电路，这些任务包括逻辑态制备、逻辑门设计以及诸如码切换、码增长等逻辑例程。我们的方法持续为所有这些任务找到容错电路，每个电路都通过对故障的穷举检查进行验证。

items.title_en: Do Embedding-Map Distances Guide LLM Ideation? Four Tests Against What Came Next
items.title_zh: 嵌入图距离能引导LLM构思吗？针对后续出现内容的四项检验
items.abstract_en: A popular ideation recipe treats an embedding map of existing work as a guide: pick points far from everything and decode them into ideas. I test four ways such distances could guide ideation against what appeared later. (1) Far random directions are not text: no later item reaches a raw cosine above about 0.10 with one (after centring or whitening, 22 of 24 cells stay out of reach), and an LLM decoder shown a target's neighbours, with score-only feedback, writes those neighbours in all six target sets. A neighbour-free search writes coherent text at median cosine 0.57 and 0.47 to interior gaps, beating the nearest existing item on 15 and 14 of 20, but only 0.07 and 0.06 to far points. (2) On k-means cells of a past-only map, the registered hole score mostly tracks cell size and position; three density-based gap scores forecast which cells grow fastest at or below chance (AUC 0.30 to 0.66) and add nothing to momentum in Steam and arXiv, with patents inconclusive; more isolated new Steam games are slightly better reviewed. (3) LLM continuations of arXiv papers stay closer to the source than papers that cite it, under three user prompts and against proposal rewrites (gpt-4o) and April-December 2023 papers (OLMo). Critique lengthens this step beyond content-free revision, replicated on 150 new papers. Revealing a real follow-up's title turns the ideas by 0.032 along a follow-up-specific direction beyond revision; reviewer, oracle and distance feedback add 0.13, 0.08 and 0.34 of that turn (upper bounds 0.46, 0.46, 0.70), and their turn is not separable from revision or their longer step. (4) For inspiration material graded by distance, no inverted U was detected, on an anticipation margin that tracks format more than content. Original tests were registered before running, follow-ups (thirteen requested in two AI-agent reviews) after the main results; all are dated only by local git commits.
items.abstract_zh: 一种流行的构思配方将现有工作的嵌入图视为指南：选取远离所有点的点，并将其解码为想法。我针对后来出现的内容，检验了此类距离引导构思的四种方式。（1）远的随机方向不是文本：没有后续条目与某个随机方向达到原始余弦相似度高于约0.10（在中心化或白化后，24个单元格中有22个仍无法达到），而一个仅接收分数反馈、被展示目标邻居的LLM解码器在全部六个目标集中写出的就是那些邻居。无邻居搜索写出的连贯文本与内部间隙的中位余弦相似度为0.57和0.47，在20个中有15个和14个优于最近的现有条目，但与远点的相似度仅为0.07和0.06。（2）在仅基于过去数据的嵌入图的 k-means 单元格上，所登记的孔洞分数主要跟踪单元格大小和位置；三种基于密度的间隙分数对哪些单元格增长最快的预测处于或低于随机水平（AUC 0.30 至 0.66），并且在 Steam 和 arXiv 上对动量没有增量，专利数据则不确定；更孤立的新 Steam 游戏获得的评价略好。（3）在三种用户提示下，并相对于提案改写（gpt-4o）和2023年4月至12月的论文（OLMo），arXiv 论文的 LLM 续写比引用该论文的论文更接近来源。批评使这一步长于无内容修订，并在150篇新论文上得到复现。揭示真实后续工作的标题会使想法沿后续工作特定方向移动0.032（超出修订）；审稿人、预言机和距离反馈分别增加该转动的0.13、0.08和0.34（上界为0.46、0.46、0.70），并且它们的转动无法与修订或它们更长的步骤区分开。（4）对于按距离评分的灵感材料，在更多跟踪格式而非内容的预期边际上，未检测到倒U型关系。原始检验在运行前注册，后续检验（两项AI智能体评审中要求的十三项）在主要结果之后注册；所有内容仅通过本地 git 提交标注日期。

items.title_en: ModHarness-RL: Recasting Harnesses as Learnable and Evolving Programs for Agentic RL
items.title_zh: ModHarness-RL：将支架重塑为面向智能体强化学习的可学习且不断演化的程序
items.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly relies on a harness, the scaffold around the model that decides what it sees of its own interaction and what guidance it receives. Most existing approaches train under a hand-written harness that stays fixed throughout. However, an effective harness depends on the domain, the data and the model, and keeps changing as the model trains. We introduce ModHarness-RL, which recasts the harness as programs that are learned from data and evolve as the model trains with RL. ModHarness-RL records the interaction as structured State, a set of typed blocks, and two core components of the harness are programs over these blocks, a Compression program that assembles the accumulated history into the model's context and a Steering program that supplies guidance when behavior deviates. During RL training, candidate programs are proposed from recent trajectories, verified by execution, and replayed over past trajectories, so the harness tracks how the model's behavior shifts. We study CodeSearch in depth and further analyze ALFWorld and BIRD SQL, with models from 1.5B to 8B. The proposed Compression and Steering mechanisms improve held-out performance over the fixed-harness baseline in most settings. These results suggest that a harness for agentic RL can be learned from the task's data and evolved with the model.
items.abstract_zh: 智能体强化学习（RL）日益依赖 harness，即模型周围决定其如何看到自身交互以及接收何种指导的支架。大多数现有方法在手工编写且全程固定的 harness 下训练。然而，有效的 harness 取决于领域、数据和模型，并随着模型训练而不断变化。我们提出 ModHarness-RL，它将 harness 重塑为从数据中学习、并随模型通过 RL 训练而演化的程序。ModHarness-RL 将交互记录为结构化 State，即一组带类型的块，而 harness 的两个核心组件是作用于这些块的程序：Compression 程序将累积历史组装到模型上下文中，Steering 程序在行为偏离时提供指导。在 RL 训练期间，候选程序由近期轨迹提出，经执行验证，并在过去轨迹上重放，从而使 harness 跟踪模型行为如何变化。我们深入研究 CodeSearch，并进一步分析 ALFWorld 和 BIRD SQL，模型规模从 1.5B 到 8B。所提出的 Compression 和 Steering 机制在大多数设置中相比固定 harness 基线提升了留出集性能。这些结果表明，面向智能体 RL 的 harness 可以从任务数据中学习，并随模型演化。

items.title_en: SuperGlance: Driving at a Glance with a Vision-Language Model
items.title_zh: SuperGlance：用视觉-语言模型实现一眼驾驶
items.abstract_en: Autonomous driving is turning to vision-language-action models (VLAs). They answer and plan by decoding, one step at a time. Each step is another forward pass, so a plan can take over a second of GPU time. Embodied AI often pairs such a slow, reasoning System 2 with a fast System 1 that acts. Human drivers plan at a glance, with System 1. Faster designs usually put System 1 outside the vision-language model (VLM), in a planner without its abilities. Yet before a VLM writes its first token, it has already read the scene into one hidden state. We show that, once trained, this hidden state is enough to drive and to answer questions about what the model sees. SuperGlance reads it to turn a decoder-only VLM into an encoder-style driving policy. Its linear head scores a fixed set of 5,273 candidate trajectories. With the set fixed, rewards are computed offline, so supervised targets can be reward-weighted and reinforcement learning maximizes the exact expected reward. Before and during policy training, multiple-choice training keeps the VLM's visual abilities in one pass, so the policy still answers questions about driving scenes. Training questions are built against shortcuts. Each must be answered right in two option orders. Against drift, a KL term keeps each stage near its starting model. One pass offers VLAs a more plausible path to System 1. SuperGlance answers visual multiple-choice questions as well as its base VLM does by decoding. It plans in 84 ms of GPU time, six times faster than Qwen-Drive-1.0, and at least as well on NAVSIM, PAI-AV and WOD-E2E. In AlpaSim closed loop, km per at-fault incident holds for both planners up to a 300-ms delay and drops beyond. With GPU time charged as delay, SuperGlance's lead over Qwen-Drive-1.0 grows from 2.8 to 3.9 times. Delayed by 1.2 s, our model falls below Qwen-Drive-1.0 at its own 518 ms.
items.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶正转向视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）。它们通过逐步解码来回答和规划。每一步都是另一次前向传播，因此一次规划可能耗费超过一秒的 GPU 时间。具身AI通常将这种缓慢、推理式的 System 2 与快速行动的 System 1 配对。人类驾驶员用 System 1 一眼完成规划。更快的设计通常将 System 1 放在视觉-语言模型（VLM）之外，置于一个不具备其能力的规划器中。然而，在 VLM 写出第一个 token 之前，它已经把场景读入一个隐藏状态。我们表明，经过训练后，这个隐藏状态足以用于驾驶并回答关于模型所见内容的问题。SuperGlance 读取该隐藏状态，将仅解码器 VLM 转变为编码器风格的驾驶策略。其线性头对一组固定的5,273条候选轨迹进行打分。由于集合固定，奖励可离线计算，因此监督目标可以按奖励加权，而强化学习最大化精确的期望奖励。在策略训练之前和期间，多项选择训练以一次前向传播保持 VLM 的视觉能力，因此该策略仍能回答关于驾驶场景的问题。训练问题针对捷径构建。每个问题必须在两种选项顺序下都被正确回答。为防止漂移，KL 项使每个阶段接近其起始模型。一次前向传播为 VLA 提供了一条更合理的通向 System 1 的路径。SuperGlance 回答视觉多项选择题的效果与其基础 VLM 通过解码回答的效果一样好。它以84毫秒的 GPU 时间进行规划，比 Qwen-Drive-1.0 快六倍，并在 NAVSIM、PAI-AV 和 WOD-E2E 上至少同样好。在 AlpaSim 闭环中，对于两个规划器，每起有责事故的公里数在最高300毫秒延迟下保持不变，超过后下降。将 GPU 时间计为延迟时，SuperGlance 相对 Qwen-Drive-1.0 的领先优势从2.8倍增长到3.9倍。在延迟1.2秒时，我们的模型低于 Qwen-Drive-1.0 在其自身518毫秒时的表现。

items.title_en: CLIFT: Contrastive LiDAR Instance Features for 3D Pedestrian Tracking
items.title_zh: CLIFT：用于3D行人跟踪的对比式LiDAR实例特征
items.abstract_en: A social robot has to keep track of the people around it over time to plan its motion, a task handled by 3D multi-object tracking. For the LiDAR modality, trackers usually sit on top of a detector and link its detections across frames with a separate motion model or re-identification network. We instead show how a 3D LiDAR detector itself can be turned into a tracker by adding an instance-level contrastive objective on its intermediate voxel features. Each embedding is read from the voxels inside a detected box, and boxes are matched across frames by cosine similarity and the Hungarian algorithm, without a motion model. The detector backbone is fine-tuned together with this objective, which learns identity-aware features while leaving detection accuracy essen- tially intact. Because the method uses only the voxel features that Li- DAR detectors already produce, it is backbone-agnostic. On the JRDB 3D tracking leaderboard our LiDAR-only tracker ranks first on HOTA (38.58) and IDF1 (37.99), 13.04 and 9.30 points above the next pub- lished method, and second on MOTA and OSPA. Code is available at https://hermak56.github.io/CLIFT/.
items.abstract_zh: 社交机器人必须随时间跟踪周围的人以规划其运动，这一任务由3D多目标跟踪处理。对于LiDAR模态，跟踪器通常建立在检测器之上，并通过单独的运动模型或重识别网络将其跨帧检测结果关联起来。我们则展示，如何通过在3D LiDAR检测器的中间体素特征上添加实例级对比目标，将检测器本身转变为跟踪器。每个嵌入从检测框内的体素读取，框通过余弦相似度和匈牙利算法跨帧匹配，不使用运动模型。检测器骨干与该目标一起微调，从而学习身份感知特征，同时使检测准确率基本保持不变。由于该方法仅使用LiDAR检测器已产生的体素特征，因此与骨干无关。在JRDB 3D跟踪排行榜上，我们的纯LiDAR跟踪器在HOTA（38.58）和IDF1（37.99）上排名第一，分别比下一个已发表方法高13.04和9.30分，在MOTA和OSPA上排名第二。代码见 https://hermak56.github.io/CLIFT/。

items.title_en: FasL blockade suppresses liver metastasis and prolongs survival in small-cell lung cancer
items.title_zh: FasL阻断抑制小细胞肺癌肝转移并延长生存
items.abstract_en: Small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an aggressive malignancy characterised by early metastatic dissemination, frequent relapse and poor long-term survival. Despite advances in immunotherapy, durable disease control remains challenging, highlighting the need to identify therapeutic vulnerabilities beyond conventional tumour-cell killing and immune checkpoint inhibition. Here, we uncover an unexpected contribution of Fas-Fas ligand (FasL) signalling to SCLC metastatic progression and demonstrate the therapeutic potential of targeting this pathway. Using an autochthonous Rb1/Trp53-deficient mouse model, we show that genetic Fas deletion markedly suppresses liver metastatic disease, identifying a previously unrecognised contribution of Fas signalling to metastatic progression. Notably, despite this antimetastatic effect, Fas deletion during tumour initiation did not improve survival and was accompanied by pronounced alterations in pulmonary tissue architecture. As these alterations may reflect adverse consequences of Fas deletion in non-malignant pulmonary populations, we reasoned that pharmacological FasL blockade in established disease could provide therapeutic benefit while circumventing the detrimental consequences for pulmonary tissue homeostasis associated with genetic Fas deletion. Remarkably, only six administrations of a soluble Fas-Fc fusion protein over three weeks significantly prolonged survival and substantially reduced the incidence and burden of liver metastases. FasL blockade was also associated with enhanced inflammatory and immune-response transcriptional signatures in the liver, while its combination with anti-PD-1 increased pulmonary immune-cell accumulation without conferring additional survival benefit. These data suggest that the biological consequences of targeting this pathway may depend on the timing and cellular context of intervention. Together, our findings identify Fas-FasL signalling as an unexpected regulator of SCLC metastatic progression and establish FasL blockade as a promising therapeutic strategy capable of prolonging survival in established disease beyond conventional immune checkpoint inhibition.
items.abstract_zh: 小细胞肺癌（SCLC）是一种侵袭性恶性肿瘤，其特征是早期转移播散、频繁复发和长期生存差。尽管免疫治疗取得进展，持久的疾病控制仍具挑战，这凸显出需要识别超越传统肿瘤细胞杀伤和免疫检查点抑制的治疗脆弱性。在此，我们揭示了Fas-Fas配体（FasL）信号对SCLC转移进展的意外贡献，并证明了靶向该通路的治疗潜力。使用自发Rb1/Trp53缺陷小鼠模型，我们显示遗传性Fas缺失显著抑制肝转移性疾病，从而识别出Fas信号对转移进展此前未被认识到的贡献。值得注意的是，尽管有这种抗转移效应，肿瘤起始期间的Fas缺失并未改善生存，并伴随肺组织结构的明显改变。由于这些改变可能反映Fas缺失在非恶性肺群体中的不良后果，我们推断，在已建立疾病中进行药理学FasL阻断可提供治疗获益，同时规避与遗传性Fas缺失相关的对肺组织稳态的有害后果。引人注目的是，在三周内仅六次给予可溶性Fas-Fc融合蛋白，就显著延长了生存，并大幅降低了肝转移的发生率和负荷。FasL阻断还与肝脏中炎症和免疫应答转录特征的增强相关，而将其与抗PD-1联合使用增加了肺部免疫细胞积聚，但未带来额外的生存获益。这些数据表明，靶向该通路的生物学后果可能取决于干预的时机和细胞背景。总之，我们的发现将Fas-FasL信号识别为SCLC转移进展的意外调节因子，并确立FasL阻断为一种有前景的治疗策略，能够在已建立疾病中延长生存，超越传统免疫检查点抑制。

items.title_en: Modular Programmable Photonics with Unitary Tiles
items.title_zh: 基于酉瓦片的模块化可编程光子学
items.abstract_en: Programmable photonics provides a versatile platform for optical information processing, but extending programmable transformations to large numbers of optical modes remains challenging. We investigate a modular architecture composed of unitary tiles arranged in alternating and staggered columns. Each physical tile interlaces fixed multiport mixers with programmable phase shifts, confining individual mixing operations to small groups of modes while connecting them across a larger processor. We analyze the relationship between circuit depth, intertile connectivity, and attainable transformations, distinguishing ideal programmable tiles from their physical phase-stack implementations. Numerical target-fitting results show a transition in the reconstruction errors at $R = 2K$, where $K$ and $R$ are the number of tile rows and columns, respectively. This design ultimately aims to enable large and reliable port-count optical photonic processors.
items.abstract_zh: 可编程光子学为光学信息处理提供了通用平台，但将可编程变换扩展到大量光学模式仍然具有挑战性。我们研究一种模块化架构，由按交替和错列列排列的酉瓦片组成。每个物理瓦片将固定的多端口混频器与可编程相移交织，将单个混频操作限制在小组模式内，同时在更大的处理器中连接它们。我们分析电路深度、瓦片间连接性与可达到变换之间的关系，区分理想可编程瓦片与其物理相位堆叠实现。数值目标拟合结果显示，在R = 2K处重构误差发生转变，其中K和R分别为瓦片行数和列数。该设计最终旨在实现大规模且可靠端口数的光学光子处理器。

items.title_en: From very fine Vertical Resolution to Range Super-Resolution on BIOMASS P-BAND SAR Data
items.title_zh: 从极高垂直分辨率到BIOMASS P波段SAR数据的距离超分辨率
items.abstract_en: This paper demonstrates range super-resolution over arid regions using SAR tomography data with very fine vertical resolution from the European Space Agency's BIOMASS mission. As the first civilian spaceborne P-band SAR mission, BIOMASS is operating with a bandwidth limited to 6~MHz by International Telecommunication Union regulations, yielding a native slant-range resolution of approximately 25 m. The large spatial baseline data acquired during the commissioning phase in July and August 2025 provide a valuable opportunity to enhance range resolution based on the InSAR wavenumber shift principle. According to this principle, a wider effective bandwidth can be synthesized by combining complementary sub-bands of the ground reflectivity spectrum sampled across acquisitions at different look angles. Unlike existing literature, this paper offers a novel interpretation of this problem from the perspective of SAR tomography. Furthermore, the proposed method also accounts for residual topography errors. The range resolution enhancement performance is validated using all 20 available acquisitions from the July-August 2025 commissioning phase over Lop Nur, China, and Wadi al-Hayat, Libya, achieving spatial detail comparable to optical satellite imagery in a grid finer than 2 m. Furthermore, the reconstructed range spectrum of the central Libyan oasis exhibits an effective bandwidth exceeding 70 MHz. The point spread function (PSF) of a point like target in the scene demonstrates a slant-range resolution finer than 2.1 m, representing more than a twelvefold improvement over the native resolution.
items.abstract_zh: 本文利用来自欧洲空间局BIOMASS任务的具有极细垂直分辨率的SAR层析数据，展示干旱区域的距离超分辨率。作为首个民用星载P波段SAR任务，BIOMASS受国际电信联盟规定限制，带宽被限制在6 MHz，产生约25 m的原始斜距分辨率。2025年7月和8月调试阶段获取的大空间基线数据为基于InSAR波数偏移原理增强距离分辨率提供了宝贵机会。根据该原理，通过组合在不同视角观测中采样的地面反射率谱的互补子带，可以合成更宽的有效带宽。与现有文献不同，本文从SAR层析的角度对该问题提供了新的解释。此外，所提方法还考虑了残余地形误差。使用2025年7—8月调试阶段在中国罗布泊和利比亚Wadi al-Hayat的全部20次可用观测，验证了距离分辨率增强性能，在细于2 m的网格中实现了与光学卫星影像相当的空间细节。此外，利比亚中部绿洲的重构距离谱显示出超过70 MHz的有效带宽。场景中类点目标的点扩散函数（PSF）表明斜距分辨率细于2.1 m，比原始分辨率提高超过十二倍。

items.title_en: Procedure without Judgment: What Small Language Models Learn under an Exact Verifier
items.title_zh: 无判断的程序：小语言模型在精确验证器下学到了什么
items.abstract_en: When an authorization policy blocks an agent's tool call, the audit log should name the facts that forced the decision and nothing more. For an executable policy over an enumerable context space this minimal sufficient reason can be computed exactly, so an explanation is scored against ground truth rather than a proxy for it. We use that exactness to ask what a model can learn from a verifier that has no error in it. The explainer sees one request and one decision, never the policy, and has thirty turns in which it may call the policy on altered requests and ask whether a candidate set of facts is sufficient. Frontier models find the exact reason about half the time with the tools alone, and one sentence telling them to shrink the answer lifts Haiku 4.5 from 58% to 75%. A 4B model fine-tuned on 2000 traces of the deletion algorithm reaches 92% on the policy it was trained on. Teacher kind is what moves this: at matched data size the algorithm-taught student leads the frontier-taught one in all three training seeds, and the two arms never overlap. What the student learns is a fixed schedule of sufficiency checks, and the schedule does not travel. On three public policies it never saw, its answers stay sufficient (94%) and stop being minimal (48%), while Haiku under the same sentence is exact on all 47 episodes. Reinforcement learning from the exact reward leaves held-out accuracy where it was and inverts the strategy, from probing the policy to spending the entire budget on sufficiency checks. The oracle made the effect of training legible, but it did not make training better.
items.abstract_zh: 当授权策略阻止智能体的工具调用时，审计日志应列出迫使该决定的事实，且不应包含更多内容。对于可枚举上下文空间上的可执行策略，这种最小充分理由可以被精确计算，因此解释是针对真实值而非其代理进行评分。我们利用这种精确性来追问：模型可以从一个本身无误差的验证器中学到什么。解释器看到一个请求和一个决定，从不看到策略，并有三十个回合，在其中它可以对修改后的请求调用策略，并询问候选事实集合是否充分。前沿模型仅使用工具时约有一半时间找到精确理由，而一句要求它们精简答案的话将Haiku 4.5从58%提升到75%。一个在删除算法2000条轨迹上微调的4B模型在其训练所用策略上达到92%。起决定作用的是教师类型：在数据规模匹配时，由算法教导的学生在全部三个训练种子中都领先于由前沿模型教导的学生，且两个实验组从不重叠。学生学到的是一个固定的充分性检查调度，而该调度不可迁移。在三个它从未见过的公开策略上，其答案保持充分（94%）但不再最小（48%），而在同样提示句下的Haiku在全部47个回合中均精确。基于精确奖励的强化学习使留出准确率保持不变，并逆转策略：从探测策略转为将全部预算用于充分性检查。该预言机使训练效果变得可读，但并未使训练变得更好。

items.title_en: X-Nav Technical Report: Real-World Long-Horizon Indoor-to-Outdoor Navigation on a Humanoid Robot
items.title_zh: X-Nav技术报告：人形机器人真实世界室内到室外长时程导航
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon navigation from indoors to outdoors remains an open problem for humanoid robots: one instruction covers rooms, doors and roads, and the camera moves with the gait. Worken, AGIBOT's measure of productive robot work, depends on robots that reach their workplaces autonomously. We present X-Nav, to our knowledge the first system to take a bipedal humanoid through a language-instructed long-horizon mission from indoors to outdoors. X-Nav covers a pipeline from data to deployment. Its data engine collects navigation data in open-source scenes, in digital twins of deployment sites and on real robots. Its navigation model, MELIOR, takes only RGB images from the robot's built-in camera and comes in two versions: MELIOR-A predicts actions, and MELIOR-N predicts a navigation goal. Its agentic workflow, X-Navarch, turns a brief human instruction into sub-tasks and deploys MELIOR on the robot with explicit target navigation and obstacle avoidance. On the Lingxi X2, X-Nav completes a mission of about a hundred metres from an office lobby to a store in a neighbouring building; LiDAR and odometry are used for target approach and low-level control. The mission is completed with both versions of MELIOR: the robot follows a change of destination and walks through a door from the lobby to the road, and with X-Navarch it also passes static and dynamic obstacles on the route. During deployment, MELIOR is adapted with data collected in a digital twin of the site; the adaptation raises its closed-loop success rate in the twin, and the adapted model is then deployed on the robot at the real site. In addition, MELIOR achieves competitive results on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.
items.abstract_zh: 从室内到室外的长时程导航对人形机器人仍是一个开放问题：一条指令涵盖房间、门和道路，且相机会随步态移动。Worken是AGIBOT衡量机器人生产性工作的指标，它依赖于机器人自主到达工作场所。我们提出X-Nav，据我们所知，这是首个让双足人形机器人完成语言指令下从室内到室外长时程任务的系统。X-Nav涵盖从数据到部署的流水线。其数据引擎在开源场景、部署场地的数字孪生以及真实机器人上收集导航数据。其导航模型MELIOR仅接收来自机器人内置相机的RGB图像，并有两个版本：MELIOR-A预测动作，MELIOR-N预测导航目标。其智能体工作流X-Navarch将简短的人类指令转化为子任务，并在机器人上部署MELIOR，以显式目标导航和避障。在Lingxi X2上，X-Nav完成一项约一百米的任务，从办公室大厅到相邻建筑中的商店；LiDAR和里程计用于目标接近和底层控制。该任务在MELIOR两个版本下均完成：机器人跟随目的地变更，并穿过一扇门从大厅走到道路；在X-Navarch下，它还能通过路线上的静态和动态障碍物。在部署期间，MELIOR利用在场地数字孪生中收集的数据进行适配；该适配提高了其在孪生中的闭环成功率，随后适配后的模型被部署到真实场地的机器人上。此外，MELIOR在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上取得有竞争力的结果。

items.title_en: Deep Learning for Satellite-Based Mountain Hazard Screening: A Retrospective Failure Analysis on the 2021 Chamoli Rock-Ice Avalanche
items.title_zh: 基于卫星的山地灾害筛查深度学习：对2021年Chamoli岩冰崩的回顾性失败分析
items.abstract_en: The approach utilizes 10 bands from Sentinel-2 imagery, along with terrain information, in a deep learning pipeline to classify potential hazard sources in any given mountainous region. The performance of our model has been evaluated against the data collected during the rock-ice avalanche event in the Chamoli region in the Indian Himalayas on 7th February 2021. U-Net performs segmentation of the detected land surface in the satellite image, detects changes in the identify candidate hazard zones, and then the following steps are performed to calculate the potential energy using the Monte Carlo sampling for steepest descent (D8) flow paths, finding the exposed structures in the downstream locations, and ranking the zones depending on the risk score. In comparison to the simple spectral rule, our approach achieved the higher macro F1 score of 0.648 (as compared to 0.519). But the F1 score in case of rock and soil was low, being in the range of 0.3s. In case of optical change detection in winter, it's only that northeast-facing slope which couldn't be detected, as it was under 73% of shade prior to the incident. The parameters have been set for this particular scene alone and not independently; hence, this is a retrospective test, and this test locates a failure which has occurred earlier. The primary contribution of this paper is locating the pipeline leak.
items.abstract_zh: 该方法在深度学习流水线中使用Sentinel-2影像的10个波段以及地形信息，对任意给定山区的潜在危险源进行分类。我们模型的性能已对照2021年2月7日印度喜马拉雅Chamoli地区岩冰崩事件期间收集的数据进行评估。U-Net对卫星影像中检测到的地表进行分割，检测变化以识别候选危险区，然后执行以下步骤：使用蒙特卡洛采样在最陡下降（D8）流路上计算势能，找出下游位置中暴露的结构，并按风险评分对区域排序。与简单光谱规则相比，我们的方法取得了更高的宏F1分数0.648（相比0.519）。但岩石和土壤的F1分数较低，处于0.3左右。在冬季光学变化检测中，只有东北朝向的坡面无法被检测到，因为其在事件发生前有73%处于阴影中。这些参数仅针对这一特定场景设置，并非独立设定；因此这是一次回顾性测试，该测试定位了一个早先发生的失败。本文的主要贡献是定位流水线泄漏。

items.title_en: Native-like 3D colonoids reveal mechanisms of colonic drug disposition
items.title_zh: 类天然3D结肠类器官揭示结肠药物处置机制
items.abstract_en: Intestinal organoid research in drug absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADME-T) has focused predominantly on small intestinal enteroids, leaving colonic drug handling comparatively unexplored. Here, we established and characterized adult colonic stem cell-based three-dimensional (3D) organoid (colonoid) models as physiologically relevant New Approach Methodologies (NAMs). Donor-matched mucosal tissue, isolated primary epithelial cells, and 3D colonoids were characterized using global and targeted proteomics, fixed and live-cell microscopy, functional ADME-T assays and targeted lipidomics. This complementary analysis identified isolated primary epithelial cells as a more representative native epithelial reference than excised mucosal tissue. Suspended differentiated apical- and basal-out colonoid configurations more closely matched this reference across the assessed characteristics. Together, these two configurations provided access to both apical and basolateral epithelial surfaces, enabling functional studies of key drug transporters (P-gp, BCRP) and metabolizing enzymes (CYP3A4, UGT1A, SULT1A) in a native-like setting. Measurement of intracellular bioavailability (Fic), reflecting drug availability to intracellular targets, revealed lipophilicity-dependent microvillar absorption mechanisms. Hydrophilic compounds exploited the enlarged membrane surface provided by microvilli, whereas highly permeable lipophilic compounds seemingly entered only at the microvillus tips. Compared with HEK293 cells, an established reference model for Fic measurements, colonoids combined native-like epithelial geometry with higher phospholipid content and generally stronger intracellular drug binding, highlighting the importance of both architecture and cellular composition for studying colonic drug disposition. These colonoid models provide a physiologically relevant platform for investigating colonic ADME-T and reveal how microvillar architecture shapes intracellular drug bioavailability.
items.abstract_zh: 肠道类器官在药物吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADME-T）方面的研究主要集中在小肠肠类器官，结肠药物处置相对未被探索。在此，我们建立并表征了基于成体结肠干细胞的三维（3D）类器官（结肠类器官）模型，作为生理相关的新方法学（NAMs）。使用全局和靶向蛋白质组学、固定和活细胞显微镜、功能性ADME-T测定和靶向脂质组学对供体匹配的黏膜组织、分离的原代上皮细胞和3D结肠类器官进行表征。这种互补分析确定，分离的原代上皮细胞是比切除的黏膜组织更具代表性的天然上皮参考。悬浮分化的顶端朝外和基底朝外结肠类器官构型在所评估特征上更接近该参考。这两种构型共同提供了对顶端和基底外侧上皮表面的访问，从而能够在类天然环境中对关键药物转运体（P-gp、BCRP）和代谢酶（CYP3A4、UGT1A、SULT1A）进行功能研究。细胞内生物利用度（Fic）的测量反映了药物对细胞内靶点的可利用性，揭示了依赖亲脂性的微绒毛吸收机制。亲水性化合物利用了微绒毛提供的增大的膜表面，而高渗透性亲脂性化合物似乎仅在微绒毛尖端进入。与Fic测量的既定参考模型HEK293细胞相比，结肠类器官结合了类天然上皮几何结构和更高的磷脂含量以及总体上更强的细胞内药物结合，突出了结构和细胞组成对研究结肠药物处置的重要性。这些结肠类器官模型为研究结肠ADME-T提供了一个生理相关平台，并揭示了微绒毛结构如何塑造细胞内药物生物利用度。

items.title_en: Quantum Networks with Realistic Photonic Memories
items.title_zh: 具有现实光子存储器的量子网络
items.abstract_en: Ensemble based photonic memories paired with photon pair sources are the essential ingredient for many quantum networking protocols. Most protocols and theoretical analyses focus on networks of identical nodes, however, realistic networks consist of nodes that may vary from device to device. We investigate a network of non-identical memories and develop mitigation strategies for the variation in performance. We find that by strategically distributing the memories among the nodes and individually adapting the emission probabilities based on the memory efficiency the effect of the variance on fidelity and duration can to a large extend be mitigated. Generally, our analysis shows the importance of accounting and compensating for device variations to avoid deteriorating the performance. Lastly, we also link our results to memories where efficiency decays as a function of storage duration. Here, we show that our approach provides a visible improvement for networks with non-identical and decaying memories.
items.abstract_zh: 基于系综的光子存储器与光子对源配对，是许多量子网络协议的关键要素。大多数协议和理论分析关注由相同节点组成的网络，但现实网络由可能因设备而异的节点组成。我们研究由非相同存储器组成的网络，并针对性能差异制定缓解策略。我们发现，通过在节点间策略性分配存储器，并基于存储效率单独调整发射概率，可以在很大程度上缓解方差对保真度和持续时间的影响。总体而言，我们的分析表明，考虑并补偿设备差异以避免性能恶化非常重要。最后，我们还将结果与效率随存储持续时间衰减的存储器联系起来。在此，我们表明我们的方法对具有非相同且衰减存储器的网络提供了可见的改进。

items.title_en: Same Fix, Different Weights: Replicating Weight-Space Programming with Claude
items.title_zh: 同样的修复，不同的权重：用Claude复现权重空间编程
items.abstract_en: Takehi et al. (2026) report that GPT-6 Astra, given the weights of small neural networks as text, can say what they were trained to do, repair them, and write new ones without training. I re-ran the core of that study with Claude Opus 5.5 in ten pre-registered experiments, with untrained-network and permutation controls and hand audits of every sandboxed code cell. Reading was mixed: Claude named 3 of 4 Atari games from policy weights and found the measured copying heads in 15/15 character-LM runs, but its answers about training data often followed priors. Unlike the original, it identified a sycophantic Gemma 3 270M finetune from weights alone in 6/6 runs. One-shot weight edits took a failing MountainCar policy from 0% to 100% success and a hovering LunarLander policy from 0% to 85.6%; zero-shot networks beat PPO at 100k steps on 4 of 5 environments, each implementing a textbook controller. With no training or forward passes, Claude wrote a 1.48M-parameter 9x9 Go network that won 85-94% of games against three PPO opponents. Given Qwen3.5-0.8B's weights and 10, 25 or 50 forward passes of 64 practice problems, Claude raised MATH-500 from 6.7% to 51.4%, 55.2% and 58.1% (+51.4 points at 50 passes, 95% CI [47.9, 55.0]; original 48.1%), GSM8K from 11.6% to 68.2% and IFEval from 22.2% to 54.2%. Unlike the original, which removed an internal loop direction, every edit acted at the output: it scaled the final norm, raising the effective sampling temperature, and lowered the logit of "Wait" while raising that of . The norm scaling alone reaches only 20.9-22.1% on MATH-500. On Gemma 3 270M, which rarely loops, no edit helped (-0.8 points), as in the original.
items.abstract_zh: Takehi等人（2026）报告称，GPT-6 Astra在获得以文本形式给出的小型神经网络权重后，能够说出它们被训练来做什么、修复它们，并在无需训练的情况下编写新的网络。我用Claude Opus 5.5在十个预注册实验中重新运行了该研究的核心，并设置了未训练网络和置换对照，且对每个沙箱代码单元进行人工审计。读取结果好坏参半：Claude从策略权重中命名了4个Atari游戏中的3个，并在15/15次字符语言模型运行中找到了所测量的复制头，但其关于训练数据的回答常常遵循先验。与原始研究不同，它仅在6/6次运行中仅凭权重识别出一个谄媚的Gemma 3 270M微调模型。一次性权重编辑将一个失败的MountainCar策略从0%成功率提升到100%，并将一个悬停的LunarLander策略从0%提升到85.6%；零样本网络在5个环境中的4个上于100k步时击败PPO，每个网络都实现了一个教科书控制器。在没有训练或前向传播的情况下，Claude编写了一个148万参数的9x9围棋网络，在与三个PPO对手的比赛中赢得85-94%的对局。给定Qwen3.5-0.8B的权重以及64道练习题进行10、25或50次前向传播，Claude将MATH-500从6.7%提高到51.4%、55.2%和58.1%（50次传播时+51.4个百分点，95% CI [47.9, 55.0]；原始为48.1%），将GSM8K从11.6%提高到68.2%，将IFEval从22.2%提高到54.2%。与原始研究移除内部循环方向不同，每次编辑都作用于输出：它缩放了最终归一化，提高了有效采样温度，并降低了“Wait”的logit，同时提高了 的logit。仅归一化缩放就使MATH-500仅达到20.9-22.1%。在很少循环的Gemma 3 270M上，没有任何编辑有帮助（-0.8分），与原始研究相同。

items.title_en: A Scalable Multi Task Learning Framework for Modeling Demographic Disagreements in Annotation Tasks
items.title_zh: 用于建模标注任务中人口统计学分歧的可扩展多任务学习框架
items.abstract_en: Annotators from different demographic backgrounds often disagree in systematic ways due to varying lived experiences, cultural contexts, and their relationship to the content. When such disagreement occurs, one group's perspective may sometimes warrant prioritization because they hold an epistemically advantaged standpoint or bear greater stake in the outcome. For example, when assessing toxicity of posts on social media, it may be important to prioritize a targeted group's viewpoint. We propose a Stakeholder-Aware Joint Multi-Task Learning (SAJ-MTL) framework to jointly model demographic disagreement both across- and within- annotator groups. The model uses conditional gradient routing to handle sparsity induced by group-conditional labeling, and parameterization supports customized weighting of groups in different task settings. SAJ-MTL improves group-level performance in toxicity detection through better context-aware understanding of demographic-sensitive content. Only annotator group-membership information is required, which is more practical than existing methods requiring more privacy-invasive individual-level annotator details. Our scalable architecture is also computationally efficient to support large-scale deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 来自不同人口统计学背景的标注者常常由于不同的生活经历、文化背景及其与内容的关系而以系统性方式产生分歧。当这种分歧发生时，有时某一群体的视角可能值得优先考虑，因为他们拥有认识论上的优势立场或在结果中利益更大。例如，在评估社交媒体帖子的毒性时，优先考虑目标群体的观点可能很重要。我们提出利益相关者感知联合多任务学习（SAJ-MTL）框架，以联合建模标注者群体之间和群体内部的人口统计学分歧。该模型使用条件梯度路由来处理群体条件标注引起的稀疏性，参数化支持在不同任务设置中对群体进行定制加权。SAJ-MTL通过对人口统计学敏感内容更好的上下文感知理解，提高了毒性检测中的群体级性能。仅需要标注者的群体成员信息，这比需要更多侵犯隐私的个体级标注者详细信息的现有方法更实用。我们的可扩展架构在计算上也高效，可支持大规模部署。

items.title_en: ARMFUL: Learning Whole-Arm Grasp Configurations for Single-Arm Pickup of Large Objects
items.title_zh: ARMFUL：学习用于单臂拾取大型物体的全臂抓取构型
items.abstract_en: Many everyday objects, such as storage boxes, baskets, and chairs, are too large or heavy for a gripper to grasp, yet a single arm can still pick them up by wrapping around and supporting them. Such grasps are hard to learn: wrapping motions are difficult to teleoperate, and existing datasets contain little whole-arm pickup data. We introduce WAG (Whole-Arm Grasp Dataset), the first large-scale dataset for single-arm pickup of large objects, with 1.7~million joint configurations across 793 objects. We sample configurations directly in joint space, execute each through squeeze and lift primitives in simulation, and stress-test survivors under active shaking and external forces. To demonstrate the utility of WAG and accomplish the whole-arm pickup task, we develop ARMFUL, a whole-arm pickup pipeline that pairs a diffusion model trained on WAG, generating whole-arm grasps from the object's point cloud, with a motion planner that reaches them collision-free before the same squeeze-and-lift execution. In simulation, ARMFUL reaches 85.4\% lift success on training and 69.9\% on held-out objects, and it lifts the object in 70 of 100 trials on a physical Franka arm across 10 IKEA objects.
items.abstract_zh: 许多日常物体，如储物箱、篮子和椅子，对于夹爪来说太大或太重而无法抓取，但单臂仍可通过环绕并支撑它们来拾取。此类抓取难以学习：环绕运动难以遥操作，且现有数据集几乎没有全臂拾取数据。我们引入WAG（全臂抓取数据集），这是首个用于单臂拾取大型物体的大规模数据集，包含793个物体上的170万个关节构型。我们直接在关节空间中采样构型，在仿真中通过挤压和抬升原语执行每个构型，并在主动晃动和外部力下对存活构型进行压力测试。为证明WAG的效用并完成全臂拾取任务，我们开发了ARMFUL，一个全臂拾取流水线，它将基于WAG训练的扩散模型（从物体点云生成全臂抓取）与运动规划器配对，使运动规划器在同样的挤压和抬升执行之前无碰撞地到达这些抓取。在仿真中，ARMFUL在训练物体上达到85.4%的抬升成功率，在留出物体上达到69.9%；在物理Franka机械臂上，针对10个IKEA物体，它在100次试验中的70次成功抬升物体。

items.title_en: Improving X-Ray Baggage Instance Segmentation with Shared Point-Based Mask Refinement
items.title_zh: 基于共享点式掩码细化的X射线行李实例分割改进
items.abstract_en: Overlapping projections and complex object contours make prohibited items difficult to delineate in X-ray baggage images. This study investigates shared point-based mask refinement to improve instance segmentation within Cascade Mask R-CNN. The framework combines a ResNet-101 backbone with an attention-based feature pyramid and progressively updates uncertain mask locations, increasing mask resolution from $28 \times 28$ to $112 \times 112$. A single refinement module is shared across cascade stages and refinement levels, with transformer and multilayer perceptron (MLP) variants used to examine the role of interactions among selected points. Ten configurations were evaluated on the official PIXray split across three training seeds using the original target-instance annotations for evaluation. The transformer and MLP refiners achieved mean mask average precision (AP) of 71.79 and 72.47, respectively, compared with 70.50 for the unrefined detector, yielding gains of 1.29 and 1.97 AP points. The MLP achieved the highest mean mask AP among the evaluated configurations. Both variants also improved boundary agreement on commonly detected objects, supporting improved mask delineation, while detection diagnostics did not establish a corresponding positive gain. These findings demonstrate that shared point-based refinement can improve segmentation quality in the tested cascade architecture using existing target-mask annotations, without additional occluder supervision. Evaluation on independent X-ray datasets is needed to determine how well these improvements generalize.
items.abstract_zh: 重叠投影和复杂物体轮廓使得违禁物品在X射线行李图像中难以被描绘。本研究探讨共享的基于点的掩码细化，以改进Cascade Mask R-CNN中的实例分割。该框架将ResNet-101主干与基于注意力的特征金字塔相结合，并逐步更新不确定的掩码位置，将掩码分辨率从28×28提高到112×112。单个细化模块在级联阶段和细化层级之间共享，并使用Transformer和多层感知机（MLP）两种变体来考察所选点之间交互的作用。在官方PIXray划分上，使用原始目标实例标注进行评估，跨三个训练种子评估了十种配置。Transformer和MLP细化器分别达到平均掩码平均精度（AP）71.79和72.47，而未细化检测器为70.50，增益分别为1.29和1.97个AP点。在评估的配置中，MLP取得最高的平均掩码AP。两种变体还改善了常见检测对象的边界一致性，支持掩码描绘的改进，而检测诊断未确立相应的正向增益。这些发现表明，在所测试的级联架构中，使用现有的目标掩码标注，共享的基于点的细化可以改善分割质量，而无需额外的遮挡物监督。需要在独立X射线数据集上进行评估，以确定这些改进的泛化程度。

items.title_en: Integrating multiple imputation with harmonization in multisite neuroimaging data: implications for site effects and biological inference
items.title_zh: 将多重插补与协调化整合于多站点神经影像数据：对站点效应与生物学推断的意义
items.abstract_en: Multisite neuroimaging harmonization in Alzheimer's disease research with missing data has received limited attention in the literature. Here, we evaluated the performance of several harmonization methods in conjunction with multiple imputation (MI) to address missing data, using baseline [18F]flortaucipir tau positron emission tomography (PET) data from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI). We compared complete case and MICE-imputed datasets (m = 5) across the original ADNI-preprocessed data and four statistical harmonization approaches: ComBat with and without covariates, quantile normalization, and quantile regression. Weighted average standardized uptake value ratios (SUVRs) across six Braak regions were analyzed for each dataset-method combination. We assessed harmonization effectiveness using covariate-adjusted intraclass correlation coefficients and site-level pairwise differences, and evaluated biological effect preservation using Hedges' g, regression coefficients, and statistical significance for comparisons between cognitively impaired and unimpaired participants. For imputed analyses, effect sizes and regression coefficients were pooled using Rubin's rules, with statistical inference based on the pooled estimates. Post-processing harmonization reduced site-level variability compared to the original data, with method performance varying across evaluation metrics, while overall harmonization quality remained comparable after MI. Disease group differences remained statistically significant across all combinations, exhibiting a consistent regional pattern, strongest in Braak I and weakest in Braak VI. MI modestly increased effect size and coefficient estimates, with improved precision reflected by median standard error ratios below 1 (0.89 for effect sizes and 0.93 for coefficients). These findings indicate that integrating MI with harmonization preserves disease group differences and improves statistical efficiency without compromising harmonization performance, supporting a practical framework for multisite neuroimaging studies.
items.abstract_zh: 在阿尔茨海默病研究中，针对缺失数据的多站点神经影像协调化在文献中受到的关注有限。在此，我们使用阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议（ADNI）的基线[18F]flortaucipir tau正电子发射断层扫描（PET）数据，评估了几种协调化方法与多重插补（MI）结合以处理缺失数据的性能。我们在原始ADNI预处理数据以及四种统计协调化方法：带协变量和不带协变量的ComBat、分位数归一化和分位数回归上，比较了完整案例数据集和MICE插补数据集（m = 5）。对每种数据集-方法组合，分析了六个Braak区域内的加权平均标准化摄取值比（SUVR）。我们使用协变量调整的组内相关系数和站点级两两差异评估协调化有效性，并使用Hedges' g、回归系数以及认知受损与未受损参与者比较的统计显著性评估生物学效应保留情况。对于插补分析，使用Rubin规则合并效应量和回归系数，统计推断基于合并估计。与原始数据相比，后处理协调化降低了站点级变异性，方法性能因评估指标而异，而MI后整体协调化质量保持可比。疾病组差异在所有组合中均保持统计显著，呈现一致的区域模式，在Braak I最强，在Braak VI最弱。MI适度增加了效应量和系数估计，精度提高体现为中位标准误比低于1（效应量为0.89，系数为0.93）。这些发现表明，将MI与协调化整合可保留疾病组差异并提高统计效率，而不损害协调化性能，支持多站点神经影像研究的实用框架。

items.title_en: Controlling Mode-Locking in Liquid Light
items.title_zh: 控制液态光中的锁模
items.abstract_en: Mode-locking is the process by which the phases of many cavity modes organize collectively into a stationary state. In lasers, mode-locking originates from the interplay of gain, loss, dispersion and nonlinearities, most commonly resulting in the emission of short pulses. However, pulse formation is prevented when the gain recovery is fast enough to suppress amplitude fluctuations. Mode-locking then produces an extended state of nearly constant intensity, whose dynamics is governed by the phase. Yet, a general framework for designing the phase of such extended photonic states remains lacking. Here we introduce a hydrodynamic approach to designing extended photonic states, in which the phase dynamics are understood and controlled as a flow of liquid-like light. The intensity, clamped by fast gain, plays the role of a constant density, the instantaneous frequency that of a flow velocity, and the programmable radio-frequency modulation applied to the laser acts as a potential landscape that controls the flow. We derive analytical solutions connecting the applied modulation to the instantaneous frequency and hence to the spectrum emitted by the laser. We further provide experimental evidence for the liquid light shaping framework by measuring the frequency comb spectra emitted by a fast-gain semiconductor laser around \SI{1.6}{\micro\m} under the control of a programmed modulation, and comparing them to the ones predicted by the analytical solution. The hydrodynamic picture of mode-locking provides a predictive design principle for frequency combs, pointing toward a programmable synthesizer of light, and establishes fast-gain lasers as an accessible, electrically driven platform for nonequilibrium fluids of light.
items.abstract_zh: 锁模是许多腔模的相位集体组织成稳态的过程。在激光器中，锁模源于增益、损耗、色散和非线性之间的相互作用，最常见的结果是发射短脉冲。然而，当增益恢复足够快以抑制幅度涨落时，脉冲形成会被阻止。此时锁模产生一种近乎恒定强度的扩展态，其动力学由相位支配。然而，设计此类扩展光子态相位的通用框架仍然缺乏。在此，我们引入一种流体动力学方法来设计扩展光子态，其中相位动力学被理解并控制为类液态光的流动。被快速增益钳制的强度扮演恒定密度的角色，瞬时频率扮演流速的角色，而施加于激光器的可编程射频调制则充当控制流动的势场景观。我们推导了解析解，将所施加的调制与瞬时频率进而与激光器发射的光谱联系起来。我们进一步通过测量快速增益半导体激光器在约1.6微米处、在程序化调制控制下发射的频率梳光谱，并将其与解析解预测的光谱进行比较，为液态光整形框架提供了实验证据。锁模的流体动力学图景为频率梳提供了预测性设计原理，指向可编程的光合成器，并使快速增益激光器成为可用于非平衡光流体的易获取的电驱动平台。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为光学器件与计算，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Architectural Principles for Parameter-Efficient Unitary Transformations in Coherent Optical Neural Networks
items.title_zh: 相干光学神经网络中参数高效酉变换的架构原则
items.abstract_en: Coherent optical neural networks based on interferometric architectures offer a promising route toward high-throughput, energy-efficient computation by exploiting the multiple degrees of freedom of light, including spatial, temporal, and spectral modes. However, practical implementations are constrained by the number of tunable parameters due to fabrication complexity, device footprint, and control overhead. In such parameter-constrained settings, achieving high expressive power remains a central challenge. We identify two key architectural requirements for maintaining high expressive power under these constraints: (i) statistical uniformity in the implemented transformations and (ii) strong mixing capability per parameter, which enables rapid and unbiased redistribution of information across modes. To realize these requirements, we develop a logarithmic-depth butterfly-topology architecture whose fundamental building block is a single phase-shifter--beam-splitter pair, in contrast to conventional rectangular mesh architectures based on Mach-Zehnder interferometers. Computational evaluations show that, particularly at restricted parameter counts, the proposed architecture achieves lower matrix-reconstruction errors and higher classification accuracies than conventional meshes in both feedforward and recurrent networks. We further quantify these design principles using graph-theoretic measures, expected squared moduli of transformation-matrix entries, and matrix-reconstruction error. The resulting framework provides a quantitative and physically interpretable basis for parameter-efficient optical neural networks.
items.abstract_zh: 基于干涉架构的相干光学神经网络通过利用光的多个自由度（包括空间、时间和光谱模式），为高通量、节能计算提供了一条有前景的途径。然而，由于制造复杂性、器件占用面积和控制开销，实际实现受到可调参数数量的限制。在此类参数受限的设置中，实现高表达能力仍然是核心挑战。我们确定了在这些约束下保持高表达能力的两个关键架构要求：（i）所实现变换的统计均匀性，以及（ii）每个参数的强混合能力，从而能够跨模式快速且无偏地重新分配信息。为满足这些要求，我们开发了一种对数深度的蝶形拓扑架构，其基本构建模块是单个移相器—分束器对，这与基于马赫-曾德尔干涉仪的传统矩形网格架构形成对比。计算评估表明，特别是在参数数量受限时，所提出的架构在前馈和循环网络中均比传统网格实现更低的矩阵重构误差和更高的分类准确率。我们进一步使用图论度量、变换矩阵元素的期望平方模以及矩阵重构误差来量化这些设计原则。所得框架为参数高效的光学神经网络提供了定量且物理上可解释的基础。

items.title_en: AuXSpec: Learning to Autoformalize Program Specifications via Executable Postconditions
items.title_zh: AuXSpec：通过可执行后置条件学习程序规约的自动形式化
items.abstract_en: Formal specifications define intended program behavior and underpin verification, but writing them in theorem provers such as Lean is slow and expertise-intensive, making specification a major bottleneck to scaling formally correct code. Autoformalization from natural-language problems is promising, yet training specification models requires scalable feedback on whether generated specifications capture intended behavior. Prior approaches obtain this feedback through explicit proofs or separately implemented code with formal correspondence proofs, both expensive. We introduce AuXSpec, a Lean framework that pairs declarative postconditions with executable counterparts, obtained through type class resolution when possible and otherwise defined separately with an equivalence proof. Test cases can then evaluate declarative specifications by execution, letting us use agreement as a reinforcement-learning reward. Using AuXSpec, we synthesize 3,037 LeetCode problems and expand training to 19.5K samples through expert iteration on Codeforces. Experiments show that training Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B with the execution-based reward improves SpecGen pass@4 on AuXSpec-Test 0.7% $\to$ 82.7% and 14.3% $\to$ 84.3%, and the 27B model outperforms all frontier models. On the out-of-domain Verina benchmark with its original prompts, both models improve 7.0% $\to$ 90.5% and 21.9% $\to$ 90.5% and surpass VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B, the prior state of the art among open-source specification models, on pass@1 (theirs 47.6% vs. ours 73.7% and 84.5%) and pass@4 (theirs 63.9% at pass@10 vs. ours 90.5%). We release the weights of the trained 9B and 27B models and the 3,037 problems with test cases, including the 300-problem AuXSpec-Test benchmark with expert review and correctness proofs for future evaluation. Models and data: https://huggingface.co/collections/eth-algopt/auxspec. Website: https://auxspec.org
items.abstract_zh: 形式化规约定义了程序的预期行为，并支撑验证，但在Lean等定理证明器中编写它们既缓慢又需要大量专业知识，使得规约成为扩展形式正确代码的主要瓶颈。从自然语言问题进行自动形式化具有前景，然而训练规约模型需要对生成的规约是否捕捉预期行为获得可扩展的反馈。先前方法通过显式证明或单独实现并带有形式对应证明的代码来获得这种反馈，二者都代价高昂。我们引入AuXSpec，一个Lean框架，将声明式后置条件与可执行对应物配对，在可能时通过类型类解析获得，否则单独定义并附等价性证明。然后测试用例可以通过执行来评估声明式规约，使我们能够将一致性用作强化学习奖励。使用AuXSpec，我们合成了3,037个LeetCode问题，并通过在Codeforces上的专家迭代将训练扩展到19.5K个样本。实验表明，使用基于执行的奖励训练Qwen3.5-9B和Qwen3.8-27B，使AuXSpec-Test上的SpecGen pass@4分别从0.7%提高到82.7%，从14.3%提高到84.3%，且27B模型优于所有前沿模型。在域外Verina基准上使用其原始提示，两个模型分别从7.0%提高到90.5%，从21.9%提高到90.5%，并在pass@1（他们的47.6%对 ours 73.7%和84.5%）和pass@4（他们在pass@10下为63.9%，而我们为90.5%）上超过VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B——先前开源规约模型中的最先进水平。我们发布训练后的9B和27B模型权重以及3,037个带测试用例的问题，包括经过专家评审并带有正确性证明的300题AuXSpec-Test基准，以供未来评估。模型与数据：https://huggingface.co/collections/eth-algopt/auxspec。网站：https://auxspec.org

items.title_en: ESI: An Embodied Self-Improvement Flywheel for LLM-VLA Agents
items.title_zh: ESI：面向LLM-VLA智能体的具身自我改进飞轮
items.abstract_en: Independently pretrained language models and vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide complementary building blocks for embodied agents, but connecting them does not automatically produce coordinated behavior. The VLA may generate actions that diverge from the LLM's intended subtask and, upon regaining control after a correction, undo the promising state restored by the LLM. We introduce ESI (Embodied Self-Improvement), an automated flywheel that uses environmental interaction to align reasoning and action. ESI treats the modular agent as the unit of post-training, repeatedly refining the prompts that guide the LLM, the shared skill interface that expresses its intent, and the VLA parameters that realize that intent, then redeploying these components together. Our key insight is that collaboration itself can supply supervision for improving this interface. The LLM's subtask decisions provide semantic supervision for what the policy should execute, while its effective corrections and subsequent student continuations provide action-level supervision for recovery and handoff. The student also learns from its own effective execution, allowing locally useful experience to contribute even when the overall episode fails. On ten selected RoboDojo tasks, ESI achieves a mean Score of 62.03 and a mean success rate of 49.41% using an LLM-VLA agent without generating task-specific control code. On both metrics, it outperforms the published reference results of all hybrid embodied agents, including the Agent+WAM system GO-3 Nano Preview (47.27 Score and 36.60% success), as well as all compared code-based methods.
items.abstract_zh: 独立预训练的语言模型和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略为具身智能体提供了互补的构建模块，但将它们连接起来并不会自动产生协调行为。VLA可能生成偏离LLM预期子任务的动作，并且在纠正后重新获得控制时，可能撤销LLM恢复的有希望状态。我们引入ESI（具身自我改进），一个自动化飞轮，利用环境交互来对齐推理与行动。ESI将模块化智能体视为后训练单元，反复改进引导LLM的提示、表达其意图的共享技能接口以及实现该意图的VLA参数，然后共同重新部署这些组件。我们的关键洞见是，协作本身可以为改进这一接口提供监督。LLM的子任务决策为策略应执行什么提供语义监督，而其有效纠正及后续学生继续执行则为恢复和交接提供动作级监督。学生也从自身的有效执行中学习，使得即使整个回合失败，局部有用的经验也能有所贡献。在十个选定的RoboDojo任务上，ESI使用LLM-VLA智能体在不生成任务特定控制代码的情况下，取得平均Score 62.03和平均成功率49.41%。在这两项指标上，它优于所有混合具身智能体的已发表参考结果，包括Agent+WAM系统GO-3 Nano Preview（47.27 Score和36.60%成功率），以及所有比较的基于代码的方法。

items.title_en: GeoReVis: Learning Selective Revision and Evidence Consolidation for Remote Sensing Segmentation
items.title_zh: GeoReVis：面向遥感分割学习选择性修正与证据整合
items.abstract_en: Recent methods try to inspect and revise masks to mitigate referential ambiguity and localization errors caused by complex spatial relations in language-guided remote sensing segmentation. However, these solutions often lead to Revision Degradation: revising missing regions may introduce errors into previously correct ones. Even a globally better mask can omit correct regions found in inferior masks. We term this Evidence Fragmentation: correct target evidence is scattered across imperfect masks. All masks generated by the model at this time are suboptimal. We propose GeoReVis, which unifies revision guided by execution feedback, Candidate Selection, and Cross-Mask Evidence Consolidation. It learns fine-grained revision from real actions that improve segmentation when executed and learns to select a better mask through quality comparisons between actual candidates, reducing the risk of degradation during revision. The selected whole mask can still discard useful regions. GeoReVis therefore retains all candidates across rounds, partitions their spatial disagreements into composable regions, and jointly reconstructs regions conditioned on the full instruction and context. This makes complementary and fragmentary evidence reusable regardless of its source candidate's overall quality, yielding improved segmentation. We further build a data pipeline to generate fine-grained multi-round segmentation trajectories and derive supervision for revision actions, candidate selection, and region composition from the model's own outputs, extending training beyond whole-mask IoU supervision. We also propose ReVis-Eval, a benchmark protocol evaluating multi-round revision and cross-round evidence consolidation accuracy. Experiments on ReVis-Eval and 5 benchmarks for remote sensing reasoning and referring segmentation demonstrate the effectiveness of GeoReVis.
items.abstract_zh: 近期方法尝试检查并修正掩码，以缓解语言引导遥感分割中复杂空间关系导致的指代歧义和定位错误。然而，这些方案常常导致 Revision Degradation：修正缺失区域可能会把错误引入此前正确的区域。即使全局更优的掩码也可能遗漏较差掩码中已找到的正确区域。我们将其称为 Evidence Fragmentation：正确的目标证据分散在不完美的掩码中。此时模型生成的所有掩码均为次优。我们提出 GeoReVis，它统一了由执行反馈引导的修正、Candidate Selection 与 Cross-Mask Evidence Consolidation。它从实际执行后能改进分割的真实动作中学习细粒度修正，并通过实际候选之间的质量比较学习选择更优掩码，从而降低修正过程中的退化风险。选出的整体掩码仍可能丢弃有用区域。因此，GeoReVis 保留多轮中的所有候选，将其空间分歧划分为可组合区域，并在完整指令和上下文条件下联合重建这些区域。这使得互补且碎片化的证据无论其来源候选的整体质量如何都可被复用，从而改进分割。我们进一步构建数据流水线，以生成细粒度多轮分割轨迹，并从模型自身输出中导出修正动作、候选选择和区域组合的监督，从而将训练扩展到整掩码 IoU 监督之外。我们还提出 ReVis-Eval，一种评估多轮修正和跨轮证据整合准确性的基准协议。在 ReVis-Eval 以及 5 个遥感推理和指代分割基准上的实验证明了 GeoReVis 的有效性。

items.title_en: Partial microglial depletion attenuates Purkinje cell degeneration and reshapes both glial and inflammatory responses in a mouse model of selective neurodegeneration
items.title_zh: 部分小胶质细胞耗竭减轻浦肯野细胞变性，并重塑选择性神经退行性变小鼠模型中的胶质与炎症反应
items.abstract_en: Background The microglial population contributes to the inflammatory environment during neurodegeneration. Its role in neuronal loss remains hard to distinguish from its response to injury. We investigated how early pharmacological reduction of this population affects Purkinje cell preservation, behaviour and the cerebellar glial response. Methods We administered PLX5622 to Purkinje cell degeneration (PCD) and wild-type (WT) mice from postnatal day (P) 15 to P24 and compared them with their respective untreated controls. We assessed motor coordination, spontaneous behaviours and novel-object recognition at P17, P21 and P25. At P25, we quantified regional Purkinje cell preservation, glial immunoreactivity and microglial abundance and morphology. We assessed selected transcripts in whole-cerebellum samples by reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR). Results At P25, treated PCD mice showed better motor coordination, improvements in selected spontaneous behaviours and greater novel-object discrimination. Greater Purkinje cell preservation coincided with lower glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) immunoreactivity in lobes IV-V and VIII. Microglial density decreased in all four PCD regions analysed. The territory encompassed by the processes of residual microglia expanded in both genotypes. In PCD mice, CD68-positive tissue area decreased in lobes I-II and IV-V, and the proportion of Iba1-positive area occupied by CD68 decreased in IV-V. CD45, CD16/32 and CD206 immunoreactivity decreased alongside selective reductions in immune, inflammatory and phagocytosis-associated transcripts. Treated WT mice showed early behavioural changes, including reduced novel-object discrimination. Conclusions Early PLX5622 treatment can modify the outcome of genetically driven cerebellar degeneration in PCD mice. The benefits achieved with partial microglial depletion provide a preclinical rationale for testing how the timing and extent of glial modulation influence neuronal protection during active degeneration.
items.abstract_zh: 背景 小胶质细胞群体在神经退行性变过程中参与形成炎症环境。其在神经元丢失中的作用仍难以与其对损伤的反应相区分。我们研究了早期药物性减少该群体如何影响浦肯野细胞保留、行为以及小脑胶质反应。方法 我们从出生后第15天（P15）至P24向浦肯野细胞变性（PCD）小鼠和野生型（WT）小鼠施用 PLX5622，并与各自未处理的对照进行比较。我们在 P17、P21 和 P25 评估运动协调、自发行为和新物体识别。在 P25，我们量化区域浦肯野细胞保留、胶质免疫反应性以及小胶质细胞丰度和形态。我们通过逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）评估全小脑样本中的选定转录本。结果 在 P25，接受治疗的 PCD 小鼠表现出更好的运动协调、部分自发行为的改善以及更强的新物体辨别能力。浦肯野细胞保留增加与 IV-V 叶和 VIII 叶中较低的胶质纤维酸性蛋白（GFAP）免疫反应性相吻合。分析的四个 PCD 区域中小胶质细胞密度均下降。残余小胶质细胞突起所覆盖的区域在两种基因型中均扩大。在 PCD 小鼠中，I-II 叶和 IV-V 叶中 CD68 阳性组织面积减少，IV-V 叶中 CD68 占据的 Iba1 阳性面积比例下降。CD45、CD16/32 和 CD206 免疫反应性降低，同时免疫、炎症和吞噬相关转录本出现选择性减少。接受治疗的 WT 小鼠表现出早期行为变化，包括新物体辨别能力降低。结论 早期 PLX5622 治疗可改变 PCD 小鼠遗传驱动小脑变性的结局。部分小胶质细胞耗竭所获得的益处为测试胶质调控的时机和程度如何影响活跃变性过程中的神经元保护提供了临床前依据。
