items.title_en: Multilevel AlScN Ferroelectric Diode Crossbar Arrays with Sub-200 nm Cells for Selector-Free Nonvolatile Memory
items.title_zh: 用于无选择器非易失性存储器的亚200 nm单元多电平AlScN铁电二极管交叉阵列
items.abstract_en: Passive crossbar arrays are a leading route to high-density nonvolatile memory and in-memory computing, but without a selector the memory element itself must supply the nonlinearity that suppresses sneak-path currents. Here we scale aluminum scandium nitride (AlScN) ferroelectric diodes (FeDs) in both dimensions that matter - the ferroelectric is thinned to 10 nm and the junction diameter is reduced to 100 nm. We further integrate 200 nm cells into a 2-kilobyte (128 * 128) passive crossbar. At a junction area of 0.0314 um2 this is a ~625 reduction in cell area, at equal array capacity, relative to kilobyte-scale AlScN FeD crossbars built on 5 μm cells. The 10 nm Al0.64Sc0.36N layer reverses its polarization under pulses of 50 ns full width at half maximum at a pulse-energy density of ~16 pJ μm-2, corresponding to ~0.5 pJ per 200 nm cell. Pulsed programming at 17.5 V and 1 kHz yields an ON/OFF ratio of 4.2 * 103 in a 200 nm cell, while DC characterization of 283 randomly addressed cells of the 2-kB array gives ON/OFF and rectification ratios at 5 V of 43 33 and 61 74, from which we derive the sub-array size that selector-free reading currently supports. Eight conductance levels (three bits) written into a 200 nm array cell remain resolvable for 103 s, and the two extreme states are stable beyond 5 * 104 s. Mapping the measured, nonuniformly spaced levels onto a ResNet-20 network recovers 91.7 +- 0.1 % CIFAR-10 accuracy after quantization-aware training, against a 92.2 +- 0.1 % full-precision baseline. AlScN FeDs thus combine nanosecond switching, three-bit storage and sub-0.05 μm2 cells in a BEOL-compatible, selector-free crossbar.
items.abstract_zh: 无源交叉阵列是通向高密度非易失性存储器和存内计算的主要途径之一，但如果没有选择器，存储元件本身必须提供抑制潜行路径电流的非线性。在这里，我们在两个关键维度上缩小了铝钪氮化物（AlScN）铁电二极管（FeDs）：铁电层减薄至10 nm，结直径减小至100 nm。我们进一步将200 nm单元集成到2千字节（128×128）无源交叉阵列中。在结面积为0.0314 μm²时，在阵列容量相同的情况下，这相对于基于5 μm单元构建的千字节级AlScN FeD交叉阵列，实现了约625倍的单元面积缩减。10 nm Al0.64Sc0.36N层在半高全宽为50 ns的脉冲下、脉冲能量密度约16 pJ μm⁻²时反转其极化，对应每个200 nm单元约0.5 pJ。17.5 V和1 kHz下的脉冲编程在200 nm单元中产生4.2×10^3的ON/OFF比，而对2 kB阵列中283个随机寻址单元进行直流表征，给出5 V下的ON/OFF比和整流比分别为43 33和61 74，由此我们推导出当前无选择器读取所支持的子阵列尺寸。写入200 nm阵列单元的八个电导电平（三比特）在10^3 s内仍可分辨，两个极端状态在超过5×10^4 s后仍稳定。将测得的不等间距电平映射到ResNet-20网络，在量化感知训练后恢复91.7±0.1%的CIFAR-10准确率，而全精度基线为92.2±0.1%。因此，AlScN FeDs在BEOL兼容的无选择器交叉阵列中结合了纳秒开关、三比特存储和亚0.05 μm²单元。

items.title_en: Deep Sequence Model for Genome Wide Discovery of Coding and Regulatory Element Signatures
items.title_zh: 用于全基因组发现编码和调控元件特征的深度序列模型
items.abstract_en: Interpreting deep neural networks for genomic sequence classification remains challenging despite strong predictive performance. We develop a lightweight CNN with post-training gradient-based analysis to identify which sequence positions drive coding versus intergenomic classification. Applied to the standardized demo_coding_vs_intergenomic_seqs dataset, our model achieves 91.87% validation accuracy while revealing interpretable patterns: nine hot spots with consistently high importance, clear class-specific separation at positions 20-100 (coding) and 150-190 (intergenomic), and a strong mean-variance correlation (r = 0.530) indicating robust discriminative features. Gradient-based importance analysis shows that the model implicitly learns biologically meaningful sequence distinctions without explicit annotations. This work demonstrates that neural network interpretability and accuracy can coexist, providing a framework for understanding genomic sequence classification and enabling biology-driven hypothesis generation.
items.abstract_zh: 尽管预测性能很强，解释用于基因组序列分类的深度神经网络仍然具有挑战性。我们开发了一种轻量级CNN，并结合训练后基于梯度的分析，以识别哪些序列位置驱动编码区与基因间区的分类。在标准化的demo_coding_vs_intergenomic_seqs数据集上，我们的模型达到91.87%的验证准确率，同时揭示出可解释的模式：九个持续高重要性的热点，在位置20-100（编码区）和150-190（基因间区）具有清晰的类别特异性分离，以及强均值-方差相关性（r = 0.530），表明具有稳健的判别特征。基于梯度的重要性分析表明，模型在没有显式注释的情况下隐式学习了具有生物学意义的序列区分。这项工作表明，神经网络的可解释性和准确性可以共存，为理解基因组序列分类提供了框架，并支持生物学驱动的假设生成。

items.title_en: Train After You Measure: a Pre-Registered Learning Curve for Fine-Tuning Typed Decision Models on One User's Labels
items.title_zh: 先测量再训练：在单个用户标签上微调类型化决策模型的预注册学习曲线
items.abstract_en: Fine-tuning a small typed decision model on one user's email labels did not clear the margin we pre-registered over a logistic regression trained on the same labels. In earlier work, about two hundred labels and a TF-IDF logistic regression had the highest point accuracy on this inbox, though not significantly above the best hosted model; we ask whether the same labels, given to a decision model, close the gap. A first registered study, on a generic 4B base with cross-validation and message type only, stayed below the baseline at every label budget (-1.8 to -7.3 points). The main study was registered before any fine-tuning run: a fixed test set of 135 emails never used for selection, LoRA adapters on the public Tev1-0.8B and Tev1-4B decision models, nested subsets of 50 to 587 labels, two seeds and five decision fields on a free T4 GPU. Four of its five hypotheses are refuted--two in the fine-tunes' favour--and one is confirmed for one model. On message type the 4B model misses the registered three-point margin at 400 labels (+2.6) and passes it with all 587 (+3.3); with all labels both models are above the baseline by +0.7 and +3.3 points, where one email is 0.74 points and a 95% interval is about 15 points wide, and the 4B model is clearly ahead in type macro-F1 (0.581 vs. 0.406). On the three action switches the baseline is ahead at every label budget for both models (0.931 vs. 0.904 and 0.899 mean accuracy with all labels), at under a millisecond per question against 306 and 1681 ms. The 0.8B type curve barely improves after 300 labels and then falls. The baseline never predicts the two rarest classes (7 offers and 8 spam in the training pool); the fine-tuned models find spam in some runs, not consistently across seeds. We list the explanations we did not test and say when a new attempt would be worth making. Scripts are public; weights and emails are not.
items.abstract_zh: 在单个用户的电子邮件标签上微调一个小型类型化决策模型，未能达到我们预注册的、相对于在相同标签上训练的 logistic regression 的领先幅度。在早期工作中，约两百个标签和 TF-IDF logistic regression 在这个收件箱上取得了最高的点准确率，尽管并不显著高于最佳托管模型；我们询问，将相同标签提供给决策模型是否能缩小差距。第一项注册研究在一个通用4B基座模型上，仅使用交叉验证和消息类型，在每个标签预算下都低于基线（-1.8至-7.3个百分点）。主要研究在任何微调运行之前注册：一个由135封电子邮件组成的固定测试集从未用于选择，在公开的 Tev1-0.8B 和 Tev1-4B 决策模型上使用 LoRA 适配器，标签的嵌套子集为50至587个，两个随机种子和五个决策字段，在免费 T4 GPU 上运行。其五个假设中有四个被否定——其中两个有利于微调——有一个在一个模型上得到确认。在消息类型上，4B模型在400个标签时未达到注册的三点领先幅度（+2.6），而在全部587个标签时达到（+3.3）；使用全部标签时，两个模型分别高于基线+0.7和+3.3个百分点，其中一封电子邮件为0.74个百分点，95%区间宽约15个百分点，并且4B模型在类型 macro-F1 上明显领先（0.581 vs. 0.406）。在三个动作开关上，基线在两个模型的每个标签预算下都领先（使用全部标签时平均准确率分别为0.931 vs. 0.904和0.899），且每题耗时低于1毫秒，而后者分别为306和1681毫秒。0.8B的类型曲线在300个标签后几乎没有改善，然后下降。基线从不预测两个最稀有的类别（训练池中有7个 offers 和8个 spam）；微调模型在某些运行中找到 spam，但跨种子并不一致。我们列出了未测试的解释，并说明何时值得进行新的尝试。脚本公开；权重和电子邮件不公开。

items.title_en: SADL: On the Demand-Supply Geometry of Representation Collapse
items.title_zh: SADL：论表示坍缩的需求-供给几何
items.abstract_en: In Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs), a well-constrained projector output does not by itself prevent representation collapse. We find that, from initialization, the encoder representation is dominated by a component shared by different inputs. A batch-normalized projector removes this component, so regularization after the projector cannot correct it, and the differences between representations shrink until they collapse. We propose SADL (Supply And Demand Loss), which keeps the original training objective and constrains the encoder directly when needed. SADL compares the representation differences that the projector output demands with the differences the encoder can retain and pass on to the projector, and adds a constraint on the encoder only when supply falls short of demand. It works with different Demand Regularizers and introduces no auxiliary networks, additional trainable parameters, or architectural changes. In single-task and jointly trained four-task LeWorldModel (LeWM) and INTACT experiments, SADL lowers the collapse rate over ten random seeds from 50% to 0%. After one epoch of training, encoder effective rank is 3.4-6.4 times that of the corresponding baseline without SADL, and latent prediction error falls to 1/20-1/303 of it. Without additional tuning, SADL stays robust as its loss weight spans orders of magnitude, and with several Demand Regularizers INTACT exceeds 95% mean search-free control success. On four image datasets, SADL also consistently improves accuracy and stability across random seeds. These results show that matching the representation differences a regularizer demands with the differences the encoder can supply leads to faster and more stable representation learning in control and image classification.
items.abstract_zh: 在联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）中，良好约束的投影器输出本身并不能防止表示坍缩。我们发现，从初始化开始，编码器表示就被不同输入共享的一个分量所主导。批归一化投影器会移除该分量，因此投影器之后的正则化无法纠正它，表示之间的差异会不断缩小直至坍缩。我们提出 SADL（Supply And Demand Loss），它保留原始训练目标，并在需要时直接约束编码器。SADL比较投影器输出所要求的表示差异与编码器能够保留并传递给投影器的差异，并且仅在供给不足于需求时对编码器添加约束。它可与不同的 Demand Regularizer 配合使用，且不引入辅助网络、额外可训练参数或架构改变。在单任务以及联合训练的四任务 LeWorldModel（LeWM）和 INTACT 实验中，SADL在十个随机种子上将坍缩率从50%降至0%。训练一个 epoch 后，编码器有效秩是不带 SADL 的对应基线的3.4-6.4倍，潜在预测误差降至其1/20-1/303。无需额外调参，SADL在其损失权重跨越多个数量级时仍保持稳健，并且在若干 Demand Regularizer 下，INTACT超过95%的平均无搜索控制成功率。在四个图像数据集上，SADL也持续提高跨随机种子的准确率和稳定性。这些结果表明，使正则器所要求的表示差异与编码器所能提供的差异相匹配，可在控制和图像分类中带来更快、更稳定的表示学习。

items.title_en: GlyphAtlas: Disentangling Stroke Detail from Layout for Scene Text Synthesis
items.title_zh: GlyphAtlas：将笔画细节与布局解耦，用于场景文本合成
items.abstract_en: Scene text synthesis requires stroke-accurate characters rendered in a specified layout, as well as visual coherence with the surrounding scene. To achieve this, existing methods commonly pre-render the target text at its intended locations to form a glyph image that jointly specifies layout and glyph structure. However, this representation ties the resolution of each glyph to its target region, limiting fine-grained stroke guidance for small, densely packed, or structurally complex text. To tackle this, we propose GlyphAtlas, a scene text synthesis framework that retains the glyph image as a spatial anchor and supplies fine-grained stroke references through a dedicated glyph atlas. The atlas renders and encodes each character or word in a separate cell, decoupling reference resolution from target-region size. We further introduce atlas-anchored attention, which lets each text region retrieve stroke detail only from its corresponding atlas cells to refine the coarse glyph structure provided by the glyph image. This coarse-to-fine conditioning simplifies stroke rendering while preserving explicit layout correspondence. We optimize GlyphAtlas with a mask-weighted flow matching objective and a timestep-weighted text perceptual loss for writing accuracy and background consistency. Random resolution augmentation of atlas cells supports adjustable atlas budgets at inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GlyphAtlas achieves stroke-accurate synthesis of small, dense, and structurally complex text, zero-shot transfer to languages unseen during task-specific training, and leading performance in scenes with many text regions. project page: https://fr0zencrane.github.io/project-glyphatlas/
items.abstract_zh: 场景文本合成要求在指定布局中渲染笔画准确的字符，并与周围场景保持视觉连贯。为此，现有方法通常先在目标位置预渲染目标文本，形成同时指定布局和字形结构的字形图像。然而，这种表示将每个字形的分辨率与其目标区域绑定，限制了对小型、密集或结构复杂文本的细粒度笔画引导。为解决这一问题，我们提出 GlyphAtlas，一种场景文本合成框架，它保留字形图像作为空间锚点，并通过专用字形图集提供细粒度笔画参考。该图集在独立单元格中渲染并编码每个字符或单词，使参考分辨率与目标区域大小解耦。我们进一步引入图集锚定注意力，使每个文本区域仅从其对应的图集单元格中检索笔画细节，以细化字形图像提供的粗粒度字形结构。这种由粗到细的条件化简化了笔画渲染，同时保留了显式的布局对应关系。我们用掩码加权流匹配目标和时间步加权文本感知损失优化 GlyphAtlas，以提升书写准确性和背景一致性。图集单元格的随机分辨率增强支持推理时可调的图集预算。大量实验表明，GlyphAtlas 能对小型、密集和结构复杂的文本实现笔画准确的合成，可零样本迁移到任务特定训练中未见过的语言，并在包含许多文本区域的场景中取得领先性能。项目页面：https://fr0zencrane.github.io/project-glyphatlas/

items.title_en: A conserved MoxR-vWA chaperone complex drives starvation-induced protein degradation in bacteria
items.title_zh: 保守的 MoxR-vWA 伴侣复合体驱动细菌中饥饿诱导的蛋白质降解
items.abstract_en: Bacteria must quickly adapt to changes in their environment, notably including the sudden loss of nutrients. We previously showed that in glucose-starved E. coli, widespread starvation-induced protein degradation (SPD) fuels post-starvation proteome remodeling, degrading a wide swath of the proteome to supply the cell with energy and amino acids for synthesis of stress proteins. Here we demonstrate that SPD is mediated by a highly conserved complex of three proteins: the MoxR-type AAA+ ATPase SpdA, the von Willebrand factor A (vWA) domain protein SpdB, and the zinc metallopeptidase SpdC. Structural modeling and in vitro reconstitutions show that these proteins form a complex with 6:1:1 stoichiometry that resembles the widespread, but still poorly understood, family of MoxR-vWA chaperone complexes in bacteria and eukaryotes. Measurements of protein degradation in glucose-starved E. coli cells show that SpdA, SpdB, and SpdC work together to mediate the degradation of SPD substrates. Instead of directly degrading these substrates, our data suggest that limited structural perturbation and proteolysis "softens" SPD substrates and promotes their degradation by the cellular proteases ClpAP/ClpXP and Lon. Thus, SPD enables extensive proteome remodeling during starvation by expanding the pool of proteins accessible to cellular proteases, rather than by increasing protease abundance. Phylogenetic analysis shows that SpdA, SpdB, and SpdC are highly conserved across bacteria, with notable homologs including the well-characterized Bacillus subtilis sporulation factors PrkA (SpdA), YhbH (SpdB), and SpoVR (SpdC).
items.abstract_zh: 细菌必须快速适应环境变化，尤其是营养物质的突然缺失。我们此前表明，在葡萄糖饥饿的大肠杆菌中，广泛的饥饿诱导蛋白质降解（SPD）为饥饿后的蛋白质组重塑提供燃料，其降解蛋白质组中的很大一部分，为细胞提供能量和氨基酸以合成应激蛋白。在此，我们证明 SPD 由三种蛋白质组成的高度保守复合体介导：MoxR 型 AAA+ ATP酶 SpdA、von Willebrand 因子 A（vWA）结构域蛋白 SpdB 和锌金属肽酶 SpdC。结构建模和体外重构表明，这些蛋白质形成化学计量比为 6:1:1 的复合体，类似于细菌和真核生物中广泛存在但仍知之甚少的 MoxR-vWA 伴侣复合体家族。对葡萄糖饥饿大肠杆菌细胞中蛋白质降解的测量表明，SpdA、SpdB 和 SpdC 协同介导 SPD 底物的降解。我们的数据表明，它们并非直接降解这些底物，而是有限的结构扰动和蛋白水解“软化”SPD 底物，并促进其被细胞蛋白酶 ClpAP/ClpXP 和 Lon 降解。因此，SPD 通过扩大可被细胞蛋白酶接近的蛋白质池，而非通过增加蛋白酶丰度，在饥饿期间实现广泛的蛋白质组重塑。系统发育分析表明，SpdA、SpdB 和 SpdC 在细菌中高度保守，值得注意的同源物包括已被充分表征的枯草芽孢杆菌芽孢形成因子 PrkA（SpdA）、YhbH（SpdB）和 SpoVR（SpdC）。

items.title_en: Catalytic compression of classical communication in exact entanglement transformations
items.title_zh: 精确纠缠变换中经典通信的催化压缩
items.abstract_en: Entanglement catalysis is usually associated with making otherwise impossible transformations possible. Here we show that it can also change how much classical communication a transformation requires. A catalyst, returned exactly and uncorrelated with the output, can reduce the message alphabet size required for exact transformations of bipartite pure states by a factor that grows without bound as the Schmidt rank increases. In the asymptotic many-copy regime, however, this advantage disappears at the level of the leading communication rate: the optimal catalytic and noncatalytic rates coincide. We characterize the optimal catalytic cost in terms of Rényi entropies, revealing how the entanglement structure of the source and target governs the finite-copy advantage. Our results establish reusable entanglement as a resource for compressing classical communication in quantum state manipulation.
items.abstract_zh: 纠缠催化通常与使原本不可能的变换成为可能相关联。在此，我们表明它也可以改变一个变换需要多少经典通信。一个被精确返还且与输出不相关的催化剂，可以将二分纯态精确变换所需的消息字母表大小降低一个因子，该因子随 Schmidt 秩增加而无界增长。然而，在渐近多副本情形下，这种优势在主导通信速率层面消失：最优催化速率与非催化速率重合。我们用 Rényi 熵刻画最优催化成本，揭示源和目标的纠缠结构如何支配有限副本优势。我们的结果将可重用纠缠确立为一种资源，用于压缩量子态操控中的经典通信。

items.title_en: Spectral Steering: Local Inverse Geometry for Frozen Diffusion Generators
items.title_zh: 谱引导：冻结扩散生成器的局部逆几何
items.abstract_en: A frozen diffusion generator may need to change several output properties while preserving others. We study when guidance faithfully realizes such a structured request and whether local inverse correction improves its direction. Our account links this benefit to the interaction between the request and the objective-specific remaining-sampler Jacobian: conditioning alone is insufficient. Spectral steering combines a request-specific cosine-gain predictor with damped inverse correction and fixed-time relinearization for finite edits. Scalar nulls and matched-movement controls test the predicted mechanism. Across 8,923 instances in a retrospectively identified local regime, predicted and realized gains correlate at Spearman 0.79, versus -0.11 for condition number. Experiments span images, audio, robotics, and control and planning, including complex character motion generation. On 50 paired inpainting cases, four corrections improve unobserved-pixel PSNR over Adam by 3.25 dB at equal total derivative traversals. Together, the analysis and controls connect request-dependent geometry to directional gains and establish where these gains translate into downstream performance.
items.abstract_zh: 冻结的扩散生成器可能需要改变若干输出属性，同时保留其他属性。我们研究引导何时能忠实实现这种结构化请求，以及局部逆校正是否改善其方向。我们的论述将这一收益与请求和特定目标剩余采样器雅可比矩阵之间的交互联系起来：仅靠条件化是不够的。谱引导将请求特定的余弦增益预测器与阻尼逆校正以及用于有限编辑的固定时间重线性化相结合。标量零空间和匹配运动对照检验了所预测的机制。在回顾性识别的局部情形中，跨 8,923 个实例，预测增益与实际增益的相关性为 Spearman 0.79，而条件数为 -0.11。实验涵盖图像、音频、机器人以及控制与规划，包括复杂角色运动生成。在 50 个配对修复案例中，在相同总导数遍历次数下，四次校正将未观测像素 PSNR 较 Adam 提高 3.25 dB。总之，分析和对照将请求依赖的几何与方向增益联系起来，并确定了这些增益在何处转化为下游性能。

items.title_en: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
items.title_zh: 编码智能体的无评估递归自我改进
items.abstract_en: Recent self-improving coding agents have achieved strong benchmark performance by iteratively modifying their own executable implementations. A common pattern uses downstream task-derived evidence to decide which candidates or lineages continue evolving, which we term evaluate-and-select. Obtaining this signal requires repeatedly executing evolved agents on downstream tasks, so broader exploration incurs increasing evaluation cost, while repeated optimization against a fixed evaluation distribution may encourage benchmark-specific adaptation. We ask: can coding agents self-improve without downstream task evaluation inside the evolution loop? We introduce Explore-then-Integrate (ELITE), which integrates implementation mechanisms rather than selecting a single exploratory child to continue the lineage. At each generation, ELITE proposes diverse focused improvements, implements them independently from the same parent, and inspects the resulting programs to identify complementary, redundant, and conflicting mechanisms before reimplementing a compatible subset as one coherent descendant. No downstream task outcomes or task-solving trajectories of evolved candidates are used to guide evolution; only deterministic checks of structural and operational validity are used inside the loop. On SWE-bench Pro, ELITE improves the initial agent from 60.0% to 85.6%, compared with 86.7% for the Darwin Godel Machine (DGM) and 88.3% for the Huxley-Godel Machine (HGM), while using zero candidate task evaluations and reducing observed wall-clock evolution time by 8.8x and 3.2x, respectively, under the evaluated configurations. In cross-benchmark transfer without further adaptation, ELITE averages 73.3% on SWE-bench Verified and 69.3% on Polyglot. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of coding-agent self-improvement without downstream candidate task evaluation in our setting.
items.abstract_zh: 近期自我改进的编码智能体通过迭代修改自身的可执行实现，取得了很强的基准性能。一种常见模式使用下游任务衍生的证据来决定哪些候选或谱系继续演化，我们将其称为“评估并选择”。获得这一信号需要在下游任务上反复执行演化后的智能体，因此更广泛的探索会带来不断增加的评估成本，而针对固定评估分布的重复优化可能鼓励基准特定的适应。我们提出：编码智能体能否在演化循环内部不使用下游任务评估的情况下实现自我改进？我们引入 Explore-then-Integrate（ELITE），它整合实现机制，而不是选择单个探索性子代来延续谱系。在每一代，ELITE 提出多样化的聚焦改进，从同一父代独立实现这些改进，并检查所得程序以识别互补、冗余和冲突的机制，然后将兼容子集重新实现为一个连贯的后代。演化候选的下游任务结果或任务求解轨迹均不用于指导演化；循环内部仅使用对结构和操作有效性的确定性检查。在 SWE-bench Pro 上，ELITE 将初始智能体从 60.0% 提升至 85.6%，而 Darwin Godel Machine（DGM）为 86.7%，Huxley-Godel Machine（HGM）为 88.3%，同时使用零次候选任务评估，并在所评估配置下将观测到的实际耗时演化时间分别减少 8.8 倍和 3.2 倍。在无需进一步适应的跨基准迁移中，ELITE 在 SWE-bench Verified 上平均为 73.3%，在 Polyglot 上为 69.3%。总之，这些结果在我们设定的情形中证明了编码智能体无需下游候选任务评估即可实现自我改进的可行性。

items.title_en: Linglong Agent Service: A Runtime for Centralized Agent Reasoning and Distributed Execution
items.title_zh: Linglong Agent Service：用于集中式智能体推理与分布式执行的运行时
items.abstract_en: LLM agents can use remote tools and cloud sandboxes, but integrating reasoning, session state, and heterogeneous execution sites remains a runtime design problem. We present Linglong Agent Service (agentsvc), a self-hosted HTTP service and embeddable Python runtime that treats execution site as a configurable dimension alongside model, tools, and context. A parent service retains inference orchestration, tool descriptions, and conversation history; each inference request selects one child environment for file, shell, terminal, and MCP operations. Direct HTTP and child-initiated WebSocket tunnels carry the same application interfaces, including portable request context and centrally managed updates. The normal core path requires no third-party Python packages, with an optional Windows pseudo-terminal dependency. We further present online_debugger as the process-scale special case of execution-site separation: an instrumented program submits exception evidence, executes session-scoped inspection tools inside the incident process, and resumes the same diagnostic session. Its default prompt requires failing-then-passing reproduction evidence for source changes, while runtime patch activation and failed-call recovery remain unimplemented. We explain the design through constrained expected-utility reasoning, compare concrete mechanisms with Hermes Agent, Pi, Codex, and Claude Code, and report implementation and regression-test evidence. The current evidence establishes executable contracts, not performance advantages, repair accuracy, or production recovery. The source code is open source under the MIT license at https://github.com/mz24cn/agents.
items.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体可以使用远程工具和云沙箱，但整合推理、会话状态和异构执行站点仍是一个运行时设计问题。我们提出 Linglong Agent Service（agentsvc），一个自托管 HTTP 服务和可嵌入 Python 运行时，它将执行站点视为与模型、工具和上下文并列的可配置维度。父服务保留推理编排、工具描述和对话历史；每个推理请求选择一个子环境用于文件、shell、终端和 MCP 操作。直接 HTTP 和子端发起的 WebSocket 隧道承载相同的应用接口，包括可移植请求上下文和集中管理的更新。正常核心路径不需要第三方 Python 包，仅有一个可选的 Windows 伪终端依赖。我们进一步提出 online_debugger，作为执行站点分离的进程级特例：一个经过插桩的程序提交异常证据，在事件进程内执行会话范围的检查工具，并恢复同一诊断会话。其默认提示要求对源代码更改提供先失败后通过的复现证据，而运行时补丁激活和失败调用恢复仍未实现。我们通过受约束的期望效用推理解释该设计，将具体机制与 Hermes Agent、Pi、Codex 和 Claude Code 进行比较，并报告实现和回归测试证据。当前证据确立了可执行契约，而非性能优势、修复准确性或生产恢复能力。源代码在 MIT 许可证下开源，地址为 https://github.com/mz24cn/agents。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: DRaGAN: Dynamic Graph Attention Network for Multi-Radar Point Cloud Encoding in Automotive Radar Perception
items.title_zh: DRaGAN：用于汽车雷达感知中多雷达点云编码的动态图注意力网络
items.abstract_en: Radar represents a key modality for weather-robust perception. Unlike optical sensors such as camera and LiDAR, radar can penetrate fog, rain and snow due to its longer wavelength, and recent hardware advances have steadily improved its spatial resolution, thus making it increasingly relevant for autonomous systems. While processing raw radar data requires substantial memory computation, most existing work has focused on preprocessed point-cloud data similar to LiDAR. However, the sparse radar points and sensor-relative anisotropy make LiDAR-oriented encoders suboptimal. To address this problem, we present DRaGAN, a dynamic graph attention network for multi-radar point clouds. DRaGAN introduces a sensor-relative Fourier encoding of angle and range to capture fixed-aperture radar characteristics, gated short- and long-range hub nodes along each sensor's line of sight for efficient local-global message passing, and attention-guided dynamic rewiring that prunes weak edges and adds a bounded number of latent connections restricted to two-hop neighborhoods. This reduces the number of processed edges in deeper layers while preserving representation quality. On TruckScenes, DRaGAN improves test NDS by 10.10 points over the evaluated RadarGNN baseline and reduces the reported model FLOP count by 63.7%. This trade-off includes an increase in model latency from 40 to 53.16 ms and in trainable parameters from 1.2M to 1.7M on the evaluated implementations. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/chr-is-tof/DRaGAN.
items.abstract_zh: 雷达是全天候鲁棒感知的关键模态。与相机和LiDAR等光学传感器不同，雷达由于波长更长，可以穿透雾、雨和雪；近期硬件进展也稳步提升了其空间分辨率，使其对自主系统日益重要。处理原始雷达数据需要大量内存计算，而大多数现有工作集中在类似LiDAR的预处理点云数据上。然而，雷达点稀疏以及传感器相对各向异性，使面向LiDAR的编码器并非最优。为解决该问题，我们提出DRaGAN，一种用于多雷达点云的动态图注意力网络。DRaGAN引入角度与距离的传感器相对傅里叶编码以刻画固定孔径雷达特性，沿每个传感器视线设置门控短程和长程枢纽节点以实现高效局部-全局消息传递，并采用注意力引导的动态重连，剪除弱边并添加数量有限且限制在两跳邻域内的潜在连接。这减少了更深层中处理的边数，同时保持表示质量。在TruckScenes上，DRaGAN相比所评估的RadarGNN基线将测试NDS提高10.10点，并将报告的模型FLOP数减少63.7%。这一权衡包括在所评估实现上模型时延从40 ms增加到53.16 ms，可训练参数从1.2M增加到1.7M。代码和预训练模型见https://github.com/chr-is-tof/DRaGAN。

items.title_en: Beyond AUC: Do Mammography Risk Models Predict When Cancer Occurs?
items.title_zh: 超越AUC：乳腺X线摄影风险模型能预测癌症何时发生吗？
items.abstract_en: Longitudinal deep learning models for mammography-based breast cancer risk prediction output either per-year cumulative risks or a discrete distribution over the year of diagnosis, from which cumulative risks F1,...,F5 are derived. These models are evaluated almost exclusively with year-wise AUCs and the concordance index. We show that these metrics are largely insensitive to when cancer occurs: they can be high even for a model that carries no information about the year of diagnosis. We re-evaluate two recent longitudinal models (OA-BreaCR, LMV-Net) on CSAW-CC with a 5-year horizon using timing metrics computed on cancer cases only. Despite C-indices up to 0.75, neither orders cancer cases by time to diagnosis significantly better than chance (c_time 0.51 and 0.55, both 95% CIs covering 0.5). Weighted absolute timing error favours a constant "year 3" prediction over both models, so we use c_time as the primary timing metric. For Mirai's additive-hazard head, also used by LMV-Net, we analyse how per-year increments passed through a ReLU can collapse under severe class imbalance. We also propose a breast-level, two-stage model that separates whether from when. It matches LMV-Net in discrimination (C-index 0.745 vs. 0.746) but orders cancer cases better (c_time 0.58 vs. 0.51, paired 95% CI of the difference 0.01-0.13), on par with Mirai's published weights (0.57).
items.abstract_zh: 用于基于乳腺X线摄影的乳腺癌风险预测的纵向深度学习模型，输出逐年的累积风险或诊断年份上的离散分布，并由此导出累积风险F1,...,F5。这些模型几乎仅用逐年AUC和一致性指数评估。我们表明，这些指标对癌症发生时间基本不敏感：即使模型不包含诊断年份信息，指标也可能很高。我们在CSAW-CC上以5年时间范围重新评估两个近期纵向模型（OA-BreaCR、LMV-Net），使用仅在癌症病例上计算的时间指标。尽管C指数高达0.75，两者按诊断时间对癌症病例排序均未显著优于随机（c_time分别为0.51和0.55，95%CI均覆盖0.5）。加权绝对时间误差表明，恒定“第3年”预测优于两个模型，因此我们使用c_time作为主要时间指标。对于Mirai的加性风险头（LMV-Net也使用），我们分析经过ReLU的逐年增量在严重类别不平衡下如何坍缩。我们还提出一种乳腺级两阶段模型，将“是否”与“何时”分开。该模型在区分度上与LMV-Net相当（C指数0.745 vs. 0.746），但对癌症病例排序更好（c_time 0.58 vs. 0.51，差值配对95%CI为0.01-0.13），与Mirai已发表权重（0.57）相当。

items.title_en: Atomistic Insights into the All-Optical Switching of GdCo Alloys with Minimal Gd Concentration
items.title_zh: 最小Gd浓度下GdCo合金全光翻转的原子尺度研究
items.abstract_en: Single-pulse all-optical helicity-independent switching (AO-HIS) is most commonly observed in Gd-based ferrimagnets near magnetization compensation. Recent experiments, however, demonstrated switching in Pt/Co/Pt-based heterostructures containing only a small amount of Gd at a Co/Pt interface. Here, we use atomistic spin-dynamics simulations to test an effective interfacial GdCo-alloy picture and to determine how species-dependent spin-bath coupling controls the minimum Gd concentration required for reversal. We compare a three-monolayer Co film with Gd confined to the surface layer and a three-dimensional uniformly alloyed GdCo model. Within the present uniform-heating model, robust transient toggle-like reversal is obtained far from compensation when the Gd coupling to the thermal bath is substantially weaker than that of Co; for λCo = 0.02 and λCo = 0.001, reversal occurs down to 1.5 at. % total Gd for selected pulse parameters. Increasing the Gd content accelerates reversal, consistent with the interpretation of Gd as an angular-momentum reservoir, whereas dilute interfacial Gd produces slower and more stochastic dynamics. These results show that compensation is not a fundamental requirement for ultrafast AO-HIS and identify the effective Gd spin-bath coupling as a key control parameter. Quantitative comparison with experiment will require explicit optical absorption, stack-dependent heat flow, dipolar fields, and a stable-final-state switching criterion.
items.abstract_zh: 单脉冲全光螺旋度无关翻转（AO-HIS）最常见于接近磁化补偿的Gd基亚铁磁体。然而，近期实验在Co/Pt界面仅含少量Gd的Pt/Co/Pt基异质结构中展示了翻转。这里，我们使用原子自旋动力学模拟检验有效界面GdCo合金图像，并确定依赖于物种的自旋浴耦合如何控制反转所需的最低Gd浓度。我们比较了Gd限制在表面层的三单层Co薄膜与三维均匀合金化GdCo模型。在当前均匀加热模型中，当Gd与热浴的耦合显著弱于Co时，在远离补偿处可获得稳健的瞬态类toggle翻转；对于λCo = 0.02和λCo = 0.001，在选定脉冲参数下，总Gd低至1.5 at.%仍发生反转。增加Gd含量会加速反转，这与将Gd解释为角动量储库一致；而稀薄界面Gd产生更慢且更随机的动力学。这些结果表明，补偿不是超快AO-HIS的基本要求，并确定有效Gd自旋浴耦合是关键控制参数。与实验的定量比较将需要明确的光吸收、堆叠相关热流、偶极场以及稳定终态翻转判据。

items.title_en: Joint RF-VLP Position and Velocity Tracking: Bayesian Estimation and Performance Analysis
items.title_zh: 联合RF-VLP位置与速度跟踪：贝叶斯估计与性能分析
items.abstract_en: Visible light positioning (VLP) provides accurate indoor positioning through optical received signal strength (RSS) measurements, while radio-frequency (RF) delay and Doppler measurements offer complementary range and velocity information. Motivated by this complementarity, we investigate joint RF--VLP position and velocity tracking, addressing both recursive state estimation and its fundamental performance characteristics. We formulate a Bayesian maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimation problem that combines optical RSS, RF delay and Doppler measurements, and motion prediction, and develop a Gauss--Newton-based algorithm for recursive tracking. To characterize the estimation limits and the benefits of RF--VLP integration, we derive the Bayesian information matrix and the corresponding Bayesian Cramér--Rao lower bound (BCRLB). We further introduce a state-conditioned information matrix (SCIM), whose inverse coincides with the MAP estimator's mean-squared error matrix under a first-order observation model, enabling tractable analysis of RF-induced information gains. The analysis quantifies the distinct contributions of RF delay and Doppler measurements and reveals different asymptotic estimation-error behaviors with respect to RF and VLP signal-to-noise ratios. Numerical results demonstrate improved position and velocity tracking over the considered baselines, with substantial velocity gains from RF sensing. The results also validate the theoretical asymptotic predictions and show that the inverse of the SCIM closely captures the estimator's error trends.
items.abstract_zh: 可见光定位（VLP）通过光学接收信号强度（RSS）测量提供准确的室内定位，而射频（RF）时延和多普勒测量提供互补的距离和速度信息。受此互补性启发，我们研究联合RF-VLP位置与速度跟踪，同时处理递归状态估计及其基本性能特征。我们建立结合光学RSS、RF时延和多普勒测量以及运动预测的贝叶斯最大后验（MAP）估计问题，并开发基于高斯-牛顿的递归跟踪算法。为刻画估计极限及RF-VLP集成的收益，我们推导贝叶斯信息矩阵和相应的贝叶斯克拉美-罗下界（BCRLB）。我们进一步引入状态条件信息矩阵（SCIM），在一阶观测模型下其逆与MAP估计器的均方误差矩阵一致，从而可处理地分析RF带来的信息增益。该分析量化了RF时延和多普勒测量的不同贡献，并揭示估计误差随RF和VLP信噪比的不同渐近行为。数值结果表明，相对于所考虑的基线，位置和速度跟踪得到改善，RF感知带来显著速度增益。结果也验证了理论渐近预测，并表明SCIM的逆密切捕捉估计器的误差趋势。

items.title_en: Marimba: A System One Model for Speech
items.title_zh: Marimba：一种用于语音的系统1模型
items.abstract_en: Speech applications require decisions about term presence, turn completion, and language within an audio window. We present Marimba, an interface for typed speech decisions built on frozen Qwen3-ASR 0.6B features. Lexical questions use zero-shot scoring of ASR transcripts; non-lexical questions use a question-conditioned head and a separate layer-18 turn-end readout. Language identification uses the ASR model's own language scores. On private conversational test sets, decoder AUROC is 0.80-0.92; on public read speech it is 0.92-0.97. Speech Commands four-way accuracy is 0.93; binary lexical ECE is at most 0.08. Personal-information detection, which passes the greedy transcript to a private, curated PII pipeline, reaches item-level F1 0.904 on synthetic Brazilian Portuguese speech (1.000 on reference transcripts). Layer-12 speaker readouts detect speaker change with AUROC 0.966-0.980 on AMI and VoxConverse, above an ECAPA baseline, and count speakers (0, 1, 2, or 3+) more accurately than pyannote 3.1. The turn-end readout reaches AUROC 0.930 versus Smart Turn v3.2 at 0.982 on Smart Turn's own test set. On a subset of ICSI meetings labeled by next speaker, AUROC is 0.716 versus 0.712; the paired confidence interval includes zero.
items.abstract_zh: 语音应用需要在一个音频窗口内对术语是否存在、话轮完成和语言做出决策。我们提出Marimba，一种基于冻结Qwen3-ASR 0.6B特征的类型化语音决策接口。词汇问题使用ASR转录文本的零样本评分；非词汇问题使用问题条件头和一个单独的第18层话轮结束读出。语言识别使用ASR模型自身的语言分数。在私有对话测试集上，解码器AUROC为0.80-0.92；在公开朗读语音上为0.92-0.97。Speech Commands四分类准确率为0.93；二值词汇ECE至多为0.08。个人信息检测将贪婪转录文本传给私有、精心构建的PII流水线，在合成巴西葡萄牙语语音上达到条目级F1 0.904（参考转录文本上为1.000）。第12层说话人读出在AMI和VoxConverse上以AUROC 0.966-0.980检测说话人变化，高于ECAPA基线，并且比pyannote 3.1更准确地计数说话人（0、1、2或3+）。话轮结束读出达到AUROC 0.930，而Smart Turn v3.2在其自身测试集上为0.982。在按下一说话人标注的ICSI会议子集上，AUROC为0.716 vs. 0.712；配对置信区间包含零。

items.title_en: CoopDistill: Equilibrium-Guided Multi-Agent Policy Distillation for Cooperative Driving
items.title_zh: CoopDistill：面向协同驾驶的均衡引导多智能体策略蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Cooperative driving extends autonomous driving from individual vehicle decisions to joint maneuvers that improve traffic safety and efficiency. Optimization-based methods impose safety constraints but often fix paths to simplify multi-vehicle planning, limiting spatial flexibility. Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) explores alternatives through interaction, but coordinated learning and safe execution remain challenging. Their integration nevertheless faces challenges in exploration efficiency, experience allocation, and execution reliability. To address these challenges, this paper proposes CoopDistill, an equilibrium-guided multi-agent policy distillation framework. A potential-game (PG) formulation provides a fixed-path longitudinal reference, around which a residual MARL policy learns longitudinal acceleration, conflict-approach timing, and lateral path corrections. A hard-case curriculum concentrates experience on interactions that PG leaves unresolved or substantially delayed. A comparative rollout selector evaluates the joint consequences of learned corrections against PG before choosing the executed action. Experiments in merging, roundabout, and intersection scenarios compare CoopDistill with six baselines at four connected automated vehicle penetration levels. Relative to PG, success improves by 2.1--27.1 percentage points and delay decreases by 7.3--27.3\%, with no observed collisions. Code is available at https://github.com/FanGShiYuu/CoopDistill
items.abstract_zh: 协同驾驶将自动驾驶从单车决策扩展到可提高交通安全与效率的联合机动。基于优化的方法施加安全约束，但通常固定路径以简化多车规划，限制了空间灵活性。多智能体强化学习（MARL）通过交互探索替代方案，但协调学习和安全执行仍具挑战性。然而二者的集成在探索效率、经验分配和执行可靠性方面仍面临挑战。为解决这些挑战，本文提出CoopDistill，一种均衡引导的多智能体策略蒸馏框架。势博弈（PG）公式提供固定路径纵向参考，残差MARL策略围绕该参考学习纵向加速度、冲突接近时机和横向路径修正。困难案例课程将经验集中在PG未解决或显著延迟的交互上。比较式滚动选择器在选择执行动作之前，评估学习到的修正相对于PG的联合后果。在汇入、环岛和交叉口场景中的实验，在四个联网自动驾驶汽车渗透率水平下将CoopDistill与六个基线进行比较。相对于PG，成功率提高2.1--27.1个百分点，延迟降低7.3--27.3%，未观察到碰撞。代码见https://github.com/FanGShiYuu/CoopDistill。

items.title_en: vividRGB: Various visual cue detection in RGB photographs with forced focused attention
items.title_zh: vividRGB：在RGB照片中通过强制聚焦注意力进行多种视觉线索检测
items.abstract_en: Natural photographs contain dense, overlapping structures that can be weakly expressed in feature maps from whole-image vision encoders. We introduce forced focused attention (FFA) and its Python implementation, vividRGB. FFA is an encoder-agnostic inference-time procedure that applies a frozen encoder to enlarged, overlapping local crops, averages inverse-aligned reflections, and reconstructs a feature field in source coordinates. We evaluate 50 high-resolution photographs from grassland vegetation, fungal networks, airborne forests, coral reefs, and phytoplankton microscopy, using DINOv3 ViT-B/16. Across the five domains, FFA at 5% or 10% focus produces higher mean RGB-edge boundary F1 than direct DINOv3 encoding and automatic SAM3 masks. Domain means range from 0.244 to 0.596 for FFA, versus 0.028-0.076 for direct DINOv3 and 0.020-0.090 for SAM3. Qualitative feature maps also show finer appearance structure. These results concern RGB-edge preservation rather than verified species, traits, or biological segmentation. Narrower focus generally improves boundary preservation, while extraction time and GPU energy use increase sharply and gains diminish at finer settings. FFA may be useful for relatively small, high-resolution ecological image collections where dense visual cues matter. The alpha release vividRGB 0.1.0 and versioned research resources support reproducible cue inspection.
items.abstract_zh: 自然照片包含密集、重叠的结构，这些结构在全图视觉编码器生成的特征图中可能仅被弱表达。我们提出强制聚焦注意力（FFA）及其Python实现vividRGB。FFA是一种与编码器无关的推理时流程：将冻结编码器应用于放大且重叠的局部裁剪，对逆对齐反射取平均，并在源坐标中重建特征场。我们使用DINOv3 ViT-B/16评估来自草地植被、真菌网络、空中森林、珊瑚礁和浮游植物显微成像的50张高分辨率照片。在五个领域中，5%或10%聚焦的FFA产生的平均RGB边缘边界F1高于直接DINOv3编码和自动SAM3掩码。FFA的领域均值为0.244至0.596，而直接DINOv3为0.028–0.076，SAM3为0.020–0.090。定性特征图也显示出更精细的外观结构。这些结果关注的是RGB边缘保留，而非经过验证的物种、性状或生物分割。更窄的聚焦通常改善边界保留，但提取时间和GPU能耗急剧增加，且在更细设置下收益递减。FFA可能适用于相对较小、高分辨率且密集视觉线索重要的生态图像集合。alpha版本vividRGB 0.1.0和带版本的研究资源支持可复现的线索检查。

items.title_en: An In-Silico Audit of Topographic Organization in a Multimodal Brain-Response Model
items.title_zh: 多模态脑响应模型中拓扑组织的计算机模拟审计
items.abstract_en: TRIBE v2 (d'Ascoli et al., 2026) predicts fMRI responses across the cortical surface from video, audio and text. Its authors validated it with category-selective localizers (faces, places, bodies, words) and language contrasts, but not with the classic topographic organization of sensory cortex: retinotopy, tonotopy, and motion selectivity in area MT+. There is a clear architectural reason to expect retinotopy to fail: TRIBE's video features are averaged over space before the response head, which should discard visual-field position. I present mapping stimuli, a fitting pipeline adapted from standard fMRI mapping analyses, and a stand-in model with known ground truth that serves as a positive and negative control, and apply them to TRIBE v2's predictions, comparing the fitted maps with human atlases using spin tests. TRIBE v2 shows a sharp split. There is no contralateral hemifield response and no polar-angle map, robustly across stimulus controls. There is no tonotopic gradient in primary auditory cortex: best frequencies span an interquartile range of only 0.14 octaves across core and belt, and the null persists with loudness-equalized tones. An eccentricity-like gradient appears only when the ring geometry changes, consistent with global image statistics rather than a positional code. In contrast, motion selectivity is strong and precisely localized: 22% of the 1% most motion-selective vertices fall in MT+, which covers 0.42% of cortex. In-silico experiments that depend on feature identity appear viable with TRIBE v2, while those that depend on visual-field or frequency position are not supported by the current model.
items.abstract_zh: TRIBE v2（d'Ascoli等，2026）从视频、音频和文本预测整个皮层表面的fMRI响应。其作者用类别选择性定位器（面孔、场景、身体、词语）和语言对比对其进行了验证，但未用感觉皮层的经典拓扑组织进行验证：视网膜拓扑、音调拓扑以及MT+区的运动选择性。存在明确的架构原因预期视网膜拓扑会失败：TRIBE的视频特征在响应头之前对空间进行了平均，这应会丢弃视野位置。我提出映射刺激、一种改编自标准fMRI映射分析的拟合流程，以及一个具有已知真实值并作为阳性和阴性对照的替代模型，并将其应用于TRIBE v2的预测，使用旋转检验将拟合图与人类图谱进行比较。TRIBE v2显示出明显分化。在多种刺激控制下稳健地不存在对侧半视野响应，也不存在极角图。初级听觉皮层中没有音调拓扑梯度：在核心区和带区，最佳频率的四分位距仅为0.14个倍频程，且在响度均衡的音调下零结果仍然存在。类偏心度梯度仅在环形几何改变时出现，这与全局图像统计一致，而非位置编码。相比之下，运动选择性强且定位精确：运动选择性最强的1%顶点中有22%落在MT+，而MT+仅占皮层0.42%。依赖特征身份的计算机模拟实验在TRIBE v2上似乎可行，而依赖视野或频率位置的实验则不受当前模型支持。

items.title_en: Geometry-Derived Capacitance Dyadics with Floquet Sideband Correction for Anisotropic Periodic Patch Metasurfaces
items.title_zh: 用于各向异性周期贴片超表面的几何导出电容并矢与Floquet边带校正
items.abstract_en: Homogenised sheet models describe periodic metallic patch layers using a scalar sheet capacitance, which is only valid when the effective response is isotropic. An isotropic response exists for unit cells with patch geometries that have rotational symmetry of order three or higher. Lower-symmetry unit cells with irregular or random geometries generically require a full 2 x 2 surface-capacitance dyadic. We present a framework that computes this dyadic directly from the arbitrary gap-connected patch geometry on a unit cell of a hexagonal lattice. The two-dimensional Bravais periodicity fixes the two independent macroscopic loading directions, the connectivity of the gap ensures a full-rank response for the geometries considered here, and the point-group symmetry of the patch constrains the form of the dyadic. A quasi-static boundary value problem on a single periodic cell then determines its independent entries. We use the surface-capacitance dyadic in the anisotropic surface- wave dispersion relation, which includes the leading spatially-dispersive first shell Floquet-sideband correction. For each new patch geometry, the dyadic and the first-shell correction are obtained from a single quasi-static cell problem and from the reconstructed boundary. So anisotropic surface- wave dispersion follows without a per-geometry full-wave eigenmode band sweep or sheet-tensor retrieval. We validate this geometry-to-dispersion chain against full-wave eigenmode simulations across six representative symmetry classes, showing that the correction captures band flattening near the Brillouin-zone boundary and improves agreement relative to the local dyadic model.
items.abstract_zh: 均匀化薄片模型使用标量薄片电容描述周期金属贴片层，这仅在有效响应为各向同性时有效。对于具有三阶或更高阶旋转对称的贴片几何形状的晶胞，存在各向同性响应。具有不规则或随机几何形状的低对称性晶胞通常需要完整的2×2表面电容并矢。我们提出一个框架，可直接从六角晶格晶胞上任意间隙连接的贴片几何形状计算该并矢。二维Bravais周期性固定两个独立的宏观加载方向，间隙的连接性确保此处考虑的几何形状具有满秩响应，贴片的点群对称性约束并矢的形式。然后，单个周期单元上的准静态边值问题确定其独立元素。我们在各向异性表面波色散关系中使用表面电容并矢，其中包括主导的空间色散第一壳层Floquet边带校正。对于每种新的贴片几何形状，并矢和第一壳层校正均从单个准静态单元问题以及重构边界获得。因此，无需针对每种几何形状进行全波本征模能带扫描或薄片张量反演，即可得到各向异性表面波色散。我们在六个代表性对称类上针对全波本征模仿真验证了这条从几何到色散的链路，表明该校正捕捉了布里渊区边界附近的能带平坦化，并相对于局部并矢模型提高了吻合度。

items.title_en: Hyperlyve: Parallelized Enumeration and Exact Lyapunov Stability Certification for Deep ReLU Networks
items.title_zh: Hyperlyve：深度ReLU网络的并行枚举与精确Lyapunov稳定性认证
items.abstract_en: We introduce Hyperlyve (Hyperplane Partitioned Lyapunov Verification and Enumeration), a framework for proving the asymptotic stability of nonlinear dynamical systems, including those with neural network controllers. Hyperlyve learns and formally certifies continuous piecewise-affine (CPA) neural Lyapunov functions within a counterexample-guided inductive synthesis (CEGIS) loop. Hyperlyve's key innovation is a parallel algorithm that enumerates the hyperplane arrangement formed by the ReLU activations of deep networks and certifies that Lyapunov conditions hold within each polyhedral region. We derive sound and complete regional tests to verify the asymptotic stability of the exact smooth dynamics (rather than a piecewise-linear approximation) within a compact domain of interest. Furthermore, we formally characterize the computational complexity of the CPA neural Lyapunov verification problem as co-NP-complete, filling a key gap in the literature. Empirical results demonstrate that Hyperlyve enumerates ReLU networks over 150-times faster than competing tools, which contributes to Hyperlyve proving the asymptotic stability of systems that are currently intractable for state-of-the-art verifiers.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出Hyperlyve（Hyperplane Partitioned Lyapunov Verification and Enumeration，超平面划分Lyapunov验证与枚举），一个用于证明非线性动力系统渐近稳定性的框架，包括带有神经网络控制器的系统。Hyperlyve在反例引导归纳合成（CEGIS）循环中学习并形式化认证连续分段仿射（CPA）神经网络Lyapunov函数。Hyperlyve的关键创新是一种并行算法，它枚举深度网络ReLU激活形成的超平面排列，并认证在每个多面体区域内Lyapunov条件成立。我们推导出可靠且完备的区域测试，以在感兴趣的紧致域内验证精确光滑动力学（而非分段线性近似）的渐近稳定性。此外，我们形式化刻画了CPA神经网络Lyapunov验证问题的计算复杂度为co-NP完全，填补了文献中的关键空白。实证结果表明，Hyperlyve枚举ReLU网络的速度比竞争工具快150倍以上，这有助于Hyperlyve证明当前最先进验证器难以处理的系统的渐近稳定性。

items.title_en: Invariant-Aware Harness Enforcement to Protect LLM Agents from Silent API Failures
items.title_zh: 不变量感知的框架强制执行以保护LLM智能体免受静默API故障影响
items.abstract_en: LLM agents answer questions by calling APIs and trusting the results. An API can fail silently. It ignores part of a request, such as a misnamed filter, yet returns HTTP 200 and a plausible but wrong result. Current fixes, such as checklists, reviewer models and LLM judges, ask the model to catch it. But models often see the problem and answer anyway. We present SilentGuard, which moves the decision from the model to the harness running tool calls. It tests each result against invariants that any correct API must satisfy and withholds values that break one. We find silent failures in 11 of 15 public research APIs, with counts inflated up to 691 times. Current fixes leave over 70% of answers wrong, and agents report 77.4% of counts a judge flags. Across 7 open models, SilentGuard cuts wrong answers on its target faults from 74.0% to 1.7%, with no loss on fault-free tasks. On three frontier models they fall from 70.2% to 0.5%. A warning from the same check leaves 70.1% wrong, so enforcement is the key. On new fault types, the harness alone cuts wrong answers from 61.1% to 24.5%. It avoids wrong answers by abstaining rather than recovering.
items.abstract_zh: LLM智能体通过调用API并信任结果来回答问题。API可能静默失败。它忽略请求的一部分，例如名称错误的过滤器，却返回HTTP 200和看似合理但错误的结果。当前修复方法，如检查清单、评审模型和LLM评判器，要求模型捕捉该问题。但模型常常看到了问题仍然给出答案。我们提出SilentGuard，它将决策从模型转移到运行工具调用的执行框架。它根据任何正确API都必须满足的不变量测试每个结果，并扣留违反某个不变量的值。我们在15个公共研究API中的11个发现静默故障，计数被夸大最高达691倍。当前修复方法使超过70%的答案仍然错误，智能体报告了评判器标记的计数的77.4%。在7个开源模型上，SilentGuard将其目标故障上的错误答案从74.0%降至1.7%，且在无故障任务上无损失。在三个前沿模型上，错误答案从70.2%降至0.5%。同一检查仅发出警告时仍有70.1%错误，因此强制执行是关键。在新故障类型上，仅该执行框架就将错误答案从61.1%降至24.5%。它通过弃权而非恢复来避免错误答案。

items.title_en: QTOP: Scaling Humanoid Motion Tracking with Quantile Critics
items.title_zh: QTOP：利用分位数评论家扩展人形运动跟踪
items.abstract_en: Learning human motion tracking policies through reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a core capability that underpins a majority of recent progress in humanoid whole-body control. However, achieving generalization to unseen motions at high fidelity requires jointly scaling training to thousands of GPU and dataset hours. This work hypothesizes that motion tracking is inherently compute-bound because training on a diverse set of motions introduces learning interference, similar to multi-task RL. To tackle this, we propose Quantile Tracking Optimization (QTOP), which improves sample efficiency by introducing a distributional advantage estimate conditioned on state and reference pairs. QTOP outperforms on and off-policy RL baselines both in simulation and real-world tracking scenarios on multiple datasets by up to 10\%. Furthermore, we establish a scaling law for QTOP and find that, aside from scaling predictably, dataset size has minimal impact on performance for moderately sized GPU hour regimes.
items.abstract_zh: 通过强化学习（RL）学习人体运动跟踪策略已成为一项核心能力，支撑了人形全身控制近期的大部分进展。然而，要以高保真度泛化到未见运动，需要将训练联合扩展到数千GPU小时和数据集小时。本工作假设运动跟踪本质上是计算受限的，因为在多样化运动集合上训练会引入学习干扰，类似于多任务RL。为解决此问题，我们提出分位数跟踪优化（QTOP），它通过引入以状态和参考对为条件的分布优势估计来提高样本效率。QTOP在仿真和真实世界跟踪场景中、在多个数据集上，以最高10%的优势优于同策略和离策略RL基线。此外，我们建立了QTOP的缩放定律，并发现除了可预测地扩展外，在中等GPU小时规模下，数据集大小对性能影响极小。

items.title_en: PanDWM: Panoramic 4D Driving World Models
items.title_zh: PanDWM：全景4D驾驶世界模型
items.abstract_en: Driving world models usually generate videos from six pinhole cameras with separate optical centres and small overlaps, and must learn to keep these views consistent. We present PanDWM, which stitches them into one $360^\circ$ panoramic band. Camera boundaries then fall inside one image, so keeping the views consistent means keeping the image continuous, and each pixel still records its camera ray. Conditioned on layouts, a causal student generates the band window by window in four steps; it is distilled from a causal teacher and trained on its own rollouts. A feed-forward decoder lifts each frame along these rays into 3D Gaussians, and static Gaussians from neighbouring frames complete them into 4D scenes. On nuScenes, scored in one stitched $360^\circ$ view, PanDWM has lower FID and FVD than the multi-camera baselines at $8$-$46\times$ their speed, and keeps its 50-step teacher's FID while lowering FVD by 22-25%.
items.abstract_zh: 驾驶世界模型通常从六个具有独立光心和小重叠区域的针孔相机生成视频，并且必须学习保持这些视图一致。我们提出PanDWM，将它们拼接成一个360°全景条带。相机边界于是落入同一幅图像内部，因此保持视图一致就意味着保持图像连续，而每个像素仍记录其相机光线。以布局为条件，因果学生模型分四步逐窗口生成该条带；它从因果教师模型蒸馏而来，并在自身rollout上训练。前馈解码器沿这些光线将每一帧提升为3D高斯，来自相邻帧的静态高斯将其补全为4D场景。在nuScenes上，在单个拼接的360°视图中评分时，PanDWM的FID和FVD低于多相机基线，速度是后者的8–46倍，并保持其50步教师模型的FID，同时将FVD降低22–25%。

items.title_en: S1Pert: Scalable Target-Specific Gene Response Prediction with System-One Intelligence
items.title_zh: S1Pert：基于System-One智能的可扩展靶标特异性基因响应预测
items.abstract_en: Predicting transcriptional responses to unseen genetic perturbations is essential for extending CRISPR screens across vast target--gene combinations. However, models can achieve strong aggregate predictive performance by reproducing historical gene-level response frequencies without adequately distinguishing the effects of different perturbations. Reliable prediction at the transcriptome scale is further challenged by uncertain response labels and redundant computation across millions of target--gene pairs. We present S1Pert, a System-One framework for target-specific gene response prediction with non-autoregressive online inference. S1Pert combines directional Welch tests and equivalence testing to distinguish statistically supported responses from inconclusive observations. A frozen System-One encoder extracts reusable semantic representations of perturbation targets, query genes, and historical evidence. Compact pair-specific interactions are then computed and cached offline. A lightweight hierarchical cross-attention decoder integrates these representations with cross-target pairwise ranking and synchronized historical-evidence dropout to reduce reliance on gene-level response frequencies. Extensive experiments demonstrate that S1Pert improves target-specific response discrimination while maintaining reliable prediction and efficient inference across diverse cellular contexts. These findings highlight the potential of System-One decision learning for scalable perturbation-response prediction beyond historical gene-level response tendencies. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/liujiawen-jpg/S1Pert.
items.abstract_zh: 预测对未见遗传扰动的转录响应对于将CRISPR筛选扩展到海量靶标–基因组合至关重要。然而，模型可以通过复现历史基因水平响应频率来获得很强的总体预测性能，却未能充分区分不同扰动的效应。转录组规模上的可靠预测还受到不确定的响应标签以及数百万靶标–基因对上的冗余计算挑战。我们提出S1Pert，一个采用非自回归在线推理进行靶标特异性基因响应预测的System-One框架。S1Pert结合方向性Welch检验和等效性检验，将有统计支持的响应与无定论观察区分开。冻结的System-One编码器提取扰动靶标、查询基因和历史证据的可复用语义表示。随后计算紧凑的配对特异性交互并离线缓存。轻量级分层交叉注意力解码器将这些表示与跨靶标成对排序和同步历史证据丢弃相结合，以降低对基因水平响应频率的依赖。大量实验表明，S1Pert在多样细胞情境中提高了靶标特异性响应区分能力，同时保持可靠预测和高效推理。这些发现凸显了System-One决策学习在超越历史基因水平响应倾向的可扩展扰动–响应预测中的潜力。源代码公开于https://github.com/liujiawen-jpg/S1Pert。

items.title_en: Polarization waves in open-barrier quantum-dot cellular automata
items.title_zh: 开放势垒量子点元胞自动机中的极化波
items.abstract_en: Quantum-dot cellular automata (QCA) are almost always operated as bistable digital logic. We develop a closed-form theory of small-signal polarization waves in the open-barrier regime, where tunnelling within each cell is comparable to or stronger than the electrostatic kink coupling between cells, so that a line of cells responds linearly instead of latching. Linearizing the coherence-vector equations of the intercellular Hartree approximation (ICHA) about the unpolarized state gives a lattice dispersion with a low-frequency cutoff, an evanescent band below it and a Klein-Gordon long-wavelength limit, and relaxation toward the instantaneous equilibrium damps the waves at a rate that depends on the wavenumber. The exact Jordan-Wigner solution and exact diagonalization confirm the mode as a sharp quasiparticle, with ICHA frequencies within 6% of the exact ones once the tunnelling energy is at least twice the kink energy, and show that the exact chain also carries waves over a range of couplings where the ICHA predicts latching. A leading low-temperature estimate of thermal dephasing sets a ceiling on the operating temperature of about 13.6 K per terahertz of gap for a carrier that keeps its phase over 30 periods. At junctions the waves scatter through a lattice scattering matrix that reaches the familiar transmission-line value only at mid-band.
items.abstract_zh: 量子点元胞自动机（QCA）几乎总是作为双稳态数字逻辑运行。我们建立了开放势垒区制中小信号极化波的闭式理论；在该区制中，每个元胞内的隧穿与元胞间静电扭结耦合相当或更强，因此一条元胞链线性响应而非锁存。将元胞间Hartree近似（ICHA）的相干矢量方程在未极化态附近线性化，得到具有低频截止的晶格色散、其下方的倏逝带以及Klein-Gordon长波极限，而向瞬时平衡的弛豫以依赖于波数的速率阻尼这些波。精确Jordan-Wigner解和精确对角化确认该模式为尖锐准粒子：一旦隧穿能量至少为扭结能量的两倍，ICHA频率与精确频率的偏差在6%以内；并表明精确链在ICHA预测锁存的一定耦合范围内也承载波。对热退相位的领先低温估计给出了工作温度上限：对于在30个周期内保持相位的载波，每太赫兹能隙约为13.6 K。在结处，波通过晶格散射矩阵散射，该矩阵仅在中频带达到熟悉的传输线值。

items.title_en: Surrogate-Assisted Compact-Model Extraction for SKY130 CMOS at 77 K
items.title_zh: 77 K下SKY130 CMOS的代理辅助紧凑模型提取
items.abstract_en: Cryogenic circuit design requires compact transistor models that reproduce measured low-temperature behavior and run in standard circuit simulators. We fit BSIM4 parameters to measured I-V curves of SkyWater 130 nm (SKY130) transistors at 77 K using a neural surrogate of NGSpice. The surrogate maps compact-model parameters and device geometry to the complete set of output and transfer characteristics. Extraction is a bounded least-squares search: a bank of NGSpice simulations supplies initial candidates, finite differences of the surrogate supply the local Jacobian, and NGSpice re-simulates the resulting cards before selection. On 18 measured geometries, we compare a search over seven card parameters with a search over 43 parameters selected by NGSpice sensitivity. Relative to NGSpice re-simulations of the previously released cards, the two searches reduce the in-sample mean relative root-mean-square error (RRMS) by 17% and 26%, respectively. The 43-parameter search has the lower overall error, but the seven-parameter search has the lower mean on high-bias curves, and some individual curves have higher error than with the released cards under both searches.
items.abstract_zh: 低温电路设计需要能够复现实测低温行为并在标准电路仿真器中运行的紧凑晶体管模型。我们使用NGSpice的神经代理模型，将BSIM4参数拟合到77 K下SkyWater 130 nm（SKY130）晶体管的实测I-V曲线。该代理模型将紧凑模型参数和器件几何映射到完整的输出与转移特性集。提取是一个有界最小二乘搜索：一组NGSpice仿真提供初始候选，代理模型的有限差分提供局部雅可比矩阵，NGSpice在筛选前重新仿真所得模型卡。在18个测量几何上，我们比较了对七个模型卡参数的搜索与对由NGSpice灵敏度选出的43个参数的搜索。相对于对先前发布模型卡的NGSpice重新仿真，两种搜索分别将样本内平均相对均方根误差（RRMS）降低17%和26%。43参数搜索的总体误差更低，但七参数搜索在高偏置曲线上的均值更低，且在两种搜索下，一些单条曲线的误差高于已发布模型卡。

items.title_en: Jetriever: Shifting Agent Memory Retrieval from Similarity to Utility
items.title_zh: Jetriever：将智能体记忆检索从相似性转向效用
items.abstract_en: A useful memory need not resemble the question it helps answer. Jetriever ranks each stored memory by Jev's decision score for its usefulness to the current question, replacing similarity search with full-pool utility scoring. On InMind's 125 indirect-query tasks, it places the gold exchange first in 84.8% of cases; matched BM25 and MiniLM controls reach 1.6% and 0.0% when indexing user turns. A 20-question comparison separates finding evidence from ranking it: Jev and Qwen3.5 9B each find 90% of gold exchanges by rank 50, while Laya finds 30%; at rank one, Jev reaches 85% and Qwen3.5 9B 40%. On a dimension-proportional random sample of 60 MemoryAgentBench questions, Jetriever's four-dimension score is 55.4%, against 44.3% for ReFind on the same questions. Jev retrieval costs USD 0.00834 per InMind question and USD 0.03103 per MAB question on average. These results show the value of world knowledge, scores that rank decisive memories first, and affordable full-pool scoring.
items.abstract_zh: 有用的记忆不必与其帮助回答的问题相似。Jetriever按Jev对当前问题有用性的决策分数对每个存储记忆排序，以全池效用评分取代相似性搜索。在InMind的125个间接查询任务上，它在84.8%的情况下将金标准交换排在第一位；在索引用户轮次时，匹配的BM25和MiniLM对照分别达到1.6%和0.0%。一项20题比较将找到证据与对其排序区分开：Jev和Qwen3.5 9B在排名50以内各自找到90%的金标准交换，而Laya找到30%；在排名第一处，Jev达到85%，Qwen3.5 9B为40%。在60个MemoryAgentBench问题的维度比例随机样本上，Jetriever的四维分数为55.4%，而ReFind在相同问题上为44.3%。Jev检索平均每个InMind问题花费0.00834美元，每个MAB问题花费0.03103美元。这些结果显示了世界知识的价值、将决定性记忆排在最前的评分，以及可负担的全池评分。

items.title_en: ExtremeDrive: A Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for Critical Driving
items.title_zh: ExtremeDrive：用于关键驾驶的真实世界数据集与基准
items.abstract_en: Existing autonomous driving datasets and benchmarks provide extensive resources for routine driving, yet real-world data covering safety-critical scenarios and extreme environmental conditions remain limited. To address this gap, we present ExtremeDrive, a real-world dataset and benchmark covering emergency maneuvers, complex traffic interactions, and adverse conditions such as slippery or snow-covered roads, alongside routine driving. The dataset comprises 589 driving scenes curated from a larger pool of real-world driving recordings, with calibrated and aligned multisensor data and reviewed annotations of road structure and traffic participants. We further establish a benchmark to evaluate planned trajectories through simulated vehicle execution, measuring safety-related metrics and driving performance. Experiments at equal training set sizes show that incorporating critical driving data reduces trajectory prediction errors and improves mean critical-success rates in critical scenarios. ExtremeDrive provides a unified resource for learning and evaluating autonomous driving in safety-critical scenarios and extreme environmental conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 现有自动驾驶数据集与基准为常规驾驶提供了广泛资源，但覆盖安全关键场景和极端环境条件的真实世界数据仍然有限。为填补这一空白，我们提出ExtremeDrive，一个覆盖紧急机动、复杂交通交互以及湿滑或积雪道路等不利条件并包含常规驾驶的真实世界数据集与基准。该数据集包含从更大的真实世界驾驶记录池中筛选出的589个驾驶场景，具有经过校准与对齐的多传感器数据，以及经审核的道路结构和交通参与者标注。我们进一步建立基准，通过模拟车辆执行来评估规划轨迹，测量安全相关指标和驾驶性能。在相同训练集规模下的实验表明，纳入关键驾驶数据可降低轨迹预测误差，并提高关键场景中的平均关键成功率。ExtremeDrive为在安全关键场景和极端环境条件下学习和评估自动驾驶提供了统一资源。

items.title_en: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
items.title_zh: LynnReal-Hand：以手部控制解锁世界交互
items.abstract_en: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.
items.abstract_zh: 交互式视频世界模型能够通过文本和相机控制进行探索，但直接的对象交互需要更精细的控制。手提供了自然的接口，然而由于复杂的手-物动力学和高要求的实时计算，将连续手部运动转化为连贯的视觉响应仍然具有挑战性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 LynnReal-Hand，一种手控视频世界模型，将精确的交互建模与高效的流式生成统一起来。我们整理了 10 万个交互片段，涵盖多样的真实和合成环境，并开发了手部感知监督，以改善细粒度手部运动和对象交互。在此基础上，我们学习用于少步生成的因果流映射，并引入区域感知分数蒸馏，结合互补的视频和图像先验来细化交互动力学和视觉外观。为进一步降低推理延迟，我们提出 Ultra-Fast-VAE，一种紧凑的视频解码器，在显著降低计算成本的同时保持高重建保真度。在 HandBench 上的大量评估表明，与现有方法相比，其具有更优的手部跟随准确性和视觉质量。我们的全序列模型达到 181.67 的 FVD 和 93.02 的 MANO Dice 分数，而三步因果模型保持 92.49 的 MANO Dice 分数。对于实时交互，在单张 H200 上进行 540p 流式传输达到 18.03 FPS，延迟为 741ms，优化后的峰值 GPU 内存占用仅为 34.89GB。我们将发布数据集、模型权重以及完整的训练和推理代码，以支持手控视频世界模型的研究。

items.title_en: Mechanism-Level Chemical Reaction Simulation with Electron Bookkeeping Transformer
items.title_zh: 基于电子记账 Transformer 的机理级化学反应模拟
items.abstract_en: Modeling chemical reaction mechanisms is central to understanding and predicting chemical reactivity. We present Electron Bookkeeping Transformer (Bookkeeper), a data-driven model that simulates chemical reactions at mechanistic resolution by generating electron movement trajectories. Following the symbolic arrow-pushing formalism in chemistry, Bookkeeper explicitly models each electron as a token and predicts its movement sequentially, ensuring mass and charge conservation during both elementary step and reaction pathway predictions by construction. On reaction-size-balanced test sets, Bookkeeper improves top-1 elementary-step accuracy, top-1 pathway rank accuracy, and top-1 to top-5 product prediction accuracy over FlowER. On the entire test set, it achieves higher elementary-step top-1 accuracy but lower pathway accuracy than FlowER. Bookkeeper also samples elementary steps substantially faster, adapts to several unseen reaction types with minimal fine-tuning, and generates candidate chemical transformations for further screening. These results suggest that explicit electron bookkeeping is a useful framework for virtually screening chemical reactions across diverse reagents, validating computer-assisted synthesis planning predictions, and providing mechanistic interpretations of reactivity.
items.abstract_zh: 对化学反应机理进行建模是理解和预测化学反应性的核心。我们提出 Electron Bookkeeping Transformer（Bookkeeper），一种数据驱动模型，通过生成电子移动轨迹在机理分辨率上模拟化学反应。遵循化学中的符号化推箭头形式化方法，Bookkeeper 将每个电子显式建模为一个 token，并顺序预测其移动，从而在构造上确保基元步骤和反应路径预测过程中的质量和电荷守恒。在按反应规模平衡的测试集上，Bookkeeper 相较于 FlowER 提高了 top-1 基元步骤准确率、top-1 路径排名准确率以及 top-1 到 top-5 产物预测准确率。在整个测试集上，它实现了更高的基元步骤 top-1 准确率，但路径准确率低于 FlowER。Bookkeeper 对基元步骤的采样速度也显著更快，能够以极少的微调适应多种未见反应类型，并生成候选化学转化以供进一步筛选。这些结果表明，显式电子记账是一个有用的框架，可用于跨多样试剂的化学反应虚拟筛选、验证计算机辅助合成规划预测，并提供反应性的机理诠释。

items.title_en: Metallic or insulating magnetic phases of transition-metal oxides in light of the Slater vs Mott controversy
items.title_zh: 从 Slater 与 Mott 之争看过渡金属氧化物的金属或绝缘磁性相
items.abstract_en: Magnetic d-electron oxides usually have a long-range-ordered ground state and an above-ground-state disordered para phase. The historical Slater-Mott controversy still reverberating to date pertains to understanding the origin of the insulating vs metallic nature of these two phases. Slater suggested that the insulating character evolved from the long-range order (LRO) antiferromagnetic (AFM) cell-doubling, leading to energy band repulsion and thus to forming a band gap. The reliance on LRO to explain gapping suggests that the absence of LRO in the spin-disordered para-phase would deprive the system from band repulsion, thus predicting a metallic paramagnetic (PM) phase. This, however, conflicts with numerous current observations. The alternative Mott-Peierls-Hubbard view abandons the mean-field-like band structure view emphasizing instead the local interelectronic repulsion U as a strong correlation signature of gapping both at the presence or absence of LRO. However, U is not an easily measured or calculated quantity in periodic systems, a situation often leading in practice to treating U as an adjustable parameter. The current work uses a parameter-free mean-field-like approach (Density Functional Theory, DFT), allowing energy-lowering symmetry breaking. This is done by considering local magnetic motifs as building blocks of the macroscopic AFM or PM phases. It is found that even when such motifs are isolated electronically from each other (i.e. vanishing LRO) by embedding them in quantum barriers (such as magnetic NiO6 octahedra surrounded locally by wide-gap MgO) they exhibit an intrinsic band gap. Thus, the origin of the band gaps in AFM or PM phases need not be LRO or strong correlation and can be understood within the mean-field-like band structure approach with symmetry breaking.
items.abstract_zh: 磁性 d 电子氧化物通常具有长程有序基态和高于基态的无序顺磁相。至今仍有回响的 Slater–Mott 历史争论涉及理解这两个相的绝缘与金属性质的起源。Slater 提出，绝缘特性源于长程有序（LRO）反铁磁（AFM）的晶胞加倍，导致能带排斥，从而形成带隙。对 LRO 解释带隙形成的依赖意味着，自旋无序顺磁相中 LRO 的缺失会使系统失去能带排斥，从而预测出金属性顺磁（PM）相。然而，这与当前大量观察相冲突。另一种 Mott–Peierls–Hubbard 观点放弃了类平均场能带结构观点，转而强调局域电子间排斥 U 作为在 LRO 存在或缺失时形成带隙的强关联特征。然而，U 在周期性系统中不是一个易于测量或计算的量，这种情况在实践中常导致将 U 视为可调参数。当前工作使用无参数的类平均场方法（密度泛函理论，DFT），允许降低能量的对称性破缺。这是通过将局域磁性模体视为宏观 AFM 或 PM 相的构建块来实现的。研究发现，即使当这些模体通过嵌入量子势垒（例如局域被宽禁带 MgO 包围的磁性 NiO6 八面体）而在电子上彼此隔离（即 LRO 消失）时，它们也表现出本征带隙。因此，AFM 或 PM 相中带隙的起源不必是 LRO 或强关联，并且可以在具有对称性破缺的类平均场能带结构方法内理解。

items.title_en: CertiSum: Bitwise-Identical MXFP4 Training Across Platforms and Parallelism Layouts
items.title_zh: CertiSum：跨平台和并行布局的逐位相同 MXFP4 训练
items.abstract_en: Training with MXFP4, a 4-bit microscaling format, is non-deterministic: identical inputs can produce different results across parallelism layouts and GPU vendors. These differences complicate debugging and training audits and can cause training and inference engines to disagree. We present CertiSum to make MXFP4 training bitwise invariant across runs, parallelism layouts, and GPU vendors. Its key insight is that native FP32 accumulation of MXFP4 products is often already exact for every summation order. CertiSum collects statistics during quantization to certify native matrix multiplication results, recomputes uncertified outputs exactly, and uses exact kernels directly where certification rarely succeeds. CertiSum keeps quantization blocks unchanged across layouts and merges partial sums without rounding, including in attention and weight-gradient computation. In 200-step Qwen3-8B-Base experiments, CertiSum preserves training states bit for bit across AMD MI350X and NVIDIA GB200 and across changes in data, tensor, and context parallelism on MI350X. Across three 8B--14B models on FineWeb-Edu using MI350X, it adds 11.8--60.5% to training-step latency relative to its non-exact MXFP4 counterpart at the larger evaluated input shapes, with speedups of up to $1.24\times$ over BF16 and $1.70\times$ over deterministic BF16.
items.abstract_zh: 使用 MXFP4（一种 4 位微缩放格式）进行训练是非确定性的：相同的输入在不同并行布局和 GPU 供应商之间可能产生不同结果。这些差异使调试和训练审计复杂化，并可能导致训练引擎和推理引擎不一致。我们提出 CertiSum，使 MXFP4 训练在多次运行、并行布局和 GPU 供应商之间逐位不变。其关键见解是，MXFP4 乘积的原生 FP32 累加对于每种求和顺序通常已经是精确的。CertiSum 在量化期间收集统计信息以认证原生矩阵乘法结果，精确重算未认证的输出，并在认证很少成功的地方直接使用精确核。CertiSum 保持量化块在不同布局间不变，并在不进行舍入的情况下合并部分和，包括在注意力和权重梯度计算中。在 200 步 Qwen3-8B-Base 实验中，CertiSum 在 AMD MI350X 和 NVIDIA GB200 之间，以及在 MI350X 上数据、张量和上下文并行变化时，逐位保持训练状态。在使用 MI350X 的 FineWeb-Edu 上，对于三个 8B–14B 模型，在较大的评估输入形状下，相对于非精确 MXFP4 对应方案，它将训练步延迟增加了 11.8–60.5%，同时相对于 BF16 最高加速 1.24 倍，相对于确定性 BF16 最高加速 1.70 倍。

items.title_en: Beyond Bilingual: Studying Quadrilingual Code-Switching with Conversational AI
items.title_zh: 超越双语：研究使用会话式 AI 的四语码切换
items.abstract_en: Multilingual speakers choose languages by topic and conversation partner. Large language models (LLMs) support these languages unequally. Research on code-switching with conversational AI has mostly examined bilingual pairs of well-resourced languages. In Curaçao and Aruba, many people use Dutch, English, Spanish, and the low-resource Creole Papiamentu/o. In a preregistered study, 42 university students held two five-minute chatbot conversations, one about university life and one about local food and culture. Surveys assessed language background, AI use, and switching comfort. 20 international students in Curaçao formed a comparison sample. Participants switched between turns and rarely mixed languages within a message. English dominated both conversations. Participants switched more often in the cultural conversation, where Papiamentu/o and Spanish rose from 15% to 24% of messages. Self-reports showed no lower comfort switching with the chatbot than with a person. Conversational agents must follow turn-by-turn language changes and handle local low-resource languages well.
items.abstract_zh: 多语使用者根据话题和对话伙伴选择语言。大型语言模型（LLM）对这些语言的支持并不均衡。关于会话式 AI 中码切换的研究大多考察资源丰富语言的双语对。在库拉索和阿鲁巴，许多人使用荷兰语、英语、西班牙语以及低资源克里奥尔语 Papiamentu/o。在一项预注册研究中，42 名大学生进行了两次五分钟的聊天机器人对话，一次关于大学生活，一次关于当地食物和文化。调查评估了语言背景、AI 使用情况和切换舒适度。库拉索的 20 名国际学生构成比较样本。参与者在轮次之间切换语言，很少在单条消息内混合语言。英语在两次对话中占主导。参与者在文化对话中更频繁地切换，其中 Papiamentu/o 和西班牙语从消息的 15% 上升到 24%。自我报告显示，与聊天机器人切换语言的舒适度不低于与人切换。会话智能体必须遵循逐轮语言变化，并很好地处理当地低资源语言。

items.title_en: WTR-Drive: World-Task Decomposition with Structured Risk Supervision for End-to-End Driving
items.title_zh: WTR-Drive：用于端到端驾驶的带结构化风险监督的世界-任务分解
items.abstract_en: Proposal-conditioned scene predictions can lack a common object-level reference across candidate trajectories. Aggregate planning scores also leave the objects and times associated with violations implicit. We present WTR-Drive (World-Task-Risk Driving), a Drive-JEPA-based planner that separates shared scene estimation from proposal-conditioned reasoning. A proposal-independent World Memory estimates object states, map structure, and future motion by re-reading the original visual features at each refinement round. Proposal feedback updates a residual Task branch without writing back to World Memory. This branch guides refinement through candidate-specific retrieval and gated visual feedback. A final Task readout supplies candidate-conditioned features for scoring. We derive structured risk targets from existing candidate-scoring rollouts without additional simulator calls. For at-fault collision and time-to-collision violations, the targets encode event existence, association with shared object slots, and the first violation time bin. On the NAVSIM navtest split, WTR-Drive achieves 94.66 PDMS on v1 and 88.24 EPDMS on v2 (expert-frame sequential evaluation). These scores are 0.96 and 0.44 points above the published Drive-JEPA values, respectively. Candidate-level analysis shows that higher best-candidate scores can coexist with lower selected-trajectory scores, revealing a gap between candidate quality and selection effectiveness.
items.abstract_zh: 以提议为条件的场景预测可能缺乏跨候选轨迹的共同对象级参考。聚合规划分数也使与违规相关的对象和时间保持隐式。我们提出 WTR-Drive（World-Task-Risk Driving），一种基于 Drive-JEPA 的规划器，将共享场景估计与以提议为条件的推理分离。与提议无关的世界记忆通过在每一轮细化时重新读取原始视觉特征来估计对象状态、地图结构和未来运动。提议反馈更新残差任务分支，而不写回世界记忆。该分支通过候选特定的检索和门控视觉反馈引导细化。最终任务读出提供以候选为条件的特征用于评分。我们从现有的候选评分 rollout 中导出结构化风险目标，而无需额外的模拟器调用。对于有责碰撞和碰撞时间违规，目标编码事件存在性、与共享对象槽的关联以及首次违规时间箱。在 NAVSIM navtest 划分上，WTR-Drive 在 v1 上达到 94.66 PDMS，在 v2 上达到 88.24 EPDMS（专家帧顺序评估）。这些分数分别比已发表的 Drive-JEPA 值高 0.96 和 0.44 分。候选级分析表明，更高的最佳候选分数可以与较低的所选轨迹分数共存，揭示了候选质量与选择有效性之间的差距。

items.title_en: BLIP-Live: Balancing Timeliness & Firing Precision in Proactive Streaming Video Agents
items.title_zh: BLIP-Live：在主动式流式视频智能体中平衡及时性与触发精度
items.abstract_en: Streaming video understanding is becoming increasingly important for real-world interactive systems. Such systems must be proactive for natural and useful human interaction: they should respond as soon as sufficient evidence becomes available while avoiding premature, redundant, or incorrect responses. We present BLIP-Live, a framework unifying data, metrics, harness, and training around a shared formulation of proactivity as effective causal response decisions balancing the two competing objectives of responding vs silence. First, we construct BLIP-Live-780K dataset containing human annotations of proactive response content and timing, which defines this desired behavior. We then propose PAUC-F, a metric to effectively measure our desired proactive behavior. PAUC-F combines existing response timeliness metrics with firing precision to reward early useful responses without rewarding excessive firing. With our desired behavior defined and measurable, we finally investigate model-agnostic inference harnesses that draw out proactive streaming capabilities of offline vision language models (VLMs), together with training pipelines that learn to further improve their proactive responsiveness. Across both settings, we find that combinations of sliding visual windows, online interaction memory, and structured response outputs consistently yield strongest proactive performance. Our experiments result in two models, with our BLIP-Live-Qwen model achieving state-of-the-art performance across four proactive streaming benchmarks, with gains up to 44% over baselines and outperforming multiple closed API models. Our code and data will be released publicly.
items.abstract_zh: 流式视频理解对于现实世界的交互系统正变得越来越重要。此类系统必须具有主动性，才能实现自然且有用的人机交互：它们应在足够证据出现时尽快响应，同时避免过早、冗余或不正确的响应。我们提出 BLIP-Live，一个围绕主动性的共享表述统一数据、指标、执行框架与训练的框架，该表述将主动性定义为在响应与沉默这两个相互竞争的目标之间取得平衡的有效因果响应决策。首先，我们构建了 BLIP-Live-780K 数据集，其中包含对主动响应内容与时机的人工标注，从而定义了这种期望行为。接着，我们提出 PAUC-F，一种有效度量我们所期望主动行为的指标。PAUC-F 将现有的响应及时性指标与触发精确率相结合，以奖励早期有用响应，同时不奖励过度触发。在期望行为已被定义且可度量之后，我们最后研究了模型无关的推理框架，以激发离线视觉语言模型（VLM）的主动流式能力，并研究了学习进一步提升其主动响应性的训练流程。在这两种设置中，我们发现滑动视觉窗口、在线交互记忆和结构化响应输出的组合始终带来最强的主动性能。我们的实验产生两个模型，其中 BLIP-Live-Qwen 模型在四个主动流式基准上取得最先进性能，相对基线提升最高达 44%，并优于多个闭源 API 模型。我们的代码和数据将公开发布。

items.title_en: Astrocyte Biocomputing: Astrocytic Contributions to Neural Network Computation
items.title_zh: 星形胶质细胞生物计算：星形胶质细胞对神经网络计算的贡献
items.abstract_en: Conductors are critical for the performance of an orchestra even though they do not emit sound. Basic research and clinical studies in the last decade are revealing that astrocytes may be the "conductors" of the "orchestra" that is the brain network: astrocytes make up approximately $50\%$ of all brain cells but do not emit electrical signals. Nevertheless, they may play critical roles in important cognitive brain functions, specifically learning, memory, and information processing. Here we consider the implications of these discoveries for brain-inspired machine learning (ML), where analogy is typically drawn between neurons and their electrical interactions. We highlight specific algorithms for two key astrocyte characteristics. The first characteristic is the ability to link to and modulate thousands of synapses simultaneously. A model based on this characteristic yields faster training and makes the network more robust to noise, providing a supervised learning algorithm that can be applied to any existing neural network. The second characteristic we focus on is that the non-electrical communication among astrocytes includes slow, rhythmic dynamics. The rhythmic sharing algorithm we developed based on this premise yields rapid anomaly detection adaptation and prevents catastrophic forgetting. Overall, we find that astrocyte-derived algorithms outperform neurocentric algorithms significantly and remediate critical weaknesses of current state-of-the-art ML models.
items.abstract_zh: 指挥对管弦乐队的表现至关重要，尽管他们并不发声。过去十年的基础研究与临床研究表明，星形胶质细胞可能是脑网络这一“管弦乐队”的“指挥”：星形胶质细胞约占所有脑细胞的 50%，但不发出电信号。尽管如此，它们可能在重要的大脑认知功能中发挥关键作用，特别是学习、记忆和信息处理。在此，我们考虑这些发现对类脑机器学习（ML）的启示，其中通常将神经元及其电相互作用进行类比。我们针对星形胶质细胞的两个关键特征重点介绍具体算法。第一个特征是能够同时连接并调节数千个突触。基于该特征的模型可实现更快的训练，并使网络对噪声更稳健，提供了一种可应用于任何现有神经网络的监督学习算法。我们关注的第二个特征是，星形胶质细胞之间的非电通信包含缓慢的节律性动态。我们基于这一前提开发的节律共享算法实现了快速的异常检测适应，并防止灾难性遗忘。总体而言，我们发现源自星形胶质细胞的算法显著优于以神经元为中心的算法，并弥补了当前最先进机器学习模型的关键弱点。

items.title_en: Quantum state tomography with measurement-conditioned diffusion models
items.title_zh: 基于测量条件扩散模型的量子态层析
items.abstract_en: We introduce Diff-QST, a measurement-conditioned diffusion model for quantum state tomography that learns from an ensemble of input states and reconstructs a physical density operator from noisy, possibly incomplete Pauli measurements in two or three denoising steps. In simulations of two to five qubits, Diff-QST has higher mean fidelity than maximum-likelihood estimation (MLE) and a semidefinite-programming least-squares estimator (SDP) in all 120 tested conditions at nominal noise. After training, GPU reconstruction is faster than both in condition-averaged time at every system size and, at four and five qubits, in every condition. At four and five qubits, though not at two and three, Diff-QST also has higher fidelity than an architecture-matched regression baseline trained without diffusion. At five qubits, over the tested numbers of observables and shots per observable, it reaches a specified fidelity with 25%-67% fewer total shots than this baseline. Under state and noise distributions that differ from those used in training, Diff-QST retains its fidelity advantage over MLE and SDP in most tested conditions, although it can reverse. Diff-QST is therefore suited to fast tomography from noisy, incomplete Pauli measurements of states represented by its training ensemble.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 Diff-QST，一种用于量子态层析的测量条件扩散模型，它从输入态集合中学习，并在两到三个去噪步骤中从含噪、可能不完整的泡利测量中重建物理密度算符。在二至五个量子比特的模拟中，在标称噪声下的全部 120 个测试条件中，Diff-QST 的平均保真度高于最大似然估计（MLE）和半定规划最小二乘估计器（SDP）。训练后，GPU 重建在每个系统规模上的条件平均时间都快于二者，并且在四和五个量子比特时在每个条件下都更快。在四和五个量子比特时（但二和三个量子比特时并非如此），Diff-QST 的保真度也高于未使用扩散训练、架构匹配的回归基线。在五个量子比特时，在所测试的可观测量数量与每个可观测量测量次数范围内，它以比该基线少 25%-67% 的总测量次数达到指定保真度。在与训练所用分布不同的状态和噪声分布下，Diff-QST 在大多数测试条件中保持相对 MLE 和 SDP 的保真度优势，尽管该优势可能反转。因此，Diff-QST 适用于从其训练集合所表示状态的含噪、不完整泡利测量中进行快速层析。

items.title_en: Stability-Compensated Threshold Calibration for Selection-Conditioned Risk Control in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 面向大语言模型中选择条件风险控制的稳定性补偿阈值校准
items.abstract_en: Large language models often produce hallucinated answers, motivating selective prediction policies that abstain on uncertain queries. However, heuristic uncertainty thresholds alone do not provide statistical control of errors among accepted predictions. Linear Expectation Constraints (LEC) reduce selection-conditioned error rate (SCER) calibration to a nonpositive expected linear-loss constraint, but the associated loss is non-monotonic in the acceptance threshold. We construct an exact counterexample under i.i.d. sampling demonstrating that LEC's empirical threshold-selection rule can violate the population SCER target. To address this risk-transfer gap, we introduce Stability-Compensated Linear Expectation Control (SC-LEC), which uses the negative linear risk of a theoretical full-data reference to compensate for threshold-selection instability. For local expansion beyond a safe anchor, we derive two finite-sample certificates: a stability-based certificate exploiting rank crossings and a direct certificate using the structure of threshold expansion to reduce conservatism. With a valid population anchor margin, our certificate conditions ensure finite-sample marginal SCER control, and independent margin certification further provides a $1-δ$ high-probability guarantee for this calibration-averaged control. Experiments on CommonsenseQA, ARC-Challenge, and TriviaQA show useful retention gains beyond the same certified anchor, while revealing conservative behavior in small-margin regimes.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型经常产生幻觉答案，这促使人们采用对不确定查询弃权的选择性预测策略。然而，仅靠启发式不确定性阈值无法对已接受预测中的错误提供统计控制。线性期望约束（LEC）将选择条件错误率（SCER）校准简化为非正期望线性损失约束，但相关损失相对于接受阈值是非单调的。我们在独立同分布采样下构造了一个精确反例，表明 LEC 的经验阈值选择规则可能违反总体 SCER 目标。为解决这一风险迁移差距，我们引入稳定性补偿线性期望控制（SC-LEC），它使用理论全数据参考的负线性风险来补偿阈值选择的不稳定性。对于超出安全锚点的局部扩展，我们推导出两种有限样本证书：一种利用秩交叉的基于稳定性的证书，以及一种利用阈值扩展结构以降低保守性的直接证书。在具有有效的总体锚点裕度时，我们的证书条件确保有限样本边际 SCER 控制，而独立的裕度认证进一步为这种校准平均控制提供 $1-δ$ 高概率保证。在 CommonsenseQA、ARC-Challenge 和 TriviaQA 上的实验显示，在相同已验证锚点之外获得了有用的保留率提升，同时揭示了小裕度情形下的保守行为。

items.title_en: Semantics First, Pixels Later: Mission-Driven Event Streams for Drone Video over Bandwidth-Starved Links
items.title_zh: 语义优先，像素在后：带宽匮乏链路上面向无人机视频的任务驱动事件流
items.abstract_en: A surveillance drone on a bandwidth-starved link cannot send the video its operator would need, yet the operator's questions are often not about pixels: did three people converge, when, and where? We study what should cross a link of 1 Mbps down to 1 kbps instead, and in what order. BPS, a behavior-primitive stream, sends semantics first and pixels later: it runs a detector and a tracker onboard and sends short records (25 bytes on average) of multi-frame events selected by a mission card of 16-125 bytes, ahead of positions and pictures. We measure it by what a ground-side language model answers from it, under a preregistered protocol with a held-out set, against H.265 read by the vision fine-tune of the same model, H.265 on which the ground runs our own perception, a stream of quantized tracks, and onboard captions. On the development set (84% of questions about convergence, mostly one location) the event stream answers 74.3% of questions at 0.13 kbps. A reader that receives nothing answers 57.4%, and the video reader 59.6% at 100 kbps and 64.7% on the source frames. When the ground instead runs our perception on the video, video matches the stream at 100 kbps, about 800 times the stream's rate, and falls behind at 64 kbps and below. A track stream matches it at 96 times the bytes and loses 0.03 at 17 times. On held-out data the result is weaker: with events taken from annotated tracks, an oracle, the stream beats H.265 at 100 kbps (+0.13), but with onboard perception it does not (+0.01 [-0.04, +0.06]) and is no better than receiving nothing. Sent alone through emulated links the event records answer 0.739 at 1 Mbps and still 0.724 at 0.3 kbps; an every-frame track stream holds down to 1 kbps and video with ground-side perception down to about 100 kbps. On a Jetson Orin Nano the unchanged pipeline runs at 4.5 fps and misses most events.
items.abstract_zh: 带宽匮乏链路上的监视无人机无法发送操作员所需的视频，然而操作员的问题往往与像素无关：三个人是否聚集、何时以及何地？我们研究在 1 Mbps 直至 1 kbps 的链路上，取而代之应该传输什么，以及以什么顺序传输。BPS 是一种行为基元流，先发送语义，后发送像素：它在机上运行检测器和跟踪器，并在位置和图像之前发送由 16-125 字节的任务卡选择的多帧事件的短记录（平均 25 字节）。我们在预注册协议下，使用留出集，通过地面侧语言模型据此回答的内容来衡量它，并与同一模型视觉微调所读取的 H.265、地面运行我们自身感知的 H.265、量化轨迹流以及机上字幕进行比较。在开发集上（84% 的问题关于聚集，且大多为一个地点），事件流在 0.13 kbps 下回答了 74.3% 的问题。什么都不接收的读取器回答 57.4%，视频读取器在 100 kbps 下回答 59.6%，在源帧上回答 64.7%。当地面改为对视频运行我们的感知时，视频在 100 kbps（约为该流率的 800 倍）下与事件流相当，并在 64 kbps 及以下落后。轨迹流以 96 倍的字节量与之相当，并在 17 倍字节量时低 0.03。在留出数据上结果较弱：当事件取自标注轨迹（一种预言机）时，该流在 100 kbps 下优于 H.265（+0.13），但在使用机上感知时并非如此（+0.01 [-0.04, +0.06]），并且并不比什么都不接收更好。单独通过仿真链路发送时，事件记录在 1 Mbps 下回答 0.739，在 0.3 kbps 下仍有 0.724；每帧轨迹流可维持到 1 kbps，而带地面侧感知的视频可维持到约 100 kbps。在 Jetson Orin Nano 上，未改动的流水线以 4.5 fps 运行，并漏掉大多数事件。
